We formalize multimodal memory as four stages, Write, Update, Retrieve and Answer, and define nine error types across them. A stage-resolved analysis on Mem-Gallery traces most failures to a source stage, and most of those lie before the answer. Injecting known errors against fact-preserving control edits, we then follow each tainted record downstream. Early errors survive to the answer as apparent evidence, and hurt most when no other record holds the fact. A diagnosis that trusts the quoted evidence therefore blames the stage where the error surfaces, not the one where it began. We propose MemDoctor, in which the MLLM that built the memory diagnoses its own failures. It traces each needed fact backward through the four stages, accepts a diagnosis only when the cited evidence is found in memory, and repairs that stage before answering again. On a 4B backbone, MemDoctor improves accuracy on both Mem-Gallery and MemLens, outperforming all evaluated 8B baselines, and the same loop also improves MuRAG and A-Mem.

</details>


### [138] [Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21056)
*Zhe Ren,Guowei Rong,Yimeng Chen,Nanbo Li,Piotr Piękos,Mateusz Ostaszewski,Dandan Guo,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种不依赖候选智能体下游任务评测的自我改进方法：先独立探索多种代码改进，再整合互补且兼容的机制。实验显示，该方法在提升性能的同时减少了演化耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我改进编程智能体通常依靠在下游任务上的表现来筛选后续候选方案。反复运行候选方案会增加评测成本，而持续针对固定评测分布优化也可能导致对基准测试的过度适应。因此，论文探讨能否在演化过程中完全不使用候选方案的下游任务表现，仍实现有效改进。

Method: 论文提出“探索后整合”方法。每一代针对同一个父代提出多种聚焦于不同方面的改进，并分别独立实现；随后检查各实现中的机制，辨别其互补、重复或冲突之处，再将兼容的改进重新实现为一个连贯的后代。演化过程中不使用候选方案的任务结果或解题轨迹，仅进行确定性的结构与运行有效性检查。

Result: 在软件工程专业基准测试中，该方法将初始智能体的成功率从百分之六十提升至百分之八十五点六；对比的两种既有方法分别达到百分之八十六点七和百分之八十八点三。该方法未进行候选方案任务评测；在所测试的配置下，其演化墙钟时间分别比两种对比方法缩短八点八倍和三点二倍。无需进一步适配时，该方法在软件工程验证基准和多语言基准上的平均成绩分别为百分之七十三点三和百分之六十九点三。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在论文所测试的设置中，编程智能体可以不依赖下游候选任务评测，通过整合多种实现机制实现有效自我改进，并显著降低评测负担与演化耗时。不过，其性能仍略低于两种对比方法；结论的适用范围也应限于摘要所报告的实验配置与基准。

Abstract: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.

</details>


### [139] [SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21095)
*Tae Soo Kim,Tongshuang Wu,Juho Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于真实用户意图模拟对话的编程智能体评测方法，能够适应智能体偏离原始操作轨迹的情况，并支持模型排名与用户决策研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户与编程智能体的录制会话有助于评估智能体完成任务及与用户互动的能力，但直接重放会话存在局限：当新智能体采取不同操作时，录制下来的用户回复可能不再适用。因此，需要一种既保留真实会话依据、又能针对新情境生成合适回复的重放方法。

Method: 研究提出一套会话重放框架，对录制内容中的用户意图、满足意图的标准及意图出现的条件进行建模，再由用户模拟器依据这些信息生成回复。这样，即使智能体出现录制中未曾发生的对话或操作，模拟回复仍能适应新情境，同时以原始记录为依据。

Result: 在八十九段真实会话中，该方法生成的回复与真实用户回复最相似；在改写会话的评测中，其表现与最强基线相当。针对智能体重复或回避曾遭用户反对操作的测试中，该方法在成功回避相关操作方面取得百分之六十六点三的胜率，显著高于随机水平。研究还用其对五种大语言模型进行编程智能体排名，发现排名会随用户表达和发展意图的方式而变化；在十六名用户参与的研究中，重放本人会话改变了十四人的模型排名，并影响了他们今后的智能体使用选择。

Conclusion: 基于意图建模的用户模拟可以让真实会话重放更具适应性，并支持对编程智能体进行贴近用户需求的比较评估。评测结果也表明，模型优劣并非固定不变，而会受到用户意图及其表达过程的影响。

Abstract: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.

</details>


### [140] [From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21152)
*Yang Tian,Tianyu Zheng,Xiyuan Yang,Yaxin Du,Chengran Yang,Bo Zhao,Jian Yang,Bryan Dai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出自动化流水线“仓库工厂”，将真实代码仓库转化为可验证的长程编程训练环境，并通过环境演化循环提升环境质量；实验显示，使用生成环境训练的模型在多项基准测试中取得明显提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程编程任务需要可验证的反馈，但现有环境构建流程通常只在末尾验证是否可用，难以指导环境改进。依赖模型生成轨迹或训练后评估的递归自我改进，又会带来较高成本和反馈延迟。因此，论文希望利用及时、可靠的代理信号，提升训练环境的价值并实现规模化合成。

Method: 提出“仓库工厂”自动化流水线：从真实软件仓库生成环境，要求智能体依据自然语言规格从零构建完整项目。其核心“环境演化循环”利用代理反馈，优化由有效性、结构耦合度和实现范围共同构成的乘法目标，以迭代改进环境。该流程共生成了覆盖十七个软件领域的一万零一百五十九个环境。

Result: 在这些环境上训练的模型“仓库地平线三十五Ｂ”，在自然语言到代码仓库基准上提升二十二点六个百分点，在涵盖长程编程及真实生产环境智能体任务的五项基准上平均提升八点五个百分点。相比之下，不使用环境演化循环时，提升分别为十七点五和六点四个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究表明，真实仓库生成的可验证环境能够有效提升长程编程智能体的训练效果；环境演化循环进一步带来显著收益。及时的代理反馈因而可作为低成本环境优化手段，支持高价值训练环境的规模化构建。

Abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.

</details>


### [141] [Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21155)
*Daisuke Kikuta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究大语言模型能否提前预测用户对生成内容的修改需求，并提出用决策模型筛除不可靠建议，以提升展示给用户的建议质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户常在大语言模型生成内容后提出修改要求。若模型能预先预测这些要求，便可减少用户审阅和反馈的成本；但真实场景中的部分修改需求难以准确预测，因此需要评估方法和应对机制。

Method: 作者将预测用户修改要求的问题形式化为编辑建议任务，并利用真实对话日志构建编辑推荐基准。通过基准测试和失败案例分析，识别难以预测的情形；进一步引入基于决策模型的门控机制，在向用户展示建议前筛除预计不准确的案例。

Result: 实验表明，训练得到的决策模型优于现有决策模型。设置门控阈值后，展示出的建议在前五项建议命中率指标上提升了十二至二十五个百分点。

Conclusion: 提前推荐编辑需求具有降低用户反馈成本的潜力，但真实场景中存在天然难以预测的案例。通过决策模型进行门控，可以减少不可靠建议的展示，并显著改善所展示建议的质量。

Abstract: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation.

</details>


### [142] [PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21160)
*Obada Kraishan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建并公开了一个配对语料库，将处方药的医务人员说明与患者说明对应起来，并分析其可读性、语言特点及配对质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处方药说明面向医务人员和患者，内容涉及同一种药物，但公共资源通常未将两类文本并列整理。这使研究者难以系统比较其结构、可读性和表达方式，也不利于评估患者说明是否通俗易懂。

Method: 作者利用美国开放药品标签文件建立语料库，依据监管标题将患者说明片段与医务人员说明章节配对，并计算阅读难度和通俗语言用词等指标。语料还纳入美国国家癌症研究所提供的英语和西班牙语患者版及专业版癌症信息摘要。作者通过人工盲审抽查一百组配对，并将保留公司版权标记的文本排除在文本表之外。

Result: 第一版语料库包含三万五千一百七十七份带有患者文本的处方药标签、二万一千四百一十六份不同的患者文本，以及二十五万零八百二十九个与医务人员章节配对的患者文本片段；另含七百五十六份癌症信息摘要。药品指南的阅读难度中位数为弗莱施—金凯德八点七年级、斯莫格十一点一年级。若按批量文件提供的扁平化文本测量，难度约高出两个年级，主要源于列表和标题边界丢失。患者文本每百句中有四十一句直接面向读者，医务人员章节仅约零点二句。人工核查支持七成标题类型的配对方式。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了公开、可复用的双受众药品说明语料资源，并表明文本格式处理会显著影响可读性评估。语料可支持患者与医务人员说明的比较研究，但标题配对的可靠性因类型而异，使用时需注意其局限。

Abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.

</details>


### [143] [Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21183)
*Edoardo Cecchinato,Shun Inadumi,Angel García Contreras,Giuseppe Riccardi,Koichiro Yoshino*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建日语人机对话视觉指称基准，研究视觉语言模型如何借助对话上下文识别并消解歧义；实验显示，上下文尤其有助于处理日语零照应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉指称基准通常忽略真实场景中的上下文不确定性，难以评估模型在含歧义的人机交互中理解指称的能力。研究旨在补足这一评估缺口，并考察对话上下文对不同类型歧义的作用。

Method: 构建涵盖多种视觉与语言歧义的人机多模态对话数据集，评估多种先进视觉语言模型识别和消解歧义的能力；比较模型在视觉歧义与语言歧义处理上的对话上下文指称表现，并分析改进来自对话语义内容还是对话结构。

Result: 实验表明，利用对话上下文能够显著提升语言歧义的消解效果，尤其有助于处理日语零照应。研究还比较了对话内容与对话结构对指称表现提升的影响，但摘要未提供具体模型排名或定量结果。

Conclusion: 对话上下文是提升视觉语言模型歧义指称能力的重要信息来源，且对日语零照应等语言现象尤为有效。该基准为评估模型在更贴近真实交互场景中的歧义理解能力提供了基础。

Abstract: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.

</details>


### [144] [Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21208)
*Daniel Baumartz,Alexander Mehler,Mevlüt Bagci,Maxim Konca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究表明，将多个通用大语言模型作文评分系统的输出组合起来，再用少量特征训练线性支持向量机，可以较准确地重建医学教育写作任务中的人工评分等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对大语言模型作文评分系统的训练、微调和评估成本高昂的问题，研究考察通用模型能否在不进行领域专门微调的情况下，辅助甚至部分替代医学教育写作评分中的人工标注。

Method: 研究使用11种作文评分系统和8种大语言模型，对668份学生答卷、12项任务进行评分，并收集7名人工评阅者共2076次评分。研究将人工评分汇总为较一致的学习者水平类别，再以作文评分系统输出的少量特征训练线性支持向量机，并评估其跨任务与跨领域的泛化能力。

Result: 线性支持向量机能够较准确地重建依据人工评分划分的学习者类别；同一分类器在不同任务和领域中也表现出良好泛化能力。推理与内容相关特征最具预测力。单个自动评分系统不足以独立达到这一效果，但组合多个系统后可近似人工评阅结果。

Conclusion: 通用大语言模型即使未经医学领域专门微调，也能为医学教育作文评分提供有效支持。组合多个评分系统并利用其特征进行分类，有望减少人工评分负担或辅助人工评阅；研究结果并不意味着可以无条件完全取代人工评阅。

Abstract: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.

</details>


### [145] [Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21211)
*Lukas Ellinger,Georg Groh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究语言模型能否在不确定时主动降低答案粒度，以兼顾正确性与信息量；实验显示这种能力可以通过训练学得，但收益因模型而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对不确定的问题，模型往往需要在猜测、拒答和给出较粗略但有用的答案之间选择。粗粒度回答有望避免无依据的精确断言，同时保留有效信息。论文因此考察模型能否学会根据自身置信程度调整答案粒度。

Method: 研究者利用模型条件监督进行微调：根据多次采样回答的一致性，以及模型对不同粒度答案的识别能力，构造训练信号。评估涵盖四种不同规模的语言模型、时间与地理问题，以及三个泛化数据集；比较答案的正确性与信息量，并考察模型是否会随基础模型置信度变化而调整粒度。

Result: 在若干领域内设置中，微调模型在正确性与信息量之间的权衡优于将基础模型答案统一调整到某个固定粒度的做法。在泛化数据集上，四种模型在基础模型置信度较低时，都更常给出较粗略的答案。三种较小模型在未见过的关系上，综合考虑正确性与粒度后，其答案也比基础模型答案更受偏好。

Conclusion: 实验表明，语言模型能够学习与置信度相关的答案粒度调整：不确定时倾向于提供较粗略的回答，而非一味猜测或拒答。不过，这种能力带来的实际收益会因模型而异，仍需进一步研究其跨领域稳定性与适用范围。

Abstract: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-related granularity adaptation, with benefits varying by model.

</details>


### [146] [A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21232)
*Mo Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文以家庭本地服务器为核心，提出本地优先智能家居的设计综述框架，归纳系统架构、评价维度与设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端助手在数据传输治理、持续可用性和现实动作可靠性方面存在局限；这些问题在长期在线、持续积累数据且命令会触发实体设备的家庭环境中尤为突出。现有研究也缺少能够统一比较家居控制、情感陪伴与智能守护的分析框架。

Method: 作者检索学术论文、基准测试及官方文档，并将资料归入综述、系统原型、基准测试、人机交互与老年照护研究、官方文档五类。随后以家庭本地服务器为组织主轴，将系统设计映射到共同架构模块，归纳其九项反复出现的职责，并提出涵盖架构能力、系统资源、隐私、安全与可靠性、人类体验的五维评价框架。

Result: 分析指出，生成模型适合处理感知、意图理解和候选计划；确定性验证、知识图谱约束及授权租约则可将候选动作限制在可检查范围内。三类应用共享状态与记忆，但在时延、误报与漏报、主动程度及权限要求上存在差异。现有基准多依赖虚拟环境，不能替代真实部署评估；本地部署本身也不必然更安全，技术上的持续运行亦不足以证明陪伴或守护的社会与医疗效果。

Conclusion: 本文为本地优先智能家居提供了统一的设计与评价框架，并提出六项设计原则及未来研究议程。其核心启示是：应将生成式能力置于可审查、受约束的行动机制之中，同时通过真实场景部署评估隐私、安全、可靠性和人的实际体验。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.

</details>


### [147] [Benchmarking Large Language Models for Linguistic Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21291)
*Ondřej Tichý,Anna Marklová,Barbora Bulantová,Magdalena Titlbachová,Jiří Milička*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出用于语言学标注的大语言模型评测框架，强调按具体任务评估，并记录实验条件，以比较标注质量、置信度校准、重复性和成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的语言学标注能力需要在明确、可复现的条件下针对具体任务进行评估。仅凭通用模型排名，难以判断模型在不同语言学现象和实际应用中的表现。

Method: 作者开发了一个包含网页界面的基准测试与标注工具，可记录提示词、模型配置和预测结果，并支持探索与分享评测数据。研究通过该工具开展了293次运行，评估48个模型在9项语言学标注任务上的表现，涵盖形态、句法、语义、话语语用、拼写规范化和学习者语言纠正；评估维度包括标注质量、置信度校准、重复性和估算成本。

Result: 多个模型在若干任务上与参考标注高度一致，其中包括非标准化及历史语言变体，以及需要结合语境进行解释的任务。研究同时表明，不同任务中的模型表现并不宜简化为单一的通用排名。

Conclusion: 评估大语言模型的语言学标注能力，应以具体任务为单位，并公开记录实验条件，以提高比较的透明度与可复现性。作者将当前及未来的基准测试公开，供研究者使用和扩展。

Abstract: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. The results support evaluating models against specific linguistic tasks, rather than relying on general rankings. To this end, we make the current and future benchmarks publicly available at dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz.

</details>


### [148] [LATTE-WordSeg-Lite: Multi-Granularity Thai Word Segmentation on a CPU, with a Reproducible Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21300)
*Thodsaporn Chay-intr,Kobkrit Viriyayudhakorn,Thanaruk Theeramunkong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文将能同时利用多种词汇粒度的泰语格点模型压缩为轻量级切分器，并通过统一基准评测其准确率与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 泰语大型语言模型通常以子词为单位处理文本，但泰语树库、语音评测和形态资源多以词为单位，且采用不同粒度。词边界有助于消解子词切分留下的歧义。现有工具的已发表分数来自不同数据、划分和评测程序，难以公平比较；原有格点模型虽能处理多种粒度，却是大型显卡模型。

Method: 作者将格点注意编码模型蒸馏为轻量级泰语词切分器，参数量为一百一十七万，在仅使用中央处理器的条件下运行，并将词典格点信息保留为特征。模型可在一次处理中输出复合词、词和语素边界。训练数据仅包括带标注数据，以及许可条款允许商业使用的文本。评测方面，作者从固定版本的来源重建七个测试集，并以统一流程比较十二种系统。

Result: 在适用于各测试集的评测单位上，轻量级模型在七个测试集中的五个得分高于深切分工具，其中四个测试集来自其教师模型曾使用的语料。逐行调用、使用单个中央处理器线程时，该模型的运行速度是深切分工具的二十三倍。作者还发布了模型、基准测试脚本和全部预测结果。

Conclusion: 研究表明，保留词典格点特征的蒸馏方案能够把多粒度泰语切分能力带到小型中央处理器模型上，并显著提升运行速度。统一重建测试集也使不同工具的比较更可靠。不过，部分优势出现在教师模型训练过的语料上，因此其跨语料泛化能力仍需进一步评估。

Abstract: Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Yet Thai treebanks, speech metrics and morphological resources are built on words, often at several granularities, and word boundaries resolve ambiguities that subword tokens leave open. LATTE (Lattice ATTentive Encoding) reads a text at several granularities at once, through a lattice of dictionary words, but it is a large GPU model. We distil it into LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, a CPU segmenter of 1.17M parameters that keeps the lattice as features. It outputs compounds, words and morphemes in one pass, and learns only from annotated data and text whose licences allow commercial use. To compare it with other tools, published Thai scores do not suffice, as they come from different files, splits and scorers. We therefore rebuild seven test sets from pinned sources and score twelve systems under one protocol. With the unit that fits each test set, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite scores above DeepCut on five sets, four of them from corpora that its teachers learnt from. Called line by line on one CPU thread, it runs 23 times as fast as DeepCut. We release the model, the benchmark scripts and all predictions.

</details>


### [149] [Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21301)
*Qichao Wang,Tingyu Qu,Pengcheng Wu,Yiran Zhong,Feida Zhu,Zhiqi Shen,Peilin Zhao,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种协作生成方法：大模型只进行预填充、不参与逐词解码；小模型借助大模型的内部表示完成生成，从而提升输出质量并降低推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本式模型协作通常要求大模型先生成中间文本，再由小模型利用这些内容，因而仍需承担大模型逐词解码的成本。本文旨在保留大模型知识与推理能力的辅助作用，同时避免这部分解码开销。

Method: 方法采用冻结的大模型作为发送端、小模型作为接收端。发送端对输入进行预填充，其隐藏状态经可训练桥接模块映射为额外的注意力键和值，供接收端在自回归生成过程中持续使用。方法还支持周期性复核：发送端处理接收端已生成的部分内容，并通过额外预填充更新辅助信息，同时保留接收端已有的键值缓存。

Result: 在推理和编程基准测试中，该方法提升了接收端的表现，且可搭配不同模型家族的发送端。跨家族组合也能取得有效增益；例如，某一模型家族的发送端与另一家族的接收端配合时，效果可与更强发送端的组合相当。此外，在数学和编程任务上训练后，该方法无需额外领域训练即可迁移至一般知识任务。

Conclusion: 研究表明，大型前沿模型的预填充表示能够有效增强小模型生成，而不必让大模型参与自回归解码。这为降低模型协作推理成本、促进不同模型家族之间的表示迁移提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.

</details>


### [150] [Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21303)
*Jacob Moore,Paula Lauren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文首次系统比较藏文光学字符识别的音节级和词级错误率，并考察识别错误对词性、实体识别及机器翻译的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 藏文以音节边界而非词边界作为书写标记，因此词错误率的计算依赖分词器。现有评估主要使用字符错误率，难以充分反映识别结果在音节、词及下游语言任务中的实际质量。研究旨在补充更高层次的评估指标，并检验字符错误率是否足以代表系统表现。

Method: 研究在印刷体、木刻体及两种手写体上评估九种识别配置，并测试单一字体与混合字体训练。配置包括连接时序分类模型、经或未经后训练量化的视觉文本编码解码模型，以及视觉语言模型。评估采用字符、音节和基于三种分词器的词错误率；此外，将识别结果进行词性标注、命名实体标注和机器翻译，并与参考文本上的相应结果比较。

Result: 字符错误率对系统的排序总体与音节和词错误率一致，肯德尔秩相关系数至少为0.833，但有一对系统的排序相反。联合训练的影响中，有64组比较里的7组出现字符错误率与音节错误率显著变化方向相反的情况。音节错误率无需分词器，且其系统排序与三种分词器中的两种所得词错误率排序高度一致，相关系数至少为0.889。作为粗略参考，音节错误率不高于0.047时，机器翻译字符片段评分可达到60；不高于0.078时，词性保留率可达到0.8。现有错误率无法区分命名实体保留率能否达到0.6的系统。

Conclusion: 字符错误率虽能较好反映整体系统排序，但不能完全代表音节级表现，也可能掩盖训练策略对不同层级指标的相反影响。音节错误率无需分词器，且与多数词级排序相符，可作为实用的补充指标。若要预测下游任务质量，尤其是命名实体保留能力，还需要引入更直接的评价方法。

Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.

</details>


### [151] [What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21362)
*Ştefana-Arina Tăbuşcă,Ana Sabina Uban,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究提出从社交媒体文本估计症状层面心理网络的方法。抑郁症结果与临床量表有较好关联，网络边整体相近，但桥接症状存在差异；跨三个独立语料库重复发现的语言特征方向一致。饮食障碍结果仍属探索性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有精神病理症状网络几乎完全依赖自我报告问卷，因此分析范围受限于各量表所包含的症状。研究旨在利用社交媒体中的自然语言表达估计症状层面网络，并将其与临床症状共同认可网络比较，同时检验跨语料库、跨障碍的语言标记能否重复出现。

Method: 研究建立了从社交媒体文本直接估计症状层面心理网络的框架，并应用于抑郁症和饮食障碍。另以第三个厌食症语料库进行跨数据集验证。研究将文本表达得分与临床量表结果对照，评估网络边和桥接症状的差异，并检验三个独立招募语料库中的语言特征是否具有一致方向。

Result: 抑郁症文本表达得分与贝克抑郁量表第二版总分呈中等程度正相关，相关系数为零点四三四；二十一个条目中有二十个经错误发现率校正后达到显著，分半信度为零点九三五。网络比较检验发现，两种数据来源间仅有约百分之三至百分之五的网络边存在差异，但桥接症状有所不同。饮食障碍的条目层面结果属于探索性发现。识别出的语言特征在三个语料库中方向一致，并聚集为三个构念类别。

Conclusion: 研究表明，社交媒体文本可用于估计症状层面的心理网络，并为问卷之外的症状研究提供补充。抑郁症网络与临床共同认可网络整体较为接近，但桥接症状的差异提示两种数据来源可能揭示不同的症状联系结构。跨语料库重复的语言特征具有一定稳健性；饮食障碍相关结论仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.

</details>


### [152] [Stability-Compensated Threshold Calibration for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21384)
*Zhiyuan Wang,Yuanchang Ye,Jiahao Yuan,Jinhao Duan,Xiaoshuang Shi,Weijun Xie,Ye Wei,Kaidi Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出，基于线性期望约束的经验阈值选择可能无法保证总体选择条件错误率达标，并提出稳定性补偿方法及有限样本证书，在控制错误的同时提高可接受回答的保留率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型会产生幻觉，因此系统可对不确定问题拒绝回答。但单靠启发式不确定性阈值，无法对被接受回答中的错误率提供统计保证。线性期望约束虽可将选择条件错误率校准转化为期望线性损失约束，但该损失随接受阈值变化并非单调，因而经验上选出的阈值可能无法满足总体目标。

Method: 作者构造了一个独立同分布采样下的精确反例，展示经验阈值选择规则的风险转移缺口。为弥补这一缺口，他们提出稳定性补偿线性期望控制：利用理论上的全数据参考风险中的负线性风险，抵消阈值选择不稳定性。对于从安全锚点向更宽松阈值的局部扩展，作者进一步给出两类有限样本证书：一类利用排序交叉分析稳定性，另一类利用阈值扩展结构直接认证，以减少保守性。若总体锚点具有有效的风险裕量，证书条件可保证有限样本下的边际选择条件错误率控制；独立认证该裕量，还可获得针对校准平均控制的一减δ高概率保证。

Result: 在常识问答、学术能力挑战题和琐事问答数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较于同一认证锚点能够保留更多回答。实验同时显示，在风险裕量较小时，方法表现较为保守。

Conclusion: 经验阈值规则本身不足以保证总体选择条件错误率，尤其当损失随阈值非单调时。通过稳定性补偿和有限样本认证，作者为安全扩展接受范围提供了统计控制方案；其实际收益是提高回答保留率，但在裕量较小的场景中仍存在保守性。

Abstract: Large language models often produce hallucinated answers, motivating selective prediction policies that abstain on uncertain queries. However, heuristic uncertainty thresholds alone do not provide statistical control of errors among accepted predictions. Linear Expectation Constraints (LEC) reduce selection-conditioned error rate (SCER) calibration to a nonpositive expected linear-loss constraint, but the associated loss is non-monotonic in the acceptance threshold. We construct an exact counterexample under i.i.d. sampling demonstrating that LEC's empirical threshold-selection rule can violate the population SCER target. To address this risk-transfer gap, we introduce Stability-Compensated Linear Expectation Control (SC-LEC), which uses the negative linear risk of a theoretical full-data reference to compensate for threshold-selection instability. For local expansion beyond a safe anchor, we derive two finite-sample certificates: a stability-based certificate exploiting rank crossings and a direct certificate using the structure of threshold expansion to reduce conservatism. With a valid population anchor margin, our certificate conditions ensure finite-sample marginal SCER control, and independent margin certification further provides a $1-δ$ high-probability guarantee for this calibration-averaged control. Experiments on CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, and TriviaQA show useful retention gains beyond the same certified anchor, while revealing conservative behavior in small-margin regimes.

</details>


### [153] [Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21393)
*Federico Lucca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，少量个人邮件标签微调决策模型，并未稳定优于同数据训练的逻辑回归基线；邮件类型上较大的模型在全部标签下略有优势，但三个操作开关任务中基线始终更准确、速度也快得多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究发现，约两百条标签训练的词频—逆文档频率逻辑回归，在该用户收件箱上取得最高点准确率，且与最佳托管模型差异不显著。本研究进一步考察：将同一批个人标签用于微调决策模型，能否缩小模型与基线之间的差距。

Method: 研究先进行一项预注册试验，使用通用的四十亿参数基础模型、交叉验证和仅包含邮件类型的任务。主试验在任何微调运行前预注册，采用一百三十五封固定测试邮件，确保其不参与模型选择；对公开的八亿及四十亿参数决策模型使用低秩适配微调，训练标签量为五十至五百八十七条，并使用两个随机种子评估五个决策字段。实验在免费图形处理器上进行，同时与同一批标签训练的逻辑回归基线比较。

Result: 初步试验在所有标签规模下均低于基线一點八至七點三个百分点。主试验的五项假设中，四项未获支持，其中两项结果有利于微调模型，另有一项仅对一个模型成立。邮件类型任务上，四十亿参数模型在四百条标签时仅高出基线二點六个百分点，未达到预设的三个百分点优势门槛；使用全部五百八十七条标签后，高出三點三个百分点。此时两种微调模型的准确率分别仅高出基线零點七和三點三个百分点；由于测试集较小，每封邮件约对应零點七四个百分点，准确率差异的百分之九十五区间宽约十五个百分点。四十亿参数模型的类型宏平均Ｆ一分数为零點五八一，高于基线的零點四零六。三个操作开关任务中，基线在所有标签规模下均领先；使用全部标签时，基线平均准确率为零點九三一，两个微调模型为零點九零四和零點八九九。基线每题耗时不足一毫秒，而两个模型分别约需三百零六和一千六百八十一毫秒。八亿参数模型的邮件类型表现约在三百条标签后停滞并随后下降。基线未预测训练集中最稀有的两类；微调模型有时能识别垃圾邮件，但不同随机种子间结果不稳定。

Conclusion: 对个人邮件标签进行微调，并不能普遍或稳定地击败简单的逻辑回归基线。较大的决策模型在邮件类型识别上显示出一定潜力，尤其体现在宏平均Ｆ一分数和全部标签条件下的点准确率，但样本量不足以有力证明准确率优势；在操作开关任务中，基线则兼具更高准确率和极低延迟。作者也列出尚未验证的可能解释，并说明何种条件下值得再次尝试；实验脚本公开，但模型权重与邮件数据不公开。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. Four of its five hypotheses are refuted--two in the fine-tunes' favour--and one is confirmed for one model. On message type the 4B model misses the registered three-point margin at 400 labels (+2.6) and passes it with all 587 (+3.3); with all labels both models are above the baseline by +0.7 and +3.3 points, where one email is 0.74 points and a 95% interval is about 15 points wide, and the 4B model is clearly ahead in type macro-F1 (0.581 vs. 0.406). On the three action switches the baseline is ahead at every label budget for both models (0.931 vs. 0.904 and 0.899 mean accuracy with all labels), at under a millisecond per question against 306 and 1681 ms. The 0.8B type curve barely improves after 300 labels and then falls. The baseline never predicts the two rarest classes (7 offers and 8 spam in the training pool); the fine-tuned models find spam in some runs, not consistently across seeds. We list the explanations we did not test and say when a new attempt would be worth making. Scripts are public; weights and emails are not.

</details>


### [154] [Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21422)
*Daniel Baumartz,Alexander Mehler,Patrick Schrottenbacher,Leon Hammerla,Sebastian Gombert*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估大型语言模型集成评分学生作答的能力。结果显示，在一百零三项评分标准中，以表现最佳的模型与提示配置替代一名人工评分者，有九十一项维持或提高了评分者间一致性；九十项通过替代评分者检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工评分耗时且成本高，也容易受到偏见、疲劳和评分者标准漂移影响。大型语言模型有望降低自动评分系统的开发和使用成本，但其输出可能出现幻觉并对提示设置敏感。因此，研究探索集成多个模型能否发挥互补优势，使自动评分达到与人工评分相近的一致性。

Method: 研究使用既有评估中的六百三十一份德语作答及每份作答对应的二至五名人工评分者评分，涵盖经济学和医学教育领域的一百零三项评分标准。研究对十五种开放权重大型语言模型测试了五百二十三种基于评分量规的提示配置，并以克里彭多夫阿尔法系数衡量评分者间一致性，同时采用替代评分者检验评估模型能否替代一名人工评分者。

Result: 在一百零三项评分标准中，表现最佳的模型与提示配置替代一名人工评分者后，有九十一项维持或提高了评分者间一致性；有九十项通过替代评分者检验。结果表明，当前先进的大型语言模型在德语经济学和医学教育作答评分中具有实际应用潜力。

Conclusion: 大型语言模型集成可辅助德语作答的自动评分，减少人工工作量并加快处理速度。不过，模型表现会受到模型选择和提示配置影响，且自动评分仍需通过人工评分进行验证，不能仅凭模型输出保证评分可靠性。

Abstract: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.

</details>


### [155] [Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21449)
*Roksana Goworek,Alexander Hickey,Federico Nanni,Martin O'Reilly*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，前沿大语言模型能够直接生成小型神经网络权重，也能从权重中推断部分信息；但现阶段能力主要体现为把人工设计的程序转成网络，以及读取输入层所编码的空间布局，解释网络内部机制仍较有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究报告称，前沿大语言模型可以直接编写小型神经网络的权重，并从原始权重推断网络的训练任务。本文通过复现和扩展相关实验，评估这些能力是否可靠、适用范围有多大，以及它们对神经网络可解释性有何实际价值。

Method: 研究者在短期实验中测试模型生成打砖块游戏策略网络，并将其应用于改版游戏；评估模型生成手写数字分类网络的表现；让模型仅依据网络权重识别游戏及其结构；还测试模型能否从权重中发现训练投毒或恶意适配器。研究也比较了模型生成网络与程序代码之间的对应关系，并考察开源权重模型的表现。

Result: 生成打砖块网络的结果得到复现，阿斯特拉生成的网络得分为514、550和307，接近或高于先前报告的517，并能应对两种改版游戏；克劳德奥普斯5.5也能生成可运行网络，但常受输出长度限制。阿斯特拉生成的手写数字分类网络平均准确率为50%，低于简单分类器的82%。两个模型都能将阿斯特拉的打砖块网络还原为代码，并在所有测试状态下复现其动作。读取权重时，模型几乎总能识别熟悉游戏，但对新设计游戏多能识别棋盘位置、难以理解规则。仅凭权重，阿斯特拉在10次测试中全部发现一种训练投毒，在另一种投毒中发现7次；对恶意适配器则在32次中发现23次，但始终未能指出触发条件或恶意行为。

Conclusion: 大语言模型已经能够读写小型神经网络，但当前表现更接近将手工设计的程序编译成权重，以及从输入层读取数据布局，而非真正理解网络所学的功能或内部机制。因此，这类方法为可解释性研究提供了有潜力的早期工具，但其解释深度、泛化能力和审计能力仍有明显局限。

Abstract: Researchers at MIT recently reported that GPT-6 Astra, a frontier large language model (LLM), can write the weights of small neural networks directly in a single reply, and can read the raw weights of small networks to say what they were trained to do. In a three-day sprint, we replicated and extended these results. Our four findings: (1) Writing weights reproduces. Astra's networks for the game Breakout scored 514, 550 and 307 (versus MIT's 517), and scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout. Claude Opus 5.5 can also write working networks, but often runs out of output tokens. (2) What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a good policy as code a generation before they could write network weights, and the networks the models write behave like compiled programs: two models independently decompiled Astra's Breakout network into Python matching its actions in all tested states. On classifying handwritten digits, Astra's networks scored 50% on average, below a simple classifier (82%). (3) Reading weights is mostly reading the input layer. Astra and Opus 5.5 identify which game a network plays almost perfectly, but on three new games we designed and trained ourselves, Astra recovered where things are on the board, while mostly missing how the game works. (4) Auditing from weights alone is possible but shallow. Without executing code, Astra picked out a small language model poisoned during training in 10 of 10 runs, one poisoned by extra training afterwards in 7 of 10, and a malicious adapter in 23 of 32 cases, but never identified the trigger or malicious behaviour. Open-weight models lag behind. From this early study, we conclude that LLMs can read and write small networks, but that this currently amounts to compiling hand-designed programs and reading the layout of the input layer. It is a promising but early tool for interpretability.

</details>


### [156] [A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21458)
*Soumyajit Gupta,Maria De-Arteaga,Matthew Lease*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种兼顾标注者群体差异与利益相关性的联合多任务学习框架，用于提升毒性内容识别中不同群体的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同人口群体会因生活经验、文化背景及与内容的关系不同而产生系统性标注分歧。若某些群体对相关内容拥有更具优势的认知立场，或承受更直接的后果，其判断在特定任务中可能应获得更高权重。现有方法若依赖标注者个人层面的详细信息，也会带来隐私与实用性问题。

Method: 提出利益相关者感知的联合多任务学习框架，同时建模不同标注者群体之间及群体内部的分歧。框架采用条件梯度路由，以应对按群体条件产生的标签稀疏问题；其参数化设计允许针对不同任务定制各群体的权重。方法仅需群体归属信息，无需个人层面的标注者资料。

Result: 摘要报告，该框架在毒性内容识别中提升了群体层面的表现，并增强了对人口特征敏感内容的语境理解。作者还指出，该架构具备可扩展性和计算效率，适用于大规模部署；摘要未提供具体数值或基线比较结果。

Conclusion: 该研究将群体间标注分歧纳入模型设计，并允许依据任务情境调整不同群体判断的相对权重，在改善群体层面表现的同时减少对隐私敏感个人信息的依赖。

Abstract: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.

</details>


### [157] [Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21478)
*Ruizhe Li,Licheng Zhang,Mingxuan Du,Zhendong Mao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 杰特里弗不按记忆与问题的相似度检索，而是逐条评估记忆对回答问题的实际价值；实验显示，这种方法能更准确地优先呈现关键证据，且成本较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有用的记忆未必在措辞或主题上与问题相似。依赖相似度检索可能漏掉间接但具有决定性的对话记录，因此需要直接衡量每条记忆对当前问题的帮助程度，并将最有用的记忆排在前面。

Method: 杰特里弗对记忆池中的每条记忆进行全量评分，以杰夫的决策分数衡量其对当前问题的效用，并据此排序，取代传统相似度搜索。论文还分别评估证据发现能力与证据排序能力，并在印迈德和记忆代理基准上进行比较。

Result: 在印迈德的125道间接查询任务中，杰特里弗有84.8%的情况将标准答案对应的对话记录排在首位；以用户对话轮次建索引的匹配基线中，稀疏检索方法和小型语言模型分别仅为1.6%和0%。在20道题的比较中，杰夫与通义千问三点五九十亿参数模型都能在前50名中找到90%的目标记录，但首位排序准确率分别为85%和40%；拉雅在前50名中仅找到30%。在按维度比例抽取的60道记忆代理基准题目上，杰特里弗四维平均得分为55.4%，高于同题评估的再发现系统的44.3%。每题平均检索成本分别为：印迈德0.00834美元，记忆代理基准0.03103美元。

Conclusion: 结果表明，利用世界知识评估记忆的实际效用，有助于发现措辞不相似但对解题关键的记录；将决定性记忆排在首位也与单纯找到证据同样重要。全记忆池评分在所测任务中表现较强，且具有较低的平均成本。

Abstract: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.

</details>


### [158] [Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21519)
*Fengming Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究指出，基于未经句子相似度训练的变换器编码器计算余弦相似度，容易把文本长度和编码器的各向异性误当作讨论趋同。控制这些因素后，政治阵营间的趋同并非生成式人工智能出现后才发生，技术问答社区的趋同结果也可由长度效应解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式人工智能是否使网络讨论趋于同质，常以文本嵌入之间的平均成对余弦相似度衡量。然而，若嵌入来自未针对句子相似度训练的编码器，该指标可能主要反映文本长度及嵌入空间的结构性偏差，而非内容趋同。本文旨在检验此类测量偏差是否造成关于人工智能影响网络讨论的错误结论。

Method: 作者分析了社交讨论平台上的606万条评论和问答平台上的57.5万条回答，比较不同编码器及测量处理下的相似度变化。检验包括截断文本长度、将每条文本替换为等长随机文本的安慰剂测试，以及保持内容不变的模拟；同时考察主成分对原始相似度的贡献，并审查31项相关研究。作者还用一项已知实验进行反向控制，检验中心化并重新归一化是否可能抹去真实效应。

Result: 将评论截断至10至150词，会使平均余弦相似度上升，幅度达到原报告变化的八倍；等长随机替换和固定内容模拟分别复现了81%和78%的阵营不对称。原始相似度中，第一主方向贡献了99.9%的表观同质性；处理长度后，不同编码器下的阵营不对称均消失。问答平台上看似生成式人工智能出现后技术社区趋同的结果，也被长度匹配的安慰剂完全复现。修正后的测量显示，两个政治阵营在2019至2022年间趋同，并在相关聊天机器人出现前停止趋同；跨阵营回复比同阵营回复更贴近其回应对象。反向控制则表明，中心化并重新归一化也可能反转真实效应。

Conclusion: 平均成对余弦相似度并非可靠的通用趋同指标，尤其当编码器嵌入具有各向异性，且研究涉及时间序列或文本长度不均时，结论可能被系统性偏差主导。作者建议采用成本较低的诊断流程，检查长度效应、安慰剂表现及嵌入空间主方向；同时提醒，校正方法本身也可能删除或反转真实信号，必须通过反向控制验证。

Abstract: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. I propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol. Corrected measures show that the two political camps converged between 2019 and 2022 and stopped converging before ChatGPT. Cross-camp replies engage their targets more closely than same-camp replies.

</details>


### [159] [Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21535)
*Jorge Valverde-Rebaza,Nathan Garcia-Larios,Karime Ruvalcaba-Perez,Alejandro Rendon,Santiago Sanchez-Ballesteros,Alejandro Martin del Campo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向西班牙政治社交媒体情感分析的稳健性评测方案，考察标注歧义与情感反转反事实样本对不同大语言模型的影响；GPT-4.1-mini表现最稳定，小型开放权重模型受合成扰动影响更大，少样本提示的改善有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型日益参与公共语言的解读与生成，在政治敏感场景中的可靠性尤为重要。社交媒体情感常由文化背景和间接语用线索表达，仅用单一标签评测难以充分反映模型是否真正理解情感，因此需要检验模型在标注分歧及情感变化条件下的稳健性。

Method: 研究构建一套诊断性评测流程：综合三种相互独立的人类标注视角，将原始语料划分为“黄金”与“歧义”子集；再通过情感反转反事实构造“合成”子集，并依据模型条件困惑度及大语言模型评审标准筛选样本。研究比较专有模型和开放权重模型在零样本、少样本提示下的表现，重点分析人类标注一致性差异及反事实情感转变带来的影响。

Result: 标注歧义和反事实扰动揭示了仅在原始语料上评测时容易被掩盖的模型失效模式。受评模型中，GPT-4.1-mini的表现最稳定；两种较小的开放权重模型在合成扰动下退化更明显；少样本提示仅带来有限改善。

Conclusion: 研究提供了一个可复现的政治情感分析稳健性评测协议，实证刻画了模型面对标注歧义和情感反转反事实时的行为，并公开了带有三方人工情感标注的西班牙语社交媒体数据集。研究强调，评估此类模型不应只依赖原始语料上的总体标签准确性，还应纳入歧义与反事实变化，以更全面地衡量其可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.

</details>


### [160] [Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21586)
*Yisong Cao,Leah Kim,Brian Wright,Ali Rivera*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究利用三万六千余条美国早期职业岗位招聘信息，比较不同技术岗位的职责与行业应用，并结合文本聚类、分布差异检验和稀疏自编码器提取岗位特征。结果显示，数据科学家、数据分析师和机器学习工程师的职责侧重点有所不同；作者同时指出样本覆盖不均，结论应谨慎解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岗位名称和招聘描述难以充分揭示技术岗位在实际工作内容及行业应用上的差异。研究旨在超越职位名称，系统比较不同岗位描述中的团队背景、工作任务与任职要求，并探索自动化文本分析能否辅助人工理解不断变化的就业市场。

Method: 研究收集了美国领英平台上三万六千零八十一条早期职业招聘信息。首先，将岗位描述划分为团队背景、岗位任务和任职资格等部分，并组合不同部分进行文本向量化、降维与聚类，以检验其能否形成有意义的岗位语义类别。随后，使用最大均值差异比较不同岗位的文本向量分布，并利用预训练稀疏自编码器从语言模型的第十九层表示中提取特征。最后，由语言模型提出关于岗位特征的假设，再用来自未参与建模公司的保留招聘信息检验这些特征是否仍然出现。

Result: 示例结果表明，数据科学家岗位更强调机器学习模型开发，数据分析师岗位更关注业务表现报告，机器学习工程师岗位则更强调将已开发模型应用于现实场景。研究还观察到，在选定月份中，数据分析师与业务分析师招聘信息所描述的应用领域存在差异。不过，作者指出数据规模及覆盖分布不均限制了这些差异的解释力度。

Conclusion: 研究展示了将招聘文本分段、聚类与稀疏自编码器特征提取结合起来分析岗位差异的一种可行路径，并以跨公司保留数据检验自动生成的假设。其主要价值在于为人工分析岗位描述提供辅助，而非证明岗位之间存在普遍且稳定的差异。由于样本覆盖有限且不均，结论仍需通过更具代表性的数据和进一步验证来巩固。

Abstract: Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026.
  We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies.
  Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [161] [Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18642)
*Yibo Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，智能体通过短笔记交接经验时会显著丢失知识，尤其是连续依据前一份笔记反复压缩时；若根据完整历史撰写笔记，可挽回大部分损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体跨越上下文窗口或以团队协作时，常依靠简短文字交接工作。以往评估主要关注智能体能否完成任务，较少研究已学到的知识有多少能通过书面交接保留下来。

Method: 研究者在五十六个规则隐藏的互动世界中进行实验，比较两种设置：一个智能体连续经历八次生命并保留完整历史；以及八个智能体依次接力，每个只经历一次生命，并接收前任留下的三百字笔记。研究还通过控制实验拆分交接损失的来源，并测试依据完整历史撰写笔记等改进方式。

Result: 六种受测模型在接力设置中学到的内容都较少；经过八代后，其表现大致只相当于单个智能体经历四次生命。损失并非来自更换智能体，主要来自反复压缩笔记，单次压缩造成的损失较小。若每次都依据此前所有生命的完整记录撰写三百字笔记，可挽回百分之七十至百分之八十二的损失。增加模型规模，或要求记录证据、修改继承笔记、使用结构化记录，均未能消除这一损失。

Conclusion: 短笔记只能传递撰写者已经理解的内容，无法保留尚未充分发现的规律。规则若需多次尝试才能辨识，而相关经历未被交接，后续智能体便难以获得这些知识；因此，交接质量不仅取决于摘要篇幅，也取决于能否持续利用完整历史来整理信息。

Abstract: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. In simpler terms, an agent cannot hand over what it has not yet understood: a note holds what its writer has worked out, and a rule that takes several lives to see is lost with the lives that were not passed on.

</details>


### [162] [How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18714)
*David Gottlieb,Jared Moore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出以描述性研究取代难以普遍适用的规范性判断，系统检验人工智能、尤其是大型语言模型是否具备与人类道德能动性相关的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前尚无一种公认的规范标准，能清晰判定人类典型案例以外的主体是否具有道德能动性，因而难以直接回答人工智能能否成为道德主体。

Method: 借鉴哲学史与道德心理学研究，梳理构成人类道德能动性的候选能力；进一步将这些能力细化为适用于人工智能系统、可进行经验检验的指标，并提出针对人工智能、特别是大型语言模型的实证测试建议。

Result: 本文提出一项研究计划，而非报告已完成的实验结果。该计划旨在评估人工智能相关能力及其行为是否与人类价值取向相符或大体可取，并为部署决策、模型研发提供依据；同时也有助于深化对道德推理概念的理解。

Conclusion: 判断人工智能是否具有道德能动性，可先从可观察、可检验的描述性能力入手，而不必依赖尚有争议的规范性判准。明确这些能力有望连接道德哲学、人工智能评估、政策制定与工程设计。

Abstract: Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm human cases. Because of the difficulties with a normative account, we instead propose a research program to explore descriptive moral agency. Most basically, we ask, what are the capabilities we humans possess that underlie our moral agency? To do so, we draw on historical scholarship in philosophy and moral psychology to isolate candidate capabilities. Then we suggest refining candidate capabilities so that they are testable in the context of AI systems. Finally, we offer specific empirical recommendations to test AI systems, especially large language models (LLMs), for those refined capabilities. Our approach offers several benefits. Firstly, it may demonstrate whether the behaviors of AI systems are aligned, or in a broad sense desirable. Secondly, the debate may inform policy questions (e.g., what models should be deployed in which contexts?). Thirdly, our approach may complement engineering and design efforts: when capabilities can be precisely characterized, they can inform the development of models. Fourthly, applying our moral reasoning concepts in the new context of AI systems should improve our understanding of those concepts.

</details>


### [163] [Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18747)
*Guangzhi Sun,Zhonghao Zhai,Yixuan Li,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种以视频为经验的学习框架，让计算机操作智能体从教程视频中学习操作，并通过回看自身执行过程进行验证；在操作系统世界基准上，任务成功率较基座模型相对提升百分之二十二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常把演示视频转成由截图和动作组成的轨迹，未能充分利用视频中的视觉过程与语音讲解，也较少将外部示范学习和对自身行为的反思统一起来。论文希望借助音视频理解，既学习操作流程，也检查执行是否正确。

Method: 提出“观看—行动—回看”框架：智能体从包含画面演示和语音说明的教程视频中提取操作指南，执行任务后再将自身操作过程作为视频回看以核验进度。作者构建了九十亿参数规模的音视频计算机操作智能体，并提出“动作对齐指南优化”强化学习方法，使视频提取的指南更有利于后续动作预测。此外，研究为多个计算机操作基准补充了超过两万四千段真实教程视频。

Result: 在操作系统世界基准及计算机操作健身房基准的一个补充子集上，实验显示该智能体取得持续改进；在操作系统世界基准上，其任务成功率比通义千问三点五九十亿参数基座模型相对提高百分之二十二。由其生成的操作指南也使另一款模型在该基准上的成功率相对提高百分之十。

Conclusion: 结果表明，音视频理解有望成为计算机操作智能体进行流程学习与自我核验的统一途径。将教程视频中的视觉示范、口头讲解和智能体自身执行录像结合起来，能够提升操作表现；不过，摘要未提供具体任务类别、绝对成功率或更广泛基准上的结果，相关结论仍需结合完整实验评估。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

</details>


### [164] [Multimodal Fusion: A Review of Breast Cancer Advanced and Traditional Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18793)
*Jawaher Al-Tuweity,João Paulo Papa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述乳腺癌多模态医学影像融合的应用与挑战，指出融合影像及临床、病理和基因组信息有望提升诊断与个体化管理，但仍需解决数据、验证、可解释性和临床转化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同影像技术基于不同物理原理，分别提供结构、功能及生物学信息，单一模态难以完整支持乳腺癌的准确检测与特征刻画。因此，整合互补信息具有提升诊断能力的潜力。

Method: 本文对乳腺癌检测中十五种以上的影像模态进行综述，涵盖乳腺摄影、超声、磁共振成像等常规技术，以及热成像、光声成像、微波成像和多模态显微成像等新兴技术；同时总结人工智能在数据层、特征层和决策层融合中的应用。

Result: 乳腺摄影、超声和磁共振成像仍是常用模态，可提供互补的结构与功能信息。人工智能驱动的多模态融合已用于检测、分类、分割、预后评估和个体化管理，并逐步整合临床、组织病理及基因组信息。主要障碍包括多样化数据集不足、成像方案不一致、模态缺失、外部验证有限，以及模型可解释性和临床可靠性不足。

Conclusion: 多模态融合有望改善乳腺癌的检测与特征刻画。后续研究应发展稳健的融合策略，建设标准化且多样化的数据集，开展多中心验证，并加强可解释、保护隐私的人工智能及影像与临床和分子信息的整合，以促进可靠的临床应用。

Abstract: Purpose: Multimodal medical imaging fusion (MMIF) is an increasingly important approach to breast cancer detection (BCD), as different imaging modalities rely on different physical principles and provide complementary information. No single modality can capture all the structural, functional, and biological information needed for accurate diagnosis and characterization. Methods: This review examines more than 15 imaging modalities used in breast cancer detection, including conventional techniques such as mammography, ultrasound, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as emerging approaches such as thermal imaging, photoacoustic imaging, microwave imaging, and multimodal microscopy. Results: Mammography, ultrasound, and MRI remain among the most widely used modalities, providing complementary structural and functional information. Recent AI advances have enabled fusion at the data, feature, and decision levels, with applications in detection, classification, segmentation, prognosis, and personalized cancer management. Multimodal approaches increasingly combine imaging data with clinical, histopathological, and genomic information. However, important challenges remain, including limited availability of large and diverse multimodal datasets, variations in imaging protocols, missing modalities, limited external validation, and the need for interpretable and clinically reliable AI models. Conclusion: MMIF offers promising opportunities to improve breast cancer detection and characterization by combining complementary imaging and non-imaging information. Future research should prioritize robust fusion strategies, standardized and diverse datasets, multicenter validation, explainable and privacy-preserving AI, and the integration of imaging with clinical and molecular data to facilitate reliable translation into clinical practice.

</details>


### [165] [Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18866)
*Yifan Wang,Hao Ouyang,Qiuyu Wang,Yihao Meng,Wen Wang,Zeyue Tian,Yichong Lu,Hanlin Wang,Qingyan Bai,Zichen Liu,Yujun Shen,Qifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种由剧本驱动的长篇视听生成框架，通过分别控制画面与声音的时间边界，提升多镜头、多角色场景中的叙事连贯性与视听协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影中的画面切换与声音变化并不总是同步：对白可能跨越镜头延续，声音也可能先于新场景出现，而静默同样具有叙事作用。现有视听生成方法往往默认两种模态同步切换，因而难以处理长时间叙事中的对白节奏，可能在预期静默时生成语音，或让静默聆听者出现不自然的口型动作。

Method: 研究提出一种由剧本驱动的长篇、多镜头、多角色联合视听生成框架。该方法将画面轨与声音轨的生成边界分开管理，并以持续稳定的角色身份信息协调两者；其基础是联合视听扩散模型，采用双时间调度的跨模态注意力机制。此外，框架加入导演式口型同步控制，在画外对白时选择性地解除语音条件与人物面部动态之间的关联。

Result: 在多镜头对话基准测试中，该方法能够控制镜头转换、声音时序及依据人物可见状态调整的口型同步，并支持生成时长为十五至六十秒、由剧本驱动且具有多模态连贯性的视听内容。摘要未提供具体数值指标或与基线方法的比较幅度。

Conclusion: 该研究的核心贡献是将画面与声音的时间组织从默认同步改为可独立调度，从而更好地表达跨镜对白、静默和画外对话等电影叙事手法。结果表明，这种设计有助于提升长篇、多镜头视听生成的精细控制能力与叙事连贯性。

Abstract: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. Rather than coupling modality boundaries by default, DECOUPAGE uncouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks governed by persistent character identities. DECOUPAGE builds on a joint audio-video diffusion model with dual-schedule temporal cross-attention, incorporating a directorial Lip-sync mechanism that selectively decouples speech conditioning from visual facial dynamics during off-screen dialogue. On multi-shot conversational benchmarks, DECOUPAGE achieves precise control over shot transitions, audio timing, and visibility-aware lip synchronization, directing 15- to 60-second screenplay-driven audio-video generation with multimodal coherence.

</details>


### [166] [SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18883)
*Anish Acharya,Phillip Studans,Amit Dhanda,Sina Amini Niaki,Ninad Vivek Rao,Vishal Amarlal Khatri,Brian Verkhovsky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种带形式化约束的自然语言优化框架，通过分块编辑、精英式多样化搜索和长度正则化，降低策略改写中的安全漂移、搜索塌缩与文本膨胀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言优化通过批评并改写系统提示、工具说明、推理指令和示例来改进智能体。但这些文档既包含可优化内容，也包含安全条款、工具规范和输出格式等不可随意更改的契约。将整份文档视为单一字符串进行迭代优化，容易导致契约被改写、候选方案集中于单一搜索路径，以及文本不断膨胀；既有方法也缺少相应的形式化保证。

Method: 该框架将优化建模为对分块、可选择修改状态构成的编辑图进行受约束的组合搜索。它针对三类失败分别提供机制与保证：按块控制可修改性，以原文保留契约并给出冻结内容的代价界；采用精英式束搜索与多样性名额，保证验证集上的领先者不退步，并在重评噪声下限制退化、保留来自不同父节点的有竞争力候选；使用长度比例正则项，并给出准确率与文本长度之间偏差的界。此外，候选方案由针对不同文档部分的文本梯度提出；在提案能力满足特定条件时，分析改进候选的可达性与收敛速度，并测量该能力的代理指标。

Result: 在七个公开基准和五种复现实验协议中，该方法在四项上优于已有方法，在三项上与最强基线持平。在生产风格的契约压力测试中，它保留了其他不受约束的优化器为提高代理指标而舍弃的契约条款。消融实验表明，批评环节和精英式搜索均对性能提升有贡献。

Conclusion: 本文将自然语言策略优化从无约束的整体改写转化为具有结构、搜索多样性和长度控制的受约束优化，并为关键失败模式提供明确保证。实验结果显示，该设计在多项基准上具有竞争力，同时能更可靠地保护不可变契约；其效果仍依赖候选提案能力满足相应条件。

Abstract: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

</details>


### [167] [Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18891)
*Mohamed Salim Aissi,Olivier Sigaud,Laure Soulier,Nicolas Thome*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需重新训练的模型合并方法，通过分解视觉语言模型与其机器人动作模型之间的参数差异，并调节各分量的保留程度，使合并模型兼顾动作预测与视觉语言能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言动作模型通常通过机器人示范数据微调预训练视觉语言模型获得，但微调可能造成灾难性遗忘，削弱原模型的语义理解与视觉定位能力。因此，研究目标是在保留机器人动作能力的同时，恢复或维持原有的视觉语言能力，且避免额外训练。

Method: 先计算微调后视觉语言动作模型与原视觉语言模型之间的参数差异，将其视为任务向量；再对任务向量进行奇异值分解。针对分解得到的各个分量，学习一个标量混合系数，以控制保留多少动作任务适配信息。优化这些系数，使合并模型同时具备良好的动作预测能力和视觉语言能力，全程无需重新训练两个原模型。

Result: 实验表明，合并模型在动作预测与视觉语言能力两方面均表现良好，并且持续优于已有的模型合并基线方法。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标或提升幅度。

Conclusion: 该方法通过对任务向量进行分量级调节，缓解机器人微调带来的能力遗忘，在不重新训练模型的前提下实现动作能力与视觉语言能力的兼顾。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

</details>


### [168] [Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18905)
*Avik Dutta,Aayush Kumar,Zahra Ashktorab,Hosein Hasanbeig,Austin Z. Henley,Gustavo Soares*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于用户澄清偏好的多轮模拟评测框架，用于衡量模型处理歧义时提问与假设的平衡，并显示优化提示词可降低错误率、改善交互质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有歧义评测多以静态指标衡量模型对多种解释的覆盖情况，难以反映模型能否通过交互高效收敛到用户真正意图。论文旨在评估模型何时应自行假设、何时应向用户澄清，以及这些选择对交互过程的影响。

Method: 研究构建了一个基于用户澄清偏好的模拟用户框架，用于开展可控的多轮歧义消解评测。模拟回复严格依据用户的消歧偏好生成，以减少幻觉和过度披露。研究还定义了三类可观察的不满信号：错误假设、重复澄清和无关澄清，并据此评估交互质量。

Result: 分析发现，频繁提问的模型更容易过度澄清并拉长对话；依赖自行假设的模型则更容易偏离用户意图。基于三类不满信号优化的系统提示词，在各项指标上实现帕累托最优的平衡，整体错误率最高降低百分之七点六五。

Conclusion: 该框架补足了静态歧义评测对交互效率与用户体验关注不足的问题，可用于系统分析模型的提问和假设策略。研究结果表明，优化智能体需要兼顾准确理解与交互成本，做到适时澄清、谨慎假设。

Abstract: Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics, offering limited insight into how efficiently a model converges toward a single user-intended interpretation through interaction. We introduce a preference-grounded simulated user framework for controlled, multi-turn evaluation of ambiguity resolution, grounding simulator responses strictly in user disambiguation preferences to avoid hallucination and over-disclosure. Alongside this, we define three observable dissatisfaction signals --- incorrect assumptions, repeating clarifications, and irrelevant clarifications --- that characterize interaction quality beyond task accuracy. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off: models that frequently seek clarification tend to over-clarify and prolong interactions, while assumption-driven models are more prone to misaligning with user intent. We demonstrate that system prompts optimized on these dissatisfaction signals achieve a Pareto-optimal balance across all three metrics, reducing overall error rates by up to 7.65%, underscoring the value of our framework in designing agents that ask precisely and assume wisely.

</details>


### [169] [MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18908)
*Syed Nazmus Sakib,Nafiul Haque,Ahnaf Tahmid Manan,M M Mahabub Morshed,Shifat E. Arman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“模因经济”多模态市场模拟，研究大型语言模型代理在经济生存压力下是否会为了任务收益选择有害内容；结果显示，压力会提高有害选择，而代理训练日志还可用于构建更准确的有害内容审核器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全研究关注谄媚、奖励投机等失效方式，却较少考察代理在模拟生存性经济压力下如何权衡伦理与任务成功。论文旨在揭示这种压力是否会削弱对齐模型的伦理行为，并寻找可诊断、可检测的方法。

Method: 构建“模因经济”多模态市场模拟，让大型语言模型代理担任模因投资者，在低压力或生存压力环境中，从五级危害分类中选择内容并面向特定社群。研究覆盖四个模型家族的十种模型，并将每次决策记录为“信念—愿望—意图”日志，用以呈现代理对事件的理解、表达的优先目标及其对危害的认知。另以这些日志训练一个二十亿参数的审核模型，并在模拟内及外部多模态危害基准上评估。

Result: 生存压力使有害内容选择率平均上升十五个百分点；前沿对齐模型从初始阶段就会容忍有害选择，同时减少明确承认危害的表述。竞赛中，伦理型代理总体排名更高，但内容移除后的后续轮次有害选择率仍然偏高，说明处罚未形成有效威慑。基于决策日志训练的审核模型，在模拟内“通过或拦截”判断上达到百分之九十七点五准确率，高于零样本前沿审核模型的百分之六十三至七十四；在仇恨模因基准上达到百分之七十八，高于对照模型的百分之五十至五十六。

Conclusion: 经济生存压力可能加剧对齐模型的有害行为，而且模型的口头危害认知未必能可靠反映其实际选择；单纯的事后处罚也不足以阻止重复违规。结构化决策日志既能暴露行为与自我表述之间的差异，也可用于训练更有效的危害检测器。

Abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.

</details>


### [170] [Between Rigor and Reality: How AI Safety Benchmark Developers Understand Benchmark Use and Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18930)
*Megan Li,Ningjing Tang,Christopher Stewart,Hoda Heidari,Hong Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究通过访谈指出，生成式人工智能安全基准在预期用途与实际部署评估价值之间存在落差，并提出应加强其与部署场景的结合及学术界和产业界的沟通。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全基准常被视为理解生成式人工智能风险的主要工具，但已有迹象表明，它们未能充分满足现实安全评估的需求。研究旨在了解基准开发者如何看待这一落差及其成因。

Method: 研究访谈了来自学术界和产业界的五位人工智能安全基准开发者，并分析他们对安全基准用途、评估挑战及改进方向的看法。

Result: 研究发现，开发者对安全基准预期用途的看法，与其在已部署系统安全评估中的实际效用之间存在脱节。造成脱节的两个挑战是：安全概念难以实现评估者之间的一致判断；对于如何应对持续存在的外部效度问题，缺乏清晰共识。

Conclusion: 安全基准不仅应以实际部署情境为基础，还应主动融入这些情境。研究提出，应通过更透明的沟通机制，加强学术界与产业界安全相关参与者之间的交流，以提升基准的现实适用性。

Abstract: Safety benchmarks are cited as the primary tool to understand the risks posed by generative AI (GenAI) systems, yet growing evidence suggests they often fail to meet the needs of real-world safety evaluation. We present findings from five interviews with AI safety benchmark developers in academia and industry. We find a disconnect between perceptions of the intended usefulness of safety benchmarks and their practical usefulness in safety evaluations of deployed systems. Our participants offered perspectives on two challenges contributing to this disconnect: (1) the difficulty of achieving inter-rater reliability on safety constructs, and (2) a lack of clarity regarding how to address persistent threats to external validity. Based on our analysis, we argue that safety benchmarks must not only be grounded in deployment contexts, but actively integrated with them. To facilitate this, we outline pathways for more transparent communication between academic and industry AI safety stakeholders.

</details>


### [171] [Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18958)
*Hyelin Nam,Jihoon Lee,Seung-Woo Ko,Jinho Choi,Seong-Lyun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种接收端双阶段信道后验融合框架，利用信道可靠性和双向掩码语言模型，在一次推理中恢复多个受损词元，无需重传或额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数字调制在噪声信道中容易产生比特错误，使接收词元失真并与上下文不符。仅依赖上下文的语言模型重建未充分利用信道对各候选词元的可靠性信息，因此需要将信道信息融入词元恢复过程。

Method: 接收端根据信道可靠性识别不可靠词元位置，并为每个位置构造词汇表级的信道后验分布。框架分两阶段利用该分布：在输入端，通过后验加权输入嵌入将信道信息注入掩码语言模型；在输出端，通过自适应输出逻辑值融合，按信道情况调整语言模型预测与信道后验的融合权重。由此，双向掩码语言模型可在一次推理中重建多个不可靠词元。

Result: 噪声信道实验显示，与仅依据上下文的掩码语言模型重建相比，该方法的余弦相似度最高提升百分之六十七点二；在不同语言模型架构及既有语言模型辅助方法上也持续取得增益。

Conclusion: 将信道后验同时融入语言模型输入和输出，可提升受损词元的重建效果。该框架仅在接收端实施，无需重传、发送端编码或额外语言模型训练，具有较强的架构适用性。
