Within ML, the advertised role separates interpersonal profiles more sharply than any other dimension, including the contrast with SE.

</details>


### [337] [Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18916)
*Dingyang Chen,Jinfeng Xiao,Zhenyu Zhang,William Hu,Ziyu Wang,Yang Liu,Shirley Zhang,Yuan Ling,Xinyang Shen,Qi Zhang,Peijie Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需标签的自我蒸馏方法：让模型先解决较容易的关联问题，再把这些问题的解题过程用于训练原问题的推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我蒸馏通常借助标准答案增强教师模型，但这需要标签。用模型对同一难题的多次作答投票作为替代，在困难问题上容易因答案分歧而失效，且多数答案也可能错误。论文希望找到一种不依赖标签、又能避开直接处理难题时不可靠性的训练方式。

Method: 模型为原问题生成若干较容易的关联问题作为“垫脚石”，并保留自己能够稳定解答的问题。训练时，教师模型看到这些问题及其解题过程，但看不到最终答案；学生模型只看到原始问题。整个过程不读取标准答案，推理时也不需要额外上下文或模型调用。

Result: 在五个数学基准测试中，该方法使两种规模的模型在思考模式下取得最高平均准确率。在非思考模式下，较小和较大模型的准确率分别提升13.2和22.7个百分点，增益分别达到使用标准解答进行自我蒸馏方法的2.5倍和2.7倍。

Conclusion: 实验表明，无标签自我蒸馏不必依赖对难题答案进行投票。通过转而利用模型能够稳定解决的相关易题及其解题过程，可以有效提升数学推理表现，尤其对非思考模式下的模型帮助显著。

Abstract: Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.

</details>


### [338] [OverclusterDRG: a Deterministic, LP-Free Heuristic for Robust $k$-Center](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18931)
*Rudra Bhardwaj,Rajni Dabas,Neelima Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种确定性、无需线性规划的鲁棒中心聚类启发式算法，通过增加候选中心并结合贪心初始化与局部搜索，兼顾聚类质量和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统中心聚类的最小最大目标容易受离群点影响，因此鲁棒中心聚类允许排除一定数量的离群点。然而，现有方法面临线性规划求解扩展性差、组合算法计算昂贵，以及随机算法需要大量试验才能保证成功等问题。

Method: 算法利用最远点过采样的理论思路，在中心候选集合中额外加入与离群点数量相同的候选点，以吸收离群点；随后采用前向贪心策略初始化，并通过一换局部搜索改进解。该方法不依赖线性规划，也不需要猜测子集或使用指数级试验倍数。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上的评估显示，该算法在成人数据集上相对于分数线性规划下界的平均近似比为1.147，聚类质量和运行速度均优于所比较的先进基线。算法可扩展至十万个点，而线性规划求解器和理论算法在此规模下难以处理。

Conclusion: 该方法表明，结合最远点过采样、贪心构造和局部搜索，可以在不求解线性规划的情况下获得高质量且可扩展的鲁棒中心聚类结果。其在大规模数据上的效率优势，使其成为现有精确或理论方法的实用替代方案。

Abstract: The $k$-center problem is a fundamental formulation for metric clustering. However, its min-max objective is highly sensitive to outliers, motivating the Robust $k$-Center (R$k$C) formulation which permits excluding up to $z$ points as outliers.
  Existing algorithms for R$k$C suffer from scalability issues: LP rounding relies on fractional relaxations that scale poorly, known combinatorial approximation algorithms are computationally expensive due to radius guessing, and scalable randomized heuristics require exponential trial multipliers to guarantee success.
  We present OverclusterDRG, a deterministic, LP-free heuristic for R$k$C. The algorithm leverages the theoretical insight of farthest-point oversampling -- adding exactly $z$ extra candidates to the center set to absorb outliers -- followed by a forward-greedy initialization and a $1$-swap local search. Evaluations across real-world datasets show that OverclusterDRG attains a mean approximation ratio of 1.147 against fractional LP lower bounds on the UCI Adult dataset, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both clustering quality and speed. By avoiding subset-guessing and exponential trial multipliers, it scales smoothly to $n=10^5$ points where LP solvers and theoretical algorithms become intractable.

</details>


### [339] [Geometrically Disentangling Concept Learning from the Language Modeling Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18933)
*Yupei Wang,Neil Mallinar,Mikhail Belkin,Alex Warstadt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“概念能量”指标，追踪预训练过程中下一词预测损失如何参与不同概念的形成，发现仅看探针可解码性不足以揭示概念学习的动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型仅通过下一词预测，就能习得大量概念与能力；但这一统一训练目标如何在预训练的不同时期影响不同概念，尚不清楚。单看探针表现也难以说明损失函数何时、以何种方式参与概念学习。

Method: 提出“概念能量”指标，用于衡量概念所在的表示子空间与平均梯度外积之间的对齐程度。前者刻画概念当前存在于模型表示的何处，后者刻画损失对哪些方向最敏感。研究在两种规模的模型的十九个训练检查点上，分析了十二种词汇、句法和语义概念。

Result: 多数概念的概念能量首次达到峰值的时间，不晚于探针可解码性增长最快的时期。与通常随训练单调上升的探针表现不同，概念能量并非只有单一峰值：部分概念在预训练期间持续受到训练目标作用，或多次出现作用高峰。

Conclusion: 下一词预测损失可能通过多种方式、在多个阶段参与概念学习。概念能量补充了探针表现所提供的信息，有助于揭示训练过程中概念与损失函数之间不断变化的关系。

Abstract: Language models acquire a vast array of concepts and abilities from next-token prediction alone. We introduce an interpretability framework that exposes how this single loss relates to the development of different concepts at different points during pretraining. We propose Concept Energy, a measure of the concept-specific alignment between a concept subspace and the average gradient outer product (AGOP) of the next-token-prediction loss. The concept subspace captures where the concept currently lives in the model's representation; AGOP captures the directions to which the loss is most sensitive. Across 19 checkpoints of Pythia-410M and -1B and 12 lexical, syntactic, and semantic concepts, we find that the first peak in Concept Energy generally occurs at or before the steepest increase in probe decodability. Furthermore, whereas probe performance usually increases monotonically throughout training, Concept Energy is not confined to a single peak; some concepts exhibit sustained or repeated engagement across pretraining, suggesting that concept learning may require continual reinforcement or occur at multiple points. Our results indicate that the loss contributes to concept learning in a myriad of ways that simple probe performance alone cannot reveal.

</details>


### [340] [Contextual Non-Convex Bandit Optimization with Two-Point Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18965)
*Khaled Eldowa,Pierre Gaillard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究每轮选择两个动作、仅观察两者损失差值的非随机上下文赌博机，并利用分层离散化改善非参数策略比较下的遗憾表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在上下文赌博机中，学习者通常只能获得有限的损失反馈；仅观察单个动作的损失会限制可达到的遗憾率。本文关注一种成对反馈设定：学习者观察两个动作的损失差，同时承担两者平均损失。研究目标是与能根据上下文选择动作的通用非参数策略进行比较，并探究这种反馈能否带来更好的学习效率。

Method: 采用分层离散化技术，在不同分辨率下组织候选动作与策略，以适应策略类的非参数结构。该框架适用于利普希茨策略、赫尔德光滑策略等策略类；此外，针对利普希茨策略，提出每轮计算复杂度仅随时间跨度的对数增长的算法。

Result: 相较于单点反馈所能达到的遗憾率，所提方法在若干情形下取得改进；对于足够光滑的策略类或低维问题，甚至能够恢复全信息反馈下的遗憾率。针对利普希茨策略，算法还具有每轮对数级的时间计算复杂度。摘要未给出具体遗憾界或实验数值。

Conclusion: 成对损失差反馈结合分层离散化，能够有效利用策略类的平滑性与问题维度，提升非随机上下文赌博机的学习效率，并在部分情形下达到全信息水平，同时为利普希茨策略提供了计算高效的算法。

Abstract: We study a non-stochastic contextual bandit problem with Lipschitz losses. At every round, the learner observes the context then picks two actions, observes the difference between their losses, and incurs their mean. The aim is to minimize the regret against a generic non-parametric comparator class of policies mapping contexts to actions; for example, Lipschitz policies and Hölder-smooth policies. We show how relying on a hierarchical discretization technique allows us to improve upon the regret rates achievable under one-point feedback, and even recover the full-information rate in some cases; notably, for sufficiently smooth policy classes or low-dimensional instances. Additionally, for Lipschitz policies, we present an algorithm whose per-round computational complexity is only logarithmic in the time horizon.

</details>


### [341] [Bilateral Log-Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18974)
*Kazi Ashik Islam,Guojing Cong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 双向对数线性注意力通过增加一条从序列起点构建的层级分支，改善对早期与近期上下文的细粒度检索，同时保留较低的计算与存储开销；在关联回忆和长上下文检索任务上均优于原有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全注意力虽擅长关联回忆，但训练和预填充计算量呈二次增长，推理时缓存也随序列长度线性增长。线性注意力和状态空间模型使用固定大小记忆，成本较低，却可能因压缩过度而损害回忆能力。对数线性注意力处于两者之间，但其层级更精细地表示近期内容，对早期内容则采用更粗略的摘要，造成上下文分辨率分配不均。

Method: 在原有、偏重近期内容的对数线性层级之外，增加一条以序列起点为锚点的层级分支，并结合两条分支的读取结果，使模型能以较细粒度访问早期和近期上下文，同时保持因果性。作者为新增分支推导了递归式和分块并行实现；在特征维度与分块大小固定时，训练和预填充仍为对数线性工作量，逐词解码和持久状态存储均为对数级。

Result: 在多查询关联回忆任务中，相较于单向对数线性注意力，跨多个训练随机种子的平均总体测试准确率由百分之七十六点三七升至百分之九十六点一二。预训练语言模型在参数量近似匹配、上下文长度为六千一百四十四词元时，六项精选长文本检索测试的平均得分由百分之二十六点九七升至百分之五十点零三；在八项下游检索任务中，有七项表现更好，任务包括问答和信息抽取。

Conclusion: 从序列起点和当前查询方向分别构建层级，可弥补单一层级对早期上下文压缩过强的问题，在保持对数级解码开销和存储需求的同时显著提升关联回忆及长上下文检索表现。摘要所报告的结果显示该设计具有潜力，但其评估范围主要限于所选基准与任务。

Abstract: Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage at fixed feature dimensions and chunk size. In multi-query associative recall, this design raises mean overall test accuracy from 76.37% to 96.12% over forward log-linear attention across multiple training seeds. For pretrained language models under approximate parameter matching, it raises the mean score on six selected RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks from 26.97% to 50.03% at a context length of 6144 tokens. In the same setting, bilateral attention also outperforms forward log-linear attention on seven of eight downstream retrieval tasks, including question answering and information extraction.

</details>


### [342] [Large language models as oncology world models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18994)
*Julien Vibert,Jakob Nikolas Kather*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究系统评估了大语言模型对肿瘤患者特征与病程的内部表征，发现模型能部分遵循生物标志物和治疗逻辑，但对既往治疗及虚弱程度等因素处理较弱；其生存预测偏乐观。研究提出临床状态空间框架，用于表示和评估患者轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能够生成癌症患者病例，但其是否形成了可靠的肿瘤学内部世界模型，尚未得到系统研究。厘清模型生成患者的一致性、临床推理能力及病程预测偏差，是判断其能否用于数字孪生等临床应用的基础。

Method: 研究首先仅指定肿瘤类型，考察模型生成患者的基线特征分布；随后在12种临床情景中系统改变患者特征，评估模型是否遵循相应的生物标志物与治疗逻辑；再让模型续写真实患者病程并预测12个月生存情况，同时比较提供相似患者案例前后的预测。研究还开发了用于动态表示患者轨迹的临床状态空间框架，并将其应用于真实患者。

Result: 同一癌症中，平均有81.0%至93.2%的生成患者在各项基线特征上取值相同，显示病例多样性有限。在36项模型—情景评估中，29项遵循了生物标志物和治疗逻辑；当既往治疗或虚弱程度成为关键因素时，12项评估中仅1项符合相关逻辑。模型预测的12个月生存率为89.9%；提供相似患者作为示例后为79.2%，两者均高于真实观察到的72.2%。

Conclusion: 现有大语言模型对肿瘤学知识的表征并不全面：它们能处理部分生物标志物和治疗关系，却容易生成同质化患者，并在涉及既往治疗、虚弱程度及生存预测时出现不足或偏乐观。更完善的内部世界模型或可支持数字孪生研究；临床状态空间则为表示患者动态轨迹及评估此类模型提供了框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

</details>


### [343] [Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18996)
*Joshua Ryo Cheng,Thomas L. Griffiths,Jake C. Snell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将大语言模型的社会偏见视为潜在先验分布，并通过贝叶斯逆问题从基准问答中的提示与回答反推该分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏见评估通常依据模型对提示的表层回答，并将回答与标准答案比较；这种做法难以揭示支配模型行为的潜在偏见。论文希望从认知科学中的偏见诱发思路出发，重建模型在社会情境中的刻板印象倾向。

Method: 将偏见重建建模为贝叶斯逆问题：给定偏见基准数据集中的提示—回答观测，推断一个低维潜在分布，用以概括模型的刻板印象倾向。论文建立相应的数学基础，并提出实际重建算法，再使用问答偏见基准进行实验。

Result: 实验以问答偏见基准中的社会情境为对象，推断模型在含糊语境下对不同回答的先验分布。摘要未提供具体模型、数值结果或不同模型之间的比较，因此无法判断重建效果的定量表现。

Conclusion: 该研究提出一种超越表层回答打分的偏见分析框架，尝试从观测行为反推出模型内部的低维偏见先验，为刻画模型在模糊社会语境中的刻板印象提供了新的方法。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.

</details>


### [344] [AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19005)
*Jiangze Yan,Yi Shen,Jieyun Huang,Wenjing Zhang,Zhaoxiang Liu,Ning Wang,Kai Wang,Shiguo Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出自适应候选菜单方法：从检索到的标注样例中为每个查询构造紧凑标签菜单，并通过一次决策模型调用完成分类，从而兼顾准确率与输入成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分类标签空间扩大时，将全部标签交给决策模型可能降低准确率、增加输入成本，甚至超出选项数量限制。层级分类虽能缩小每次选择的菜单，却需要串行调用，并可能累积错误。因此，论文希望在减少候选标签数量的同时，避免多轮决策带来的代价。

Method: 该方法先检索与当前查询相关的带标签样例，据此构造随查询变化的候选标签菜单，再让决策模型一次性选出标签。默认设置还会汇总检索分数，据此动态调整菜单大小。方法使用开放式和封闭式决策模型进行评估。

Result: 在最多包含一千零一十六个标签的四组标签集上，与类型安全基线能够共同运行的十六组模型和标签集配置中，该方法的准确率均高出十六点六至三十四点三个百分点。在三个较小标签集上，与提供全部标签的菜单相比，准确率差异介于低零点五至高七点二个百分点之间，而输入词元用量减少至原来的约二十二分之一至三分之一。对于选项限制导致完整菜单无法使用的场景，该方法仍可运行；部分场景下层级基线则不可用。

Conclusion: 实验表明，基于检索构造紧凑且因查询而异的候选菜单，能够显著降低输入成本，并在多种标签空间和模型设置下提升相较于层级搜索基线的准确率。该方法也能适应决策模型的选项数量限制。

Abstract: Decision models such as Jev return probabilities over caller-defined options and are increasingly used for classification. Large label spaces challenge both accuracy and scalability: larger menus can impair decisions, increase input costs, and exceed option limits. Hierarchical classification reduces menu size but introduces serial calls and error propagation. We propose AdaMenu, which builds a compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples and makes a single decision-model request. Its candidate labels adapt to the query, and its default setting also adjusts menu size using aggregated retrieval scores. We evaluate AdaMenu with open and closed decision models on four label sets containing up to 1,016 labels. It outperforms TypeSafe's beam-search baseline on all 16 model and label-set pairs where both methods run, improving accuracy by 16.6-34.3 percentage points. Relative to the full menu on the three smaller label sets, accuracy differences range from -0.5 to +7.2 percentage points, while input token usage falls by factors of 3.2-22.9. AdaMenu also runs when option limits exclude the full menu, including settings where the hierarchical baseline is unavailable.

</details>


### [345] [Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19020)
*Berke Akturk,Ali Can Sahin,Rasit Cem Solatay,Emanuel Sommer,Yawei Li,David Rügamer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种低成本的非对称双模型校准方法：融合大型语言模型与较小辅助模型的分类分数，在基本不影响准确率的前提下改善置信度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的置信度估计对可靠应用至关重要，但现有模型常出现校准不足和过度自信。复杂校准方法可能带来较高计算成本，因此需要兼顾校准效果、预测准确率与效率的方案。

Method: 采用非对称双模型框架，将能力较强的基础模型与较小的辅助模型进行分数空间融合，并在验证集上优化全局缩放参数。该方法还可与其他已有的校准技术结合使用。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，该方法的期望校准误差和负对数似然表现通常排名第一或第二，同时没有降低预测准确率。相较于更复杂的基线方法，它以更低计算成本取得良好效果，位于校准性能与计算开销的帕累托前沿；与其他校准方法结合后，也能进一步提升其表现。分析还显示，非对称融合能够缓解基础模型的过度自信。

Conclusion: 非对称融合的优势能够迁移到大型语言模型分类任务中，为改善不确定性估计提供了一种简单、高效且易于组合的方案。

Abstract: The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration-aware techniques, meaning it can be easily combined with them to consistently boost their performance. Finally, our analysis of the logit-space behavior illustrates how asymmetric fusion successfully mitigates base model overconfidence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the benefits of an asymmetric fusion successfully transfer to the language domain, providing a simple, highly cost-efficient approach to improving uncertainty estimation in LLM classifiers.

</details>


### [346] [HeteroWear: Sensor-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Heterogeneous Wearable Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19027)
*Yasaman Mohammadpour,Pouya Shaeri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出面向异构可穿戴传感器的自监督预训练框架，在跨数据集、跨设备和传感器缺失场景中提升了活动识别性能与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器自监督学习多局限于单一数据集或设备类型，因此尚不清楚学到的表示能否迁移到不同传感器配置，也难以区分性能提升究竟来自预训练、模型结构还是更丰富的传感器输入。

Method: 作者构建了涵盖八个数据集、173名受试者及358261个数据窗口的异构可穿戴信号语料，提出异构可穿戴框架。该方法通过传感器上下文嵌入、时间变换器、跨传感器变换器及潜在交叉注意力融合，分别建模单个传感器的时间特征和传感器间关系；训练时结合结构化传感器丢弃、跨配置一致性学习和逐轴掩码传感器建模。缺失传感器会被直接忽略，而非尝试重建。

Result: 在留一数据集预训练和受试者隔离评估中，该方法的平均宏平均调和指标由相同架构从头训练时的0.688提升至0.724；在一项基准上提升最明显，由0.741升至0.823，并在五项基准中的四项超过单加速度计监督基线。留出设备评估的平均提升为0.066。测试时移除一半传感器通道后，预训练模型保留了完整通道性能的73.8%，高于未使用传感器丢弃训练的同架构模型的64.1%。消融实验表明，结构化传感器丢弃主要增强鲁棒性，跨配置一致性学习与传感器上下文编码则有助于迁移。

Conclusion: 研究表明，面向多种传感器、设备和采样率进行自监督预训练，能够改善可穿戴感知模型的跨数据集与跨设备迁移，并增强其应对传感器缺失的能力。不同训练组件作用各异：传感器丢弃主要提升缺失通道下的稳健性，其他两项机制则促进跨配置迁移。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning for wearable sensing is usually confined to a single dataset or device family, leaving open whether representations transfer across heterogeneous sensor configurations and whether gains come from pretraining rather than architecture or richer sensor input. We present HeteroWear, a sensor-aware self-supervised framework pretrained on an eight-dataset wearable corpus (173 subjects, 358,261 windows) spanning inertial and physiological signals across body locations, devices, and sampling rates. HeteroWear separates within-sensor temporal modeling from cross-sensor relational modeling using sensor-context embeddings, temporal and cross-sensor Transformers, and latent cross-attention fusion. Training combines structured sensor dropout, cross-configuration consistency, and per-axis masked sensor modeling; missing sensors are omitted rather than reconstructed. Under leave-one-dataset-out pretraining and subject-disjoint evaluation on PAMAP2, WISDM, HHAR, HARTH, and UCI-HAR, HeteroWear improves mean macro-F1 from 0.688 to 0.724 over the identical architecture trained from scratch, with the largest gain on HHAR (0.823 versus 0.741), and achieves the highest macro-F1 on four of five benchmarks relative to single-accelerometer supervised baselines. Held-out-device evaluation yields a mean +0.066 macro-F1 improvement. Under 50% test-time channel removal, HeteroWear retains 73.8% of full-channel performance versus 64.1% for the same architecture trained from scratch without sensor dropout. Ablations show that structured sensor dropout primarily drives robustness, while cross-configuration consistency and sensor-context encoding contribute to transfer.

</details>


### [347] [The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19037)
*Gaoyuan Du,Xiaoyang Liu,Rex Zhou,Dengdu Jiang,Rong Fu,Meng Ding,Defu Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文审计了自动化机器学习搜索中批评器反馈的边际影响，发现能力不足或带有方向性错误的批评器可能使结果显著变差；验证门控能降低风险，但不能保证维持无批评器基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常关注批评器能否帮助迭代搜索，却较少检验它是否会造成伤害。论文旨在分离批评器本身的影响，并评估搜索循环对错误反馈的容忍程度。

Method: 研究采用四组对照审计，比较有无批评器等条件下的搜索表现，并通过受控注入错误分析反馈失误的影响。论文还考察更强的批评器、可观测的验证门控及学习式错误检测器，并以理想化有效样本分析推导必要条件；该条件并非可直接部署的能力保证。

Result: 在八个表格数据集中的七个上，一个参数量为八十亿的朴素批评器使搜索结果低于无批评器的随机搜索基线，最差时曲线下面积下降零点二四五。损失大小随数据集、搜索前沿和预算显著变化。受控实验显示，非定向错误在保留当前最佳结果的搜索中代价很小，而带有方向性的错误会消耗有限搜索机会。更强的批评器在所测数据集上减轻了损失，但未证明存在通用的能力门槛；验证门控和学习式检测器也无法保证完全保住基线。

Conclusion: 批评器并非无成本的附加组件，其反馈可能误导并削弱搜索。部署前应审计其影响；当批评器能力不足或反馈无法充分验证时，应设置门控机制。论文还将发布一个用于检测自动化机器学习中有害批评器反馈的基准。

Abstract: LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) > β$, not a deployment certificate. How: a simple observable validation gate and a learned detector can reduce realized loss, but neither is guaranteed to preserve the full-budget no-critic baseline. We will release CRITFAULT, to our knowledge the first benchmark for detecting harmful critic feedback in AutoML. A critic is not a free addition: audit before trusting, and gate when capability or verification is insufficient.

</details>


### [348] [Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19042)
*Jianhao Huang,Allan Zhang,Ali Payani,Baharan Mirzasoleiman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，预训练中原子事实与推理链的合理配比，取决于推理链长度和推理监督覆盖率：链越长，越应加强原子事实训练；未纳入推理链的事实比例越高，原子事实训练的最优权重越低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理训练能让模型学习多步推理，但推理轨迹往往只覆盖可用事实的一部分。因此，预训练需要决定如何在提供单条事实监督的原子事实数据与提供多步过程监督的推理轨迹之间分配训练资源，尤其要提升模型对训练轨迹中从未出现、但曾以原子事实形式观察到的事实转换的泛化能力。

Method: 研究构造了一种可控训练设置：所有事实都提供原子级训练信号，但只有部分事实出现在推理监督中，据此评估模型对仅以原子形式见过、从未纳入训练推理链的转换的误差。研究先在线性变换器中推导使未见转换平方误差最小的原子信号权重，再检验这一规律能否推广至包含多层感知机、软最大注意力和交叉熵损失的完整变换器层；最后在受控多跳推理和数学预训练两种自然语言场景中进行验证。

Result: 理论分析表明，最优原子信号权重在主导阶上随推理链长度增加而增大，随未纳入推理轨迹的事实比例增加而减小。相同趋势也出现在更完整的变换器层中，并在受控多跳推理与数学预训练实验中得到进一步验证。

Conclusion: 原子事实与推理轨迹的训练配比不宜固定，而应依据推理复杂度和数据覆盖情况调整。较长的推理链需要更强的原子事实训练支撑；当推理轨迹覆盖不足时，原子事实训练的最优权重则会相应降低。研究为预训练数据分配提供了关于推理链结构与事实覆盖率的原则性依据。

Abstract: Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data during pretraining.

</details>


### [349] [A Fast Algorithm for the Familywise Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19065)
*Leelavathi Raja,Amirreza Eshraghi,Vinay Prabhakar,Mark Blacher,Han Bao,Yutong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明，多分类的族式损失梯度可在与类别数线性相关的时间内计算，并通过优化实现使其在中央处理器和图形处理器上都比交叉熵更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 族式损失已被证明与零一损失具有普遍等价性，理论性质优于交叉熵；但此前尚不清楚其计算效率是否能与交叉熵相比。论文旨在填补这一理论与实践上的空缺。

Method: 理论上，证明族式损失的梯度可在类别数为Ｋ时用Ｏ（Ｋ）时间计算。实践上，为该损失的前向与反向计算开发优化内核，并在中央处理器和图形处理器上进行速度比较。

Result: 结果表明，族式损失的梯度计算具有线性时间复杂度；所开发的优化内核在中央处理器和图形处理器上均比交叉熵运行更快。

Conclusion: 族式损失不仅具备与零一损失普遍等价的理论优势，也能实现高效计算。该工作说明，采用族式损失无需以计算速度为代价，且在实验所述硬件上可获得优于交叉熵的速度。

Abstract: The familywise (FW) loss for multiclass classification, introduced by Duchi, Ruan, and Khosravi, achieves universal equivalence to the 0-1 loss, and thus has stronger theoretical properties than cross entropy (CE). Prior work, however, left open whether FW is as computationally efficient as CE. First, on the theoretical side, we prove that the FW gradient can be computed in $O(K)$ time, where $K$ is the number of classes. Second, on the practical side, we develop optimized kernels for computing the forward and backward passes of FW which outperform CE in terms of speed on both CPU and GPU.

</details>


### [350] [Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19072)
*Austin H. Cheng,Marcel Müller,Andreas Burger,Yeonghun Kang,Tsz Wai Ko,Marta Skreta,Luka Mucko,Ella Miray Rajaonson,Cher Tian Ser,Jérôme F. Gonthier,Alex Zook,Varinia Bernales,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出统一处理文本与三维分子结构的自回归扩散模型，在十二类化学任务上训练，并报告其在若干基准任务中优于专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用语言模型擅长理解和生成语言，却难以处理大规模三维坐标；专门的三维分子生成模型则缺乏语言所带来的灵活控制能力。论文旨在结合两者优势，使同一模型能够通过文本交互完成多种三维化学任务。

Method: 作者提出名为“纳瓦尔”的仅解码器自回归扩散模型，可处理文本与三维分子构成的序列。其核心方法是“下一词元扩散”：因果变换器在生成某个词元时，对该词元进行去噪，同时关注此前已生成的干净词元；该设计支持连续坐标的自回归生成，且不增加上下文长度。模型使用涵盖十二类三维化学任务的整理数据集进行端到端训练，并配套设置评估指标与基线。

Result: 论文报告，单套模型权重能够同时完成全部十二类任务，并在晶体结构预测和性质条件分子生成方面超过相应的先进专用模型。摘要未提供具体指标、数据规模或统计显著性信息，因此无法据此判断提升幅度。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将自回归建模与扩散去噪结合，有望扩展通用解码器模型，使其原生处理并生成语言和三维化学结构。其主要贡献是提出适用于连续三维坐标的下一词元扩散机制，并展示单一通用模型覆盖多类化学任务的可行性。

Abstract: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at https://github.com/the-matter-lab/nahual.

</details>


### [351] [DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19085)
*Aadi Kulshrestha,Reese Chong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在目标模型隐藏特征上加入逐层动态门控；整体效果与基线相近，但数学任务的平均接受长度提高约百分之五，推测解码吞吐量提高百分之四点一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行草稿模型利用目标模型的隐藏特征生成候选内容。此前研究尝试组合不同层的隐藏状态，本研究进一步探讨：根据上下文动态调整各层特征的权重，能否提升块扩散推测解码的接受长度，尤其是在特定任务领域中。

Method: 研究以块大小为十六的基线模型为参照，训练一个动态模型。该模型为每一层计算门控值，在投影前调节隐藏特征的幅度。评估使用来自两个数学问答数据集的七百条提示，并在其中一部分数据上测试推测解码吞吐量。

Result: 动态模型与基线模型的整体平均接受长度没有显著差异。不过，在数学内容生成中，动态模型表现更好：七百条提示上的平均接受长度提升百分之五；在同一数据子集的推测解码评估中，吞吐量提高百分之四点一。

Conclusion: 逐层动态门控并未带来普遍且显著的接受长度提升，但在数学任务中显示出明确收益，说明按上下文调整目标模型隐藏特征可能具有领域适应价值。其效果是否能推广至其他任务与模型，仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

</details>


### [352] [Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19127)
*Sofian Zalouk,Vincent Counathe,Paul Jünger,Daniel Cao,Daniel Zlotnick,Kilian Q. Weinberger,Christopher De Sa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出留一变换器：通过改进左右上下文交互和训练目标，使扩散语言模型能够修正生成结果，并以更少推理计算获得有竞争力的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准掩码扩散模型有两项局限：生成后难以修订已生成的词元，且训练监督信号稀疏。已有空心变换器通过仅依据当前位置周围上下文预测词元来缓解这些问题，但其上下文融合能力和训练效率仍有提升空间。

Method: 提出留一变换器，改进空心变换器的两方面设计：一是重构左右上下文的合并机制，使两侧信息能够更频繁地交互，从而提升预测能力；二是推导方差更低的掩码扩散模型负证据下界估计量，以全部词元提供监督，改善训练效果。模型在推理时支持自我修正。

Result: 在一项语言建模基准上，留一变换器的验证困惑度与最强的密集监督掩码扩散模型基线相当。在开放网页文本数据集上，相较以往的重新掩码方法，它取得更高的生成分布相似度指标和更好的质量—多样性权衡，同时将前向计算次数减少至原来的八分之一、推理浮点运算量减少至原来的约三分之一点五。

Conclusion: 通过增强上下文交互并降低训练估计方差，留一变换器兼顾了预测性能、密集监督和推理效率，展示了能够在生成过程中自我修正的独立扩散语言模型的潜力。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

</details>


### [353] [How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19135)
*Charan Teja Nagisettygari,Siva Raja Sindiramutty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，零温贪心解码仍可能因批次组成和数值计算扰动而产生不同输出；训练时惩罚前两名词元的分数差，可减少翻转，但会轻微降低准确率，且不能消除硬件扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零温贪心解码通常被认为具有确定性，但实际推理时，同一提示会因批次中其他提示的数量而生成不同词元。现有方案主要在推理阶段处理这一问题，往往需要牺牲吞吐量。论文因此探讨：能否通过训练，减少容易受扰动影响的解码步骤？

Method: 作者在六个模型系列和三种数值精度下实测批次引发的扰动，分析扰动与浮点数可表示精度及张量形状的关系；随后采用铰链惩罚，针对模型前两名输出分数之间的差值进行训练，并将惩罚尺度设为实测噪声分位数的两倍。在八千五百八十道数学题数据集上评估该方法。

Result: 扰动幅度与数值精度严格相关：相比半精度浮点，脑浮点的扰动为其八倍；相比单精度浮点，半精度浮点的扰动为其八千一百九十二倍，符合尾数位数的预测。某些张量形状会偶然实现批次不变性，因此调整序列长度有时即可避免非确定性。铰链惩罚使词元翻转减少百分之三十五，输出分歧率从百分之五十三点八降至百分之三十八点一，但准确率下降一点三至二点九个百分点，且惩罚间隔越大，准确率损失越高。该方法没有改变实现确定性所需的分数差阈值：残余翻转的分数差中位数在所有实验组中均为零点一二五。

Conclusion: 训练时惩罚较小的前两名输出分数差，能够降低模型对数值扰动的敏感性，却无法消除最大硬件扰动，因此只能缓解、不能保证确定性，并需权衡准确率。论文还报告，关于方法适用性的七项假设均被否定，其中基于单个模型判断可行性的诊断在六个模型上成立、在第七个模型上被证伪。

Abstract: Greedy decoding at zero temperature is widely assumed to be deterministic, although the exact same prompt may yield different tokens depending on the number of other prompts sharing the batch for inference. The currently available solutions operate during inference, trading determinism for throughput. Can we train a model in such a way that fewer decoding steps would be susceptible? We characterize the perturbation empirically across six model families and three numerical precisions and observe two empirical facts about the measurement: the perturbation depends exactly on the representable precision (8.00x for bfloat16 vs float16, 8192.0x for float16 vs float32, in line with predictions based on mantissa bits) and the batch invariance happens accidentally at certain tensor shapes, allowing a practitioner to achieve zero nondeterminism merely by setting the sequence length. Then we apply hinge penalization of the model's top-1 / top-2 logit gap, scaled to twice the measured noise quantile. On GSM8K dataset it leads to a 35% reduction in token flips and divergence from 53.8% to 38.1%, at the cost of 1.3 - 2.9 accuracy points, increasing monotonically with the margin size. It does not affect the gap threshold sufficient for determinism: the logit gaps of surviving flips are unchanged (median 0.125 for all arms), as the hinge is a soft penalty and the largest hardware perturbation remains the same. We reject seven hypotheses, including a per-model viability diagnosis, holding on six models and falsified on the seventh.

</details>


### [354] [LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19200)
*Yanjun Fu,Quanzeng You,Jiadong Guo,Yujie Lu,Sai Charitha Akula,Haiping Wu,Miao Liu,Sanghamitra Dutta,Lu Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出全自动监督微调数据生成引擎，通过逻辑链引导图像推理与缩放工具使用，以更少数据和计算资源取得优于既有复杂训练方案的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型虽可借助局部放大工具进行细粒度视觉搜索，但要同时实现严谨推理、准确调用工具和高效操作仍具挑战。论文认为，瓶颈不一定在强化学习方案不够复杂，而在监督微调数据的质量不足。

Method: 提出“逻辑图像思考”数据引擎，自动生成具有挑战性且以视觉证据为基础的问题，以及遵循逻辑链、结构化并体现类人思考过程的工具使用轨迹。研究者使用该数据对两个基础模型进行监督微调，并在其中一个模型上进一步采用不含工具专用设计的简洁强化学习方案。

Result: 在七个基准测试集上的评估显示，基于该数据微调的模型优于已有监督微调与强化学习方法，且训练数据减少约三分之二、图形处理器训练时数减少超过一百二十倍。再经过简洁强化学习后，模型比采用复杂强化学习方案的既有方法高出九点五九分。模型的工具使用准确率与效率也更高，推理轨迹更有条理、逻辑更一致。

Conclusion: 研究表明，提升监督微调数据的质量与逻辑结构，能够有效增强模型的视觉推理和工具使用能力；在此基础上，简单强化学习也可取得强劲效果，无须依赖复杂的工具专用设计。

Abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [355] [On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19207)
*Zane Fu,Yanzhao Zheng,Ziting Qin,Qianshan Wei,Yi Yu,Gongli Xi,Jihuai Zhu,Baohua Dong,Hangcheng Zhu,Ruohui Huang,Gang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，在线策略蒸馏可能将教师模型中的条件后门高效传给学生模型，并提出针对性的缓解训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏日益用于大语言模型后训练，但教师模型中的潜在安全风险是否会随蒸馏传递，尚未得到充分研究。尤其是，若教师模型被植入后门，在线策略蒸馏是否会成为跨模型传播后门的有效途径，需要系统评估。

Method: 研究者先通过监督微调在教师模型中植入条件后门，再考察在线策略蒸馏对学生模型的后门传递，并与传统蒸馏方法比较。机制分析聚焦于教师模型对触发输入与干净输入产生的条件概率差异，以及这些信号如何在训练中逐渐融入学生模型的内部表征。基于此，研究提出一种针对该传播情形、旨在抑制异常条件概率信号的在线策略蒸馏训练方法。

Result: 即使学生模型接触触发提示的比例极低，在线策略蒸馏仍能将教师模型的条件后门传递给学生模型；其传递效果显著强于传统蒸馏。分析表明，关键传播信号主要来自教师模型对触发输入与干净输入给出的异常条件概率差异，并会逐步被学生模型内化。摘要未提供所提缓解方法的具体量化效果。

Conclusion: 在线策略蒸馏不仅能传递教师模型的能力，也可能成为后门传播的高效通道。因此，使用不可信教师监督进行蒸馏时应评估并抑制异常条件概率信号；该研究提出了面向条件后门传播风险的缓解方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. However, whether this process also transfers latent security risks from teacher models to student models remains insufficiently studied. In this work, we reveal a new security risk in which an attacker first implants a conditional backdoor into the teacher model through supervised fine tuning (SFT), after which OPD can transfer the backdoor to the student model with only an extremely small proportion of trigger prompt exposure. More concerningly, we find that such backdoor transfer is substantially stronger under OPD than under conventional distillation methods, suggesting that OPD may provide an efficient channel for propagating backdoors across models. Our mechanistic analysis shows that the backdoor signal is primarily transmitted through anomalous differences in the conditional probabilities produced by the teacher model for triggered and clean inputs, and is gradually internalized into the internal representations of the student model during training. Furthermore, we investigate how to suppress such anomalous conditional probability signals at the source of distillation supervision and, based on this analysis, propose an OPD training method tailored to this conditional backdoor propagation setting to mitigate the risk of backdoor transfer induced by untrusted teacher supervision.

</details>


### [356] [Neural Dual Bounds: Valid-by-Construction JGLP Warm-Starts for MAP and Constrained MAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19218)
*Akshay Vyas,Shivvrat Arya,Brij Malhotra,Tahrima Rahman,Vibhav Gogate,Nicholas Ruozzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出无需校准的神经对偶界框架，通过一次神经网络前向计算生成最大后验推断的确定性上界，并显著改善优化器的初始解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率图模型中的最大后验推断通常依赖迭代优化来获得紧的对偶上界，零初始化在优化早期往往效果较差。本文希望利用神经网络快速生成高质量初始消息，同时避免额外校准步骤。

Method: 在给定的连接图分解上，训练神经网络输出小桶式上界所需的边消息。训练采用自监督方式，直接最小化平滑对偶目标；测试时，将网络输出作为标准连接图循环传播优化器的热启动。框架还用于受约束最大后验估计，并结合测试时自适应。

Result: 在多种基准任务中，神经热启动相较零初始化可将对偶间隙收紧多个数量级，且收益在优化早期最明显。在贝叶斯网络的受约束任务上，结合测试时自适应后表现可与自适应基线相当；在网格和图像分割任务上，对偶间隙则优于基线一至两个数量级。

Conclusion: 神经网络能够以单次前向计算为最大后验推断提供有效的对偶优化初值，从而显著加速获得紧上界。该方法也适用于受约束推断，并在不同任务类型上展现出良好的效果。

Abstract: We present Neural Dual Bounds, a calibration-free framework that produces deterministic upper bounds for MAP inference in probabilistic graphical models using a single neural-network forward pass. The framework trains a network to output the edge messages of a mini-bucket style upper bound on a given join-graph decomposition in a self-supervised manner by directly minimizing a smooth dual objective. The output of this network can be used at test time to warm-start a standard JGLP optimizer. Across diverse benchmarks, this warm start yields dual gaps that are orders of magnitude tighter than those from zero initialization, with the largest gains in the early-iteration regime. We also apply our framework for the constrained MAP (CMPE) task, where neural warm starts with test-time adaptation are comparable to the adaptive baseline on Bayesian networks and achieve the tightest dual gaps, by one to two orders of magnitude, on the grid and segmentation families.

</details>


### [357] [Learning Graph-Conditioned Predictors in Weight Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19250)
*Zhewei Chen,Hao Zhu,Ahad N. Zehmakan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种结构条件化预测器：利用节点的结构指纹动态调整共享分类器，使模型能按结构情境解释节点属性，同时避免推理时进行在线消息传递。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相同的节点属性在不同结构环境中可能对应不同标签。许多快速、无图推理模型仅把拓扑信息当作额外特征交给统一预测器，因而默认结构只增加信息，而不会改变属性的解读方式。论文旨在让结构情境直接决定预测器如何处理节点属性。

Method: 模型为每个节点缓存结构指纹，并由一个小型生成器将其映射为共享低秩基的系数，进而对全局权重矩阵生成情境特定的更新。基础预测器、低秩基与生成器在所有节点间共享，从而兼顾情境适配与参数复用。缓存指纹后，推理只需前向计算，无须在线消息传递。

Result: 在两个大型节点分类图上，使用原始位置结构信号调节模型权重，相比将相同信号直接拼接到输入中取得明显提升。结构迁移式留出节点评测和无需教师模型的图分类实验也表明，该机制并非局限于特定的知识蒸馏场景。摘要未提供具体数值或显著性检验结果。

Conclusion: 研究表明，图结构不仅可以作为预测证据，也可以作为决定预测器如何解释节点属性的情境。通过紧凑的低秩适配和共享参数，模型在实现结构条件化预测的同时，保留了无需在线消息传递的快速推理特点。

Abstract: The same node attributes can imply different labels in different structural contexts. Yet fast graphless models typically treat topology as additional evidence supplied to a globally shared predictor. This assumes that structure augments the available information, rather than determining how node attributes should be interpreted. We introduce SCOPE (Structure-COnditioned PrEdictor), in which a small generator maps each node's cached structural fingerprint to coefficients over a shared low-rank basis, producing a context-specific update to a global weight matrix. The base predictor, basis, and generator remain shared across all nodes, while the resulting transformation adapts how attributes are processed in each relational environment. Once fingerprints are cached, inference requires only a forward pass and no online message passing. This design combines context-specific specialization with global parameter sharing, compact low-rank adaptation, and message-passing-free inference. On two large OGB node-classification graphs, conditioning the weights with raw positional signals yields clear gains over supplying the same signals through input concatenation. Further results under a structure-transductive held-out-node protocol and in teacher-free graph classification show that the mechanism extends beyond a particular distillation setting. These findings establish graph structure not only as predictive evidence, but as context that determines the predictor used to interpret that evidence.

</details>


### [358] [ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19276)
*Kejia Fan,Yajiang Huang,Jianheng Tang,Jinfeng Xu,Huiping Zhuang,Anfeng Liu,Houbing Herbert Song,Yunhuai Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出残差增强型众包解析学习机制，通过无梯度的闭式残差模块和跨递归最小二乘策略，实现适用于异构数据的分布式持续学习；在提升准确率的同时大幅降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包服务需要随用户需求变化持续吸收新知识，并保留以往所学。现有依赖梯度反向传播的方法在异构数据上持续更新时容易发生灾难性遗忘。解析学习虽可借助递归闭式解避免这一问题，但通常局限于单层线性网络，表示能力不足，容易欠拟合。因此，研究需要兼顾异构性适应、持续学习与深层非线性表示能力的方法。

Method: 提出残差增强型众包解析学习机制。借鉴残差网络设计具有闭式解的无梯度残差模块，以支持深层非线性表示；同时设计基于最小二乘的跨递归策略，实现分布式持续训练，并在更新过程中保留既有知识。

Result: 理论分析与实验结果表明，该方法兼具异构性适应能力和深层表示能力。在采用二十层残差结构时，相比单层解析学习基线，准确率提高百分之八点八五至百分之九点八三；相比基于梯度的方法，计算开销降低百分之九十四以上。

Conclusion: 该研究将解析学习的无梯度、闭式求解特性扩展到深层残差结构，并通过跨递归训练支持分布式持续服务构建。结果显示，这一方案能够缓解持续学习中的遗忘问题，同时提升模型表达能力与计算效率。

Abstract: Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invariance for distributed continual service construction. Inspired by the success of ResNet, we develop gradient-free residual blocks for ReCALM with closed-form solutions. To implement distributed continual training for ReCALM, we further devise a cross-recursive strategy via least squares. Both theoretical and experimental analyses verify ReCALM's dual superiority in heterogeneity invariance and deep representation. With 20 residual layers, ReCALM improves accuracy by 8.85%-9.83% over the single-layer analytic baseline, while reducing computational costs by over 94% compared with gradient-based baselines.

</details>


### [359] [Where Mixture Recognition Fails: An Ingredient-Level Audit of Unseen Combinations in SmellNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19297)
*Zirui Liu,Zheming Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究指出，电子鼻混合物识别的主要瓶颈不是模型架构，而是成分难以区分以及模型偏好训练中常见成分；评估应采用集合级错误指标，且不能预先告知混合物成分数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子鼻需要识别混合物中的全部成分，包括训练时未出现过的成分组合。现有基准测试会预先告知每个样本含有多少种成分，这种设置可能掩盖模型的实际错误，因此有必要审查评估协议及其揭示的泛化能力。

Method: 研究在训练数据中留出未见过的成分组合，并在不提供成分数量的条件下评估四类模型：多层感知机、卷积神经网络、长短期记忆网络和变换器编码器；随后又在官方未见组合测试集上重复评估。研究同时考察成分识别准确性、错误模式，以及训练成分出现频率对预测的影响。

Result: 即使评估协议提供成分数量，在自建留出折和官方测试集上，仍有百分之九十至九十六的混合物被预测出至少一种实际不存在的成分。在自建留出折中，模型通常能可靠识别一种成分，却很少识别出第二种；补出的第二种成分约有两倍于随机水平的概率是训练中常与第一种成分搭配的对象。在官方测试集的二元混合物中，排名第一的成分仅有百分之二十九至四十六正确；对于训练中从未出现过的成分组合，没有模型能在超过百分之一点二的样本中同时识别两种成分。各架构的失败成分相似，频率校正只是改变错误落在哪些成分上。

Conclusion: 混合物识别的局限主要源于成分之间难以区分，以及模型对训练中高频成分的偏好，而非所选架构。研究建议以集合级错误衡量完整成分预测，并取消预先告知成分数量的设置，以更真实地评估模型能力。

Abstract: An electronic nose must name every ingredient of a mixture, including combinations it has never measured. SmellNet, a public benchmark for this task, scores ingredients with a hit rate that is told how many each sample contains. We audit what this protocol hides. We hold out ingredient combinations from the SmellNet training data, evaluate four architectures (MLP, CNN, LSTM and a Transformer encoder) without revealing the ingredient count, and repeat the evaluation once on the official unseen split. Under the count-informed protocol, 90-96% of mixtures receive an ingredient that is absent, on our folds and on the official split alike. On our folds, every model identifies one ingredient reliably but the second rarely, and it completes the pair with a familiar training partner about twice as often as chance. On the official split, even the first-ranked ingredient is correct in only 29-46% of binary mixtures, often because a frequent training ingredient that is absent from every test pair is ranked first, and on its combinations that are truly absent from training no model names both ingredients in more than 1.2% of them. The failures fall on the same ingredients for every architecture, and a frequency correction only moves errors between ingredients. Mixture recognition is therefore limited by ingredients the models cannot separate and by a preference for frequent ingredients, not by the architecture, and it should be evaluated with set-level errors and without oracle cardinality.

</details>


### [360] [NetBreaker: Benchmarking Network Dismantling across Objectives, Scales, and Toplogoies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19298)
*Wenchuan Yang,Tianci Bu,Suoyi Tan,Changjun Fan,Zijie Zhou,Xin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NetBreaker 是面向网络拆解研究的综合基准，统一比较 30 种方法在 185 个网络上的表现；实验发现，学习方法并未稳定优于强非学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络拆解旨在以尽可能少的节点移除将网络分裂，应用于脆弱性分析、疫情控制和基础设施保护。现有研究在方法覆盖、数据集、评价标准和实验流程上差异较大，导致不同方法的进展难以公平评估，因此需要建立统一、可复现的基准。

Method: 论文提出 NetBreaker，按统一分类体系整理 30 种方法，包括 18 种非学习方法和 12 种学习方法，并在涵盖八个领域、规模从 14 个节点到 169 万个节点的 185 个网络上进行评测。基准将不同方法的输出统一转换为节点移除序列，并采用一致的执行流程；评价涵盖目标效果、过程轨迹效果、结构诊断，以及适用性与计算效率四个维度。

Result: 实验表明，当前学习方法并不能持续优于表现强劲的非学习方法。不同方法在效果、可扩展性和效率方面存在显著差异，且结论会随网络条件和评价视角而变化。

Conclusion: NetBreaker 为网络拆解方法提供了统一且可复现的比较基础，有助于更可靠地衡量研究进展，并推动开发兼顾效果、可扩展性与计算效率的方法。

Abstract: Network dismantling seeks to fragment a network with as few node removals as possible, which is widely applied in vulnerability analysis, epidemic containment, and infrastructure protection. Although learning-based methods have become increasingly prominent, their progress remains difficult to assess because existing studies differ in method coverage, datasets, evaluation criteria, and experimental protocols. Thus, we introduce NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark designed for the learning era of network dismantling. NetBreaker organizes 30 methods (18 non-learning and 12 learning-based) under a common taxonomy and evaluates them on 185 networks from eight unified domains, ranging from 14 to 1.69 million nodes. To enable fair comparison, heterogeneous method outputs are converted into node removal sequences and assessed under a unified execution protocol. The evaluation covers four complementary dimensions: target-based effectiveness, trajectory-based effectiveness, structural diagnostics, and applicability & computational efficiency. Extensive experiments show that current learningbased methods do not consistently outperform strong non-learning approaches, while exposing substantial differences in effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency across network conditions and evaluation perspectives. NetBreaker provides a reproducible basis for measuring progress and developing reliable, scalable, and computationally efficient network dismantling methods.

</details>


### [361] [Does Lifestyle Information Improve Hypertension Prediction? A Leakage-Controlled Evaluation on NHANES](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19302)
*Uriel Benymon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在美国国家健康与营养调查数据中，加入生活方式信息未能稳定提升高血压预测的区分能力；这不代表生活方式因素不重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在检验：在常规人口统计学和人体测量数据之外，容易获取的身体活动、饮酒、吸烟和睡眠信息，能否进一步改善机器学习对高血压的预测。

Method: 使用美国国家健康与营养调查二〇一七年至二〇二〇年三月的数据，比较逻辑回归、随机森林、梯度提升、装袋决策树和极端梯度提升五类模型。采用折内预处理，并通过配对自助法计算置信区间；另以更严格的实测血压结局、取消合成过采样，以及未接受治疗的成年人进行稳健性或探索性分析。特征归因一致性则分别在全部编码特征和两组共有的十九项基线特征上比较。

Result: 在主要分析中，加入生活方式信息未显示稳定的区分能力提升：所有模型的配对受试者工作特征曲线下面积差异置信区间均包含零。更严格的实测血压结局和不使用合成过采样时，结论相同。跨模型的特征归因排序一致性在全部编码特征上由零点八七三降至零点八〇六，但仅比较共有基线特征时差异明显缩小，由零点八七三降至零点八六三。未接受治疗者的探索性分析中，五个模型均出现小幅正向差异，其中两个模型的未经校正置信区间未包含零，仍需进一步验证。

Conclusion: 在该研究人群中，所评估的生活方式信息相较于已有信息丰富的基线数据，几乎没有增加高血压预测的区分能力。这一结果不应被解读为生活方式因素缺乏临床重要性；比较特征归因一致性时，也应使用相同的特征集合，以避免特征数量不同造成误读。

Abstract: Does readily available lifestyle information improve machine-learning prediction of hypertension beyond routine demographic and anthropometric data? On NHANES 2017-March 2020, five model families (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Bagged Decision Trees, and XGBoost) were evaluated with fold-local preprocessing and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. Adding physical activity, alcohol use, smoking, and sleep information showed no consistent detectable improvement in held-out discrimination: every paired ROC-AUC confidence interval included zero, including under a stricter measured-blood-pressure phenotype and without synthetic oversampling. Mean cross-model SHAP rank agreement fell from 0.873 to 0.806 over all encoded columns, but this decline was largely attenuated over the 19 baseline columns shared by both arms (0.873 vs. 0.863), and likewise under both robustness checks; attribution-agreement comparisons across feature sets of different sizes therefore require a matched comparison space. In exploratory analysis of untreated adults (measured-blood-pressure outcome), all five models showed small positive differences, two with unadjusted intervals excluding zero, meriting confirmation. These results do not imply that lifestyle factors are clinically unimportant; within this cohort, the evaluated lifestyle block added little incremental discrimination beyond an already-informative baseline.

</details>


### [362] [A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19304)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种仅分析微调模型权重的静态检测方法，无需运行可疑模型或提供数据，即可将后门触发短语中的一个词元排为最高候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有公开的后门触发词恢复方法都需要运行可疑模型。论文希望降低检测门槛，并探索后门信息是否直接留存在模型权重中，从而在缺少输入数据、标注样本及后门先验知识时仍能发现触发线索。

Method: 对微调后的模型检查权重，计算一种静态统计量来为词汇表中的词元排序。该方法不执行模型前向计算，不需要输入数据或已标注的中毒模型样本，也不要求事先知道模型含有后门。摘要未说明统计量的具体定义与计算细节。

Result: 作者报告称，在其研究设置中，触发短语中的一个词元被该统计量排为整个词汇表中得分最高的候选。摘要未提供实验规模、适用条件或定量指标。

Conclusion: 后门触发信息可能可从模型权重本身读取，而不必通过运行模型来恢复。这为静态审查微调检查点提供了新方向；但仅凭摘要无法判断该方法在不同模型、触发形式及现实场景中的稳健性和泛化能力。

Abstract: A backdoored language model behaves normally until a trigger phrase appears in its input. Every published method for recovering such a trigger runs the model. We show the trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic reads a fine-tuned checkpoint with no forward pass of the suspect, no data, no labelled population of poisoned models and no prior knowledge that a backdoor exists, and names one of the tokens of the trigger phrase as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary.

</details>


### [363] [Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19329)
*Akhil S. Anand,Xun Shen,Marc Peter Deisenroth,Sebastien Gros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于梯度的协同设计方法，同时优化系统设计与运行策略，并在高维可微网络系统基准上优于黑箱搜索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统设计与运行策略彼此依赖：设计效果取决于为其训练的策略，而最优策略也会随设计变化。传统方法需针对每个候选设计重新训练策略，再用贝叶斯优化或进化策略等黑箱方法搜索，难以扩展到高维设计空间，也未利用模拟器的可微结构及最优策略对设计的敏感性。

Method: 将设计梯度分解为两部分：固定策略时设计变化产生的直接影响，以及设计变化通过最优策略改变产生的间接影响。为求得间接影响，利用隐函数定理对策略梯度的驻点条件求导，计算收敛策略对设计的敏感性。基于此构造采用随机价值梯度式策略优化的协同设计算法，并证明其能够收敛到近似驻点设计。

Result: 在具有高维设计空间的可微网络系统基准上，该方法稳定优于贝叶斯优化和进化策略。摘要未提供具体数值或比较指标。

Conclusion: 利用最优策略对系统设计的敏感性，可以把协同设计从反复训练与黑箱搜索转化为梯度优化。该方法兼具理论收敛保证与基准实验优势，显示出处理高维可微协同设计问题的潜力。

Abstract: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. Based on this sensitivity, we develop a proof-of-concept co-design algorithm with stochastic value gradient (SVG)-style policy optimization, prove that it converges to an approximately stationary design, and demonstrate on a differentiable networked-system benchmark with high-dimensional design spaces that it consistently outperforms BO and ES.

</details>


### [364] [Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19330)
*Michiel Kallenberg,Philip Janz,Christoph Jörges,Vageesh Saxena,Pratishtha Poudel,Mohammed Musthafa Rafi,Ioannis N. Athanasiadis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究对五类作物产量预测方法开展大规模标准化比较，发现特征工程机器学习与表格基础模型总体表现最佳，但年际波动和异常预测仍具挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作物产量预测关系粮食安全、农业政策与商品市场。以往研究缺乏大规模、统一标准的比较，因此不同建模范式的相对优势尚不明确；同时，单一总体精度指标难以揭示模型在空间、时间及异常情形下的能力差异。

Method: 研究基于作物产量基准数据集，覆盖六大洲、六十三个国家与作物数据集，以及超过一万二千个行政区域，系统比较五类方法：统计基线、过程模型、传统特征工程机器学习、深度序列模型和表格基础模型。除总体精度外，研究还分别评估空间预测、时间预测和异常预测能力。

Result: 特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型总体预测表现最强。在种植玉米的国家中，数据驱动模型有百分之七十二实现归一化均方根误差下降，中位降幅为百分之八点八；在种植小麦的国家中，相应比例为百分之七十八，中位降幅为百分之十一点九。总体而言，空间预测显著易于时间预测和异常预测。数据驱动模型虽较统计基线明显提升了时间及异常预测能力，但对逐年产量波动的准确预测仍然困难。

Conclusion: 大规模基准比较表明，数据驱动方法具有较强的作物产量预测能力，但提升总体精度并不足以解决年际波动预测问题。未来研究应更好地刻画驱动年际变化的环境与管理因素，并构建有效的产量预测系统表征，以支持农业决策、早期预警和粮食安全规划。

Abstract: Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. Across multiple crops and countries, feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models achieve the strongest overall predictive performance. Data-driven models reduce NRMSE in 72% of countries growing maize and 78% of countries growing wheat, with median reductions of 8.8% and 11.9%, respectively. Across all modeling paradigms, spatial prediction is substantially easier than temporal and anomaly prediction. While data-driven models markedly improve temporal and anomaly prediction over statistical baselines, accurately forecasting year-to-year yield variability remains challenging. These findings suggest that future progress in large-scale crop yield forecasting will depend on the improved characterization of the environmental and management factors driving inter-annual yield variability, founded on effective representations for crop yield forecasting systems that support agricultural decision-making, early-warning applications, and food security planning

</details>


### [365] [SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19349)
*Yin Xu,Yongbo Yang,He Sun,Miao Sun,Mingjun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向长上下文大语言模型联邦微调的高效框架，通过稀疏计算、客户端间稀疏协调及渐进式更新恢复，降低显存与通信开销，并改善部分非独立同分布场景下的微调效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限设备上进行长上下文联邦微调，面临激活值占用显存过高、不同客户端的重要词元分布不一致，以及模型更新通信成本高等问题。现有方法难以同时兼顾内存效率、数据异质性和通信效率。

Method: 提出稀疏感知、内存高效的联邦微调框架，包含三项机制：本地稀疏前向适配，通过稀疏计算降低本地适配的内存需求；共识锚定的稀疏协调，针对客户端间差异协调稀疏模式；通信高效的渐进式更新恢复，以紧凑形式传输更新并逐步重建。三者协同实现高效本地训练、异质性感知的稀疏协调和轻量通信。

Result: 在中等规模模型和大型模型上的实验显示，在一万六千词元上下文长度下，该框架相较常规微调最高降低百分之八十八点三五的峰值显存占用，相较仅前向低秩适配微调降低百分之十三点二五。此外，在部分非独立同分布设置下，微调性能有所提升，并支持紧凑更新传输与渐进式重建。

Conclusion: 该框架通过联合优化稀疏计算、客户端协调和更新传输，为资源受限环境中的长上下文联邦大语言模型适配提供了兼顾内存、数据异质性与通信效率的方案。摘要所述实验表明其具有应用潜力，但具体效果仍需结合更多任务、数据分布和设备条件评估。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. Experiments on OPT-350M and LLaMA2-7B demonstrate that SMELL reduces peak memory consumption by up to 88.35% compared with conventional fine-tuning and 13.25% compared with forward-only LoRA fine-tuning at a 16K context length. Furthermore, SMELL improves fine-tuning performance under certain non-IID settings and supports compact update transmission with progressive reconstruction, demonstrating its potential for resource-efficient federated long-context LLM adaptation.

</details>


### [366] [$β$-number and Its Applications to Data Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19379)
*Pengxu Wen,Ziwei Nie,Liwen Zou,Ying Cao,Xiaoping Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出β数，用于衡量集合相对于最优低维平面的高阶偏离程度，并将其推广为主成分分析的更一般框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统降维方法主要关注寻找低维表示，难以同时刻画数据相对于低维平面的振荡或偏离程度。论文旨在建立一种可用于降维与数据分类的统一度量。

Method: 对欧几里得空间中的集合，寻找使点到某个维度为d的平面的距离的p次幂平均值最小的平面，并以此定义β数。作者分析其上下界、尺度变化规律及相关参数之间的关系，并分别提出适用于连续与离散情形的计算算法。

Result: 理论分析给出了β数的界与尺度规律，并揭示了它和相关参数的联系。离散情形下，当p等于二时，β数确定的平面与主成分分析得到的平面一致。低维数值实验验证了理论结果，降维和图像分类任务则展示了其应用潜力。

Conclusion: β数将低维近似与数据振荡度量结合起来；在特定条件下，它复现主成分分析，同时可推广到不同阶数和连续数据情形，为数据分析提供了一个兼具理论基础与应用价值的工具。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel metric, $β$-number, designed to measure the "$p$-th order $d$-dimensional oscillation degree" of a set. For a given set $K$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$, $β$-number is computed by identifying an optimal $d$-dimensional plane $L$ that minimizes the average $p$-th order distance of all points in $K$ to $L$. This metric serves as a versatile tool in data science, functioning both as a dimensionality reduction technique to find the optimal $p$-th order $d$-dimensional subspace and as a measure to characterize data oscillation for classification. We conduct a thorough exploration of $β$-number through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments. Initially, we establish the upper and lower bounds of $β$-number for any set $K$, along with its scaling law. We then elucidate the relationships between $β$-number and its related parameters. A key finding of this study is that in discrete settings, when $p=2$, the $d$-dimensional plane determined by $β$-number coincides with that obtained via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), positioning $β$-number as a generalization of PCA. Furthermore, we propose two algorithms for calculating $β$-number in both continuous and discrete settings. We validate our theoretical results through a series of numerical experiments in low-dimensional cases. Finally, we demonstrate the potential of $β$-number in practical data analysis through a dimensionality reduction task and an image classification task.

</details>


### [367] [Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19380)
*Braghadeesh Lakshminarayanan,Ojas Phadake,Qi Chen,Dominik Baumann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需重新训练的扩散预测控制方法，通过约束引导调整预训练模型的采样分布，使生成的有限时域状态—输入序列更符合新部署的安全要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型能够生成适用于预测控制的多模态候选序列，但部署环境中新增加或改变的障碍物等安全约束可能导致生成序列违规。若每次约束变化都重新训练模型，控制器的实用性和适应能力将受到限制。

Method: 将预训练扩散模型视为有限时域序列的先验分布，并依据约束违反惩罚对该分布进行指数倾斜，以得到适应新约束的分布。在线根据生成序列未通过约束验证的比例调整倾斜强度；再在扩散采样器的高斯噪声空间中使用经梅特罗波利斯校正的朗之万算法，近似从调整后的分布采样。

Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果。所提出的方法旨在不重新训练预训练模型的前提下，使采样结果适应新引入的安全约束。

Conclusion: 该方法通过测试时调整采样分布，而非更新模型参数，为扩散模型驱动的预测控制提供了一种应对部署阶段约束变化的途径。其实际效果仍需结合论文中的实验数据评估。

Abstract: Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification. We approximately sample the adapted distribution using the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm in the Gaussian noise space of the pretrained diffusion sampler.

</details>


### [368] [Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19419)
*Lavinia Ghita,Dhruv Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究比较多种逐元素与矩阵结构优化器在指令微调模型初始化上的短程前向散度蒸馏表现。矩阵结构方法未能稳定改善质量与训练时间的权衡，预训练中的优势不能直接外推至蒸馏任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵结构优化器已被证明可能提升语言模型预训练效果，但这些收益能否迁移到从指令微调模型出发、训练步数有限的散度蒸馏任务，尚不明确。研究旨在针对这一具体目标与训练条件检验其效果。

Method: 在四组稠密学生—教师模型配对上，采用统一的前向散度目标和固定训练预算，比较亚当权重衰减优化器、对角自适应梯度累积方法、两种可计算的洗发水式简化方案、SOAP方法及全二维穆昂优化器，并评估验证集散度与训练耗时之间的权衡。

Result: 各模型规模下，矩阵结构优化器均未能稳定优于逐元素参考方法的质量—耗时权衡。亚当权重衰减通常取得最低验证散度；较大规模时，对角自适应梯度累积有时略快。SOAP的散度表现常接近亚当权重衰减，但训练耗时明显更高。两种洗发水式简化方案的相对排序会随模型配对而反转。

Conclusion: 优化器的效果取决于蒸馏目标、模型配对及实际可行的实现方案。预训练中观察到的优化优势不会自动迁移到短程散度蒸馏；应在目标任务和系统条件下重新验证。

Abstract: Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. These results suggest that pretraining optimizer gains do not transfer automatically to KL distillation and should be re-established for the target objective and systems regime.

</details>


### [369] [Federated versus Centralized PV Capacity-Factor Forecasting: A Non-Inferiority Study Across Seven Stations in North Macedonia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19421)
*Amar Kumar Mandal,Yuvraj Chaudhary,Dimitar Kitanovski,Eftim Zdravevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在北马其顿七个光伏站点的离线预测中，近端联邦训练的预测误差不劣于集中式训练；其平均误差还略低，但实际运营收益仍需验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光伏功率预测有助于运营方制定能源承诺，并支持光储系统的充放电安排。然而，运营方可能无法共享原始数据，因此需要评估联邦学习能否在不汇集数据的情况下，达到集中式训练的预测效果。

Method: 研究使用七个站点的数据和统一的多层感知机，开展带有二十四小时滞后的离线预测比较。探索阶段比较本地训练、集中式训练、联邦平均及近端联邦训练，随后选定近端联邦方案进行确认性检验。检验采用仅使用过去信息的输入、五组配对随机种子、站点宏平均绝对误差，并以零点零零五作为预设非劣效界值；通过对四十九个测试日期进行一万次配对自助抽样估计置信区间。

Result: 近端联邦训练的宏平均绝对误差为零点一二八三九七，低于集中式训练的零点一三三四零五。两者误差差值为负零点零零五零零八，百分之九十五置信区间为负零点零零九九二六至负零点零零零五三七；区间上限低于预设界值，满足非劣效标准。五组种子结果均有利于近端联邦训练，且七个站点中有六个站点的平均误差较低。事后日历敏感性分析未改变结论。

Conclusion: 在本研究评估的站点与离线设置中，联邦训练实现了相对于集中式训练的预测非劣效，为数据无法汇集时的协作预测提供了支持。但研究尚未证明其能改善能源承诺或电池调度效果，这些潜在收益仍需通过实际运营评估验证。

Abstract: Background: Photovoltaic (PV) forecasts inform energy commitments by PV operators and aggregators and guide charge-discharge scheduling in solar-plus-storage systems. Federated learning enables collaborative model training through model updates when local operators cannot pool raw operational data. This study evaluated whether federated training was non-inferior to centralized training for PV capacity-factor prediction across seven stations in North Macedonia. A common multilayer perceptron was used in an offline forecasting comparison with a 24-hour timestamp lag. Exploratory validation compared local, centralized, Federated Averaging, and Federated Proximal (FedProx) training. FedProx (E = 1, mu = 1) was selected for a confirmatory comparison under a protocol fixed before test evaluation. The comparison used past-only offline inputs, five paired training seeds, macro-averaged mean absolute error (MAE), a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 0.005, and a paired day bootstrap with 10,000 repetitions over 49 test dates.
  Results: FedProx achieved a macro-MAE of 0.128397, compared with 0.133405 for centralized training. The paired difference (FedProx minus centralized) was -0.005008 (95% confidence interval: [-0.009926, -0.000537]). The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified margin, satisfying the non-inferiority criterion. All five seed-specific differences favored FedProx, and its mean MAE was lower at six of the seven stations. Post hoc calendar sensitivity analyses did not change the conclusion.
  Conclusions: These findings support further evaluation of federated forecasting for collaboration under data-pooling constraints. The study demonstrates predictive non-inferiority within the evaluated setting. Benefits for energy commitments and battery scheduling remain potential applications requiring operational evaluation.

</details>


### [370] [Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19446)
*Lucia Licakova,Niklas Schmidinger,Lukas Hauzenberger,Sebastian Böck,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究深度递归模型在自回归生成中的缓存内存开销，并提出通过跨递归迭代复用键值状态来降低开销，同时尽量维持模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度递归通过反复执行同一计算模块来增加模型的有效深度，但共享注意力参数并不会自动共享各次递归产生的键值状态。因此，递归次数增加时，解码阶段的缓存内存也会增长。论文旨在探索架构设计与缓存共享机制，以缓解这一问题。

Method: 研究在统一的深度递归框架下比较多种方案：一是构建循环混合模型，重复执行一组层，并以递归式混合模块替代多数注意力层，同时定期保留注意力锚点；二是将递归限制在专用工作区中，并测试稳定化适配器能否用于循环混合模型；三是训练带递归键值重放的循环变换器，仅让选定的递归迭代写入键值状态，供后续迭代复用，使训练与推理采用相同的缓存共享结构。

Result: 循环混合模型需要足够频繁地设置注意力锚点，其表现还明显受到递归混合模块类型的影响。跨迭代共享键值状态时，递归键值重放能够让多个迭代复用同一组状态，并取得接近于各迭代分别维护缓存的完整循环变换器的性能。

Conclusion: 递归深度带来的缓存增长可以通过跨迭代复用键值状态来缓解。递归键值重放是较有前景的方案，因为它在训练阶段就适配共享缓存结构，并在减少缓存需求的同时保持接近基准模型的性能；不过，循环混合架构的效果仍取决于注意力锚点的设置频率及所采用的递归混合模块。

Abstract: Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iteration KV sharing, recurrent KV replay allows multiple recurrence iterations to reuse the same KV states while retaining performance close to the full looped Transformer with separate KV caches for each iteration.

</details>


### [371] [Efficient and Accurate Causal Validation of Training Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19451)
*Simon Vary,Alireza Mousavi-Hosseini,Roger Grosse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文通过校正有限训练子集、重复训练随机种子和归因模型集成带来的偏差，减少评估训练数据归因方法所需的模型重训练次数，同时维持评估精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练数据归因方法需要通过因果验证来衡量其预测是否可信。常用的线性数据建模分数依赖于在大量训练集子集上重新训练模型，计算成本很高，因此需要降低评估开销而不明显损失准确性。

Method: 论文从三个方面减少分数估计的计算量：抽取的训练子集数量、每个子集对应的重复训练随机种子数量，以及归因模型集成中的模型数量。作者分析这些因素分别造成的估计偏差，并采用去偏方法加以校正；其中包括有限子集去偏，以及估计训练噪声方差。

Result: 在残差网络九层模型与小型图像分类数据集上，有限子集去偏仅用四个子集即可达到百分之三点二的相对均方根误差；使用三十二个子集时，其准确度可匹配普通斯皮尔曼相关方法使用九十六个子集的结果，比较基准为三百个子集。在图像分类、自然语言推理和语言建模实验中，估计训练噪声方差后，可用少二至五倍的重训练次数，达到标准五随机种子评估的精度。

Conclusion: 对评估中的多类偏差进行校正，能够显著降低训练数据归因方法因果验证的计算成本。结果表明，经过校正的少量子集或少量重复训练，也可获得接近传统高成本评估的准确度。

Abstract: Causal validation of training data attribution (TDA) methods is costly, since evaluation involves retraining a model on many different subsets of the original training set. For example, the Linear Datamodeling Score (LDS), which has become a standard metric for evaluating TDA methods, measures the correlation between TDA predictions and expected retrained model outputs. In this paper, we reduce the amount of computation needed to estimate the LDS along three axes: the number of sampled training subsets, the number of retraining seeds per subset, and the number of models in the attribution ensemble. Each of these factors induces a form of bias in the LDS estimation, and removing these sources of bias significantly reduces the number of retrainings needed to match the same accuracy in LDS estimation. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy of ordinary Spearman using $96$ subsets, measured against a 300-subset reference. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, BERT/QNLI and GPT-2/WikiText-2, estimating the training-noise variance allows us to reproduce the standard five-seed LDS at the same accuracy with $2$--$5\times$ fewer retrainings.

</details>


### [372] [Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19466)
*Samuel Younger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种结合离线学习世界模型与序贯凸规划的安全规划方法：在潜在空间中逐步优化动作，并在规划时域的每一步施加学习得到的离散时间控制障碍函数约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于离线数据学习的世界模型使智能体能够不与环境继续交互便进行规划，但常见的采样式规划器通常只通过给动作序列评分或直接拒绝序列来处理安全约束，难以直接保证规划过程满足约束。另一方面，序贯凸规划属于局部优化方法，需要兼顾其收敛性与初始规划质量。

Method: 作者将世界模型潜在空间中的安全规划表述为序贯凸规划，并在整个规划时域内的每一步加入学习得到的离散时间控制障碍函数约束。为满足该方法对光滑动力学的要求，模型采用平滑的极值类激活函数和谱归一化层；作者还依据利普希茨界与平滑宽度，推导线性化误差界。考虑到序贯凸规划具有局部性，算法以采样得到的规划作为初始解，并在每一步报告是否找到模型内可行且满足卡鲁什—库恩—塔克一阶条件的解，或附近未找到可行规划。

Result: 在两个基于离线数据的安全导航任务中，该方法相较于模型预测路径积分和交叉熵采样规划器，违反安全约束的次数更少；在相同运行时间下，后两者使用的样本数量是该方法的128倍，但违规次数差异未达到统计显著性。较长规划时域下，该方法获得更高回报；与没有采样初始解的序贯凸规划相比，它也显著更安全。此外，在具有利普希茨界的模型上，序贯凸规划更常收敛。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将控制障碍函数约束直接纳入世界模型中的序贯凸规划，有望比单纯依赖采样筛选更有效地兼顾安全性与任务回报。采样初始解对局部规划的安全表现尤为重要，而模型的利普希茨性质也与规划收敛性相关。实验结果具有积极趋势，但违规次数的改善未达到统计显著性，因此安全优势仍需在更多任务和条件下验证。

Abstract: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/scwm.

</details>


### [373] [Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19477)
*Pascal Sager,Benjamin Grewe,Pau Vilimelis Aceituno,Thilo Stadelmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 学习规则决定泛化电路的规模：即使学得相同算法，不同规则也会形成分散或集中的神经元实现，并在鲁棒性、可压缩性和迁移速度之间产生权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络经历“顿悟”并从记忆转向泛化时，究竟是什么决定泛化解由多少神经元实现，尚不清楚。论文关注学习规则——信用分配算法与优化器的组合——是否会影响电路规模，以及这种影响背后的机制。

Method: 研究者在模加任务中比较多种能够产生顿悟的学习规则，并分析神经元是否继续参与计算与其所获信用相对于自身更新中非梯度项的大小之间的关系。论文进一步通过均衡各神经元的信用幅度，或按信用调整各神经元的权重衰减，操控电路规模；同时改变共享均衡因子的神经元组大小，并测试神经元删除、剪枝和任务迁移表现。

Result: 所有能产生顿悟的学习规则都恢复了相同的傅里叶算法，但实现该算法的电路规模不同。信用相对较弱时，耦合权重衰减、优化器中的小常数项以及可训练神经元增益的衰减，都可能使神经元退出计算。均衡信用或按信用缩放权重衰减，可在训练与测试准确率相近时，将有效电路规模从该层神经元的百分之六十提高到百分之九十九。每八个及以上神经元共享一个均衡因子时，电路仍较集中；只有为每个神经元单独设置因子，计算才会完全分散。按神经元归一化的优化器会促成分散实现，而亚当、均方根传播、穆恩及其他采用不同归一化方式的优化器通常形成较小且集中的电路。分散电路更能承受神经元删除；集中电路则更易进一步剪枝，并能借助未使用神经元，以约两倍速度迁移到重组相同特征的任务。

Conclusion: 学习规则不仅影响模型如何优化，也会塑造泛化算法在神经元层面的实现规模。通过调节信用分配及其与更新中非梯度因素的相对关系，可以在相同算法和近似准确率下选择更分散或更集中的电路，从而权衡抗删减能力、压缩潜力与迁移速度。

Abstract: During grokking, a network transitions from memorization to generalization, yet what shapes the neural implementation (circuit) of the generalizing solution and specifically the number of participating neurons (its size) remains unclear. We find that the learning rule, the combination of credit assignment algorithm and optimizer, controls this: On modular addition, every learning rule we study that groks recovers the same Fourier-based algorithm, yet implemented by circuits that differ in size. Why? A neuron stays in use when its credit is large relative to the non-gradient term of its own update, and this single condition unifies three routes to unused neurons: the coupled weight decay, Adam's $ε$ and the decay of a trainable per-neuron gain. Equalizing the magnitude of credit assigned to each neuron, or scaling each neuron's weight decay by its credit, expands the effective circuit size, measured from the outgoing weights, from 60% to 99% of the layer's neurons at similar training and test accuracy. We vary which neurons share one equalization factor, from the whole layer to individual neurons, and find that the circuit stays concentrated for groups of eight or more and fully distributes only when every neuron has its own factor.
