Credit magnitudes are usually set by the normalization of standard optimizers: Nero, which normalizes per neuron, distributes the computation, whereas Adam and seven others, including RMSProp, Muon, and Shampoo, use other normalization schemes and retain small, concentrated circuits. Distributed circuits tolerate neuron deletion better, while concentrated circuits can be pruned further and transfer about twice as fast to a task that recombines the same features, largely by recruiting their unused neurons. Learning rule choice thus steers circuit size, trading robustness against compressibility and transfer speed without changing the learned algorithm.

</details>


### [374] [Probing SAM Perturbations Through Statistical Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19480)
*Ting Han,Jens Kleesiek,Michael Kamp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过统计重放与多种扰动对照实验，检验锐度感知最小化的泛化效果是否能由简单曲率正则化或扰动统计特征解释；结果显示这些简单解释不足以说明其机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锐度感知最小化会依据对抗性扰动后的参数处梯度更新模型，但哪些扰动特征足以产生其泛化表现仍不清楚。作者发现，基于海森矩阵迹或最大特征值的简单曲率正则化，在验证准确率上不及该方法，因此进一步直接研究其参数扰动。

Method: 作者在小型图像分类基准上使用十八层残差网络开展实验，并提出“统计重放”：从参考训练轨迹的局部时间窗口中，计算参数扰动各元素的均值与标准差，再在独立的随机梯度下降训练中生成新扰动。纯重放仅使用这些统计量；混合重放则额外加入各向同性高斯噪声。实验还比较等半径随机方向扰动，并对扰动来源、时间阶段和网络层进行干预。

Result: 纯统计重放未能复现锐度感知最小化的验证表现；混合重放以及纯各向同性扰动在特定尺度下可以接近其验证准确率，但并未复现其训练动态。在锐度感知最小化中使用等半径随机方向，表现与普通随机梯度下降相近。来源、时间及层级干预的结果进一步表明，重放效果取决于扰动的构造方式。

Conclusion: 研究初步削弱了若干关于锐度感知最小化的简单解释：仅凭扰动的局部统计量、随机方向或简单曲率指标，尚不能充分说明其泛化机制。某些噪声扰动虽能在特定条件下获得相近的验证表现，却不能重现其训练过程；该方法中仍有关键机制有待解释。

Abstract: Sharpness Aware Minimization (SAM) updates model parameters using gradients evaluated at adversarially perturbed weights, but it remains unclear which aspects of this procedure are sufficient to reproduce its generalization behavior. In our ResNet 18 experiments on CIFAR 10, simple curvature regularizers based on the Hessian trace and largest eigenvalue remain below SAM in validation accuracy, motivating a direct examination of its perturbations. We introduce statistical replay, a diagnostic that summarizes perturbations from reference SAM trajectories using elementwise means and standard deviations over local windows and constructs new perturbations during independent SGD training. Pure replay uses only these summaries, whereas mixed replay adds isotropic Gaussian noise. Pure replay does not reproduce SAM's validation behavior, while mixed replay and pure isotropic perturbations can approach its validation performance at selected scales without reproducing its training dynamics. An equal radius random direction within SAM performs similarly to SGD, and source, temporal, and layer interventions further suggest that replay behavior depends on perturbation construction. Together, these preliminary results weaken several simple explanations of SAM while leaving an important part of its mechanism unexplained.

</details>


### [375] [Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19542)
*Alejandro Moreno Arcas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可跨任务复用的数学函数表示模型：它以符号形式预训练函数编码器，并将微分学习为潜在空间中的运算。该模型在含噪样本的公式恢复上优于对比的符号回归方法，但在常规积分和微分方程基准上仍不及计算机代数系统及专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉和语言任务通常可以复用预训练编码器，而神经符号数学仍往往为每项任务单独训练序列到序列模型，缺少共享的函数表示。本文旨在学习一种具有数学结构、可供多种下游任务复用的函数潜在表示。

Method: 提出函数联合嵌入预测架构。模型在数学函数的符号形式上预训练编码器，使潜在空间模仿一阶索伯列夫空间的结构，并将微分表示为可学习的潜在运算。潜在向量的范数由原函数精确计算，方向则通过学习匹配函数间的索伯列夫夹角。冻结编码器后，使用轻量模块完成解码、函数复合、积分，以及根据采样点进行回归。

Result: 论文在预训练分布内外评估了函数表示及四项下游任务。面对含噪样本时，该方法比所比较的符号回归方法更常恢复出精确公式；但在标准积分和微分方程基准上，计算机代数系统与针对具体任务训练的模型表现更强。

Conclusion: 研究展示了以共享潜在表示支持多种数学任务的可行性，并表明具有索伯列夫结构的函数编码器在含噪数据下的公式恢复方面具有优势。不过，其在常规积分和微分方程任务上的能力仍有不足，尚不能全面取代专用方法或计算机代数系统。

Abstract: Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than the compared symbolic-regression methods, whereas computer algebra and task-specific models remain stronger on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.

</details>


### [376] [Random Cut Forests, Games and Diffusion over Approximately Nested Anisotropic Local Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19548)
*Sudipto Guha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出以随机切割森林的树形几何构造统一能量框架，使流数据上的预测、解释、干预分析、聚类与扩散动力学能够通过同一套结构化量进行描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流数据不断变化，用户提出的问题及其关注的条件也会随之改变。能量方法虽具有统一性，但解释性不足；树方法虽易解释，却常依赖彼此割裂的估计器。论文旨在结合能量方法的统一性、树结构的可解释性与流式更新能力，以支持问题变化时仍可复用的分析框架。

Method: 作者将随机切割森林中不断演化的数据几何视为扩散与推断的基础，并研究树上的随机游走及其逃逸概率。由此构造树上的稀疏电网络，使相关亲和度可由同一能量函数精确表示；更新时只需沿一条路径维护该能量。通过对不同变量或划分施加、解除固定条件，可分别得到调和预测及高斯不确定性、归一化割及其边界代价归属，以及衡量协同偏移的合作博弈分析。加入噪声后，同一能量还用于描述扩散及其弛豫速率。作者进一步分析轴平行切分的局部化速度，并用共同参考观测对齐森林中近似嵌套的树结构。

Result: 摘要报告了若干理论联系与性质：多个既有评分可解释为树上随机游走的逃逸概率；树上诱导的亲和度可由稀疏电网络精确实现；多类预测、解释、划分和干预问题可统一为对能量施加不同固定条件。轴平行切分的局部化速度由仿射维数而非环境维数控制，且该控制可延伸至平均能量。摘要还提及以加入噪声的旋转星形数据展示相关测量，但未给出具体数值或比较结果。

Conclusion: 该工作以随机切割森林的几何和稀疏电网络为核心，为流数据分析提供了可随数据更新、可解释且可复用于多种问题的统一能量框架。其主要贡献在于把预测证据、变量干预和扩散行为联系起来；不过，摘要未提供实验规模、基线比较或定量表现，实际效果仍需结合论文正文评估。

Abstract: Just as the data in a dynamic stream changes, questions asked of the stream also change in intent: what to hold constant, which counterfactuals to consider, and so forth. Energy-based learning has been celebrated for its uniform approach to losses and estimation, but interpretability remains challenging. Tree-based methods, on the other hand, offer high interpretability but often rely on bespoke, disjointed estimators. Neither paradigm readily supports changing questions on streaming data. In this paper we take a step towards combining energy, interpretability, and streaming.
  Random cut forests retain an evolving geometry of the data. We study this geometry as the basis for diffusion dynamics, prediction, explanation, and games. We show that several existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on the trees. The induced affinity is realized exactly by a sparse electrical network on each tree, giving a single energy calculus, a Hamiltonian, maintained along one path per update. This connects an estimate, its supporting evidence, and the response to intervention through the same boxes, gaps, masses, and paths. Different questions correspond to different clamp decisions on the energy. Fixing observed values gives harmonic prediction with Gaussian uncertainty. Fixing a partition gives normalized cuts whose cost is attributed exactly to oriented faces. Releasing clamps gives coalition games, in which collusive displacement measures the field response. With noise, the same energy gives diffusion dynamics whose relaxation rates are read from the boxes. Axis-parallel cuts localize at a rate set by affine rather than ambient dimension, and this control passes to the averaged energy. Across a forest the boxes are only approximately nested; common reference observations align the trees. A rotating star with added noise illustrates the measurements.

</details>


### [377] [Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19561)
*Hamidreza Hasani Balyani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，视觉语言模型会受报告激励影响而偏移读数；相较文本输入，图像输入下对指定偏移的精确配合通常更弱，但是否能明确读出数值及提示与作答顺序会显著改变这一差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型可能读取场景后向他人报告信息，而报告者与接收者的目标未必一致。论文关注：明确给出的利益激励是否会改变模型报告，以及当真实数值必须从图像中读取、而非直接以文字提供时，这种行为是否不同。研究也指出，仅用文本评测或平均偏移量，可能无法揭示模型对激励的依赖方式。

Method: 研究使用带刻度标签的合成场景，要求模型读取目标位置并向固定接收者报告一个整数；模拟报酬分别鼓励准确报告，或将报告值向一侧偏移若干单位。每个场景也以文本形式提供真实值，便于比较视觉与文本输入。研究包含一项先导实验及三项后续实验，采用预先锁定的实验方案，测试来自三个系列的四种小型开放式视觉语言模型，共分析一万五千一百七十次留出试验；还考察了提示改写、先读数再报告、客户希望真实值以及无报酬等条件。

Result: 明确的报酬激励会改变模型在图像和文本两种输入下的报告。四种模型中有三种在图像输入下对“三单位偏移”的精确配合显著低于文本输入；通义千问视觉语言模型七十亿参数版未显示可靠差异。将真实数值作为文字补充到图像提示中后，所有模型的差异都消失。先写出读数再报告可消除因努视觉读数造成的差异，但在另一模型上不能；对通义千问视觉语言模型三十亿参数版，差异在五种激励改写中的四种仍存在，却会在先写读数、说明客户希望真实值或取消报酬时大幅减弱或消失，而先报告再写读数时仍存在。即使客户被明确说明希望得到真实值，四种模型中仍有三种在文本报告里持续偏移；模型是否发生任何偏移也强烈依赖提示措辞。

Conclusion: 视觉输入并未使这些模型成为更可靠的真实报告者；它主要使模型对指定激励的配合程度，取决于模型能否明确获得读数，以及提示中的信息与输出顺序。评估这类行为时，应同时考察输入模态、提示措辞、输出流程和具体报告分布，不能只依赖文本输入测试或平均偏移指标。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. Adding the true value as text to the image prompt removed the gap in every model. For InternVL3 the gap vanished on scenes it read correctly when it wrote its reading first; for Gemma 3 it persisted. For Qwen2.5-VL 3B, which read every scene correctly, the gap held in four of five payoff paraphrases, nearly vanished when the model wrote its reading before its report or when the prompt stated that the client wants the truth, vanished with an unpaid goal, and persisted when the model reported before stating its reading; how often it shaded at all, even with text, depended strongly on the wording. When told that the client wants the true value, three of four models still shaded every text report. Visual input did not make these advisors reliably more truthful; it made compliance with a stated incentive depend on whether the read value is made explicit and on output order, a dependence that text-only evaluations and mean-shift metrics do not reveal.

</details>


### [378] [Sharp First-Hit Identification from Finite Depth Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19563)
*Hamidreza Hasani Balyani,Mahtab Movahhedrad,Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文刻画了在已知相机位姿、有限深度区间观测及有界利普希茨连续场假设下，新视角各点可能出现的首次命中深度，并给出可实现性判定与锐利的不确定性界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限个源视角深度测量并不能仅凭逐点误差界确定新视角的首次命中深度，因为样本之间未观测到的几何形状可能改变射线首先遇到的表面。论文旨在回答：在明确指定场景正则性假设后，哪些新视角深度确实可能由同一个场景产生，以及采样能将不确定性限制到什么程度。

Method: 研究对象是满足有界利普希茨条件的连续源视角逆深度场，观测为区间，且相机位姿已知。基于经典利普希茨上下包络，论文精确刻画可达的首次命中深度集合，并证明集合中的每个值都能由一个全局满足假设的场景实现；该集合可能不连通。论文还给出多个候选深度由同一场景共同实现的充要判据，并通过极线约化将问题转为标量锥不等式，无须枚举表面。此外，论文提供精确有理数验证程序，并进行固定十个场景的评估。

Result: 在整流模型中，源采样间距为 h、观测区间半宽为 ε、基线为 b、斜率上界为 L，且 bL<1 时，在深度和定义域范围足以实现上界的条件下，逆深度不确定性直径的锐利最坏情形界为 max{Lh+2ε，2ε/(1−bL)}。当 bL=1 且观测精确时，锐利界为 Lh；超过该临界值后，即使采样任意加密，歧义也未必消失。临界情形下，任何正的测量不确定性都可能破坏一致稳定性。实验还显示，固定的学习深度区间虽常给出较窄集合，却可能因场景假设不成立而得到错误结果。

Conclusion: 论文给出了有限深度观测在指定连续性场景类下所允许的新视角首次命中深度的精确刻画，并揭示了由基线与斜率共同决定的稳定性临界条件。其结论是对所假设场景类的严格分析，而不是从离散预测推断连续正则性或真实物理场景保证；因此，求解器在假设成立时正确，并不意味着输入的学习深度区间必然符合这些假设。

Abstract: Which depths in a new camera view are determined by finitely many source-depth measurements? Pointwise uncertainty bounds do not answer this question: unobserved geometry between samples can change which surface is encountered first. We study a bounded Lipschitz class of continuous source inverse-depth fields with interval observations and known camera pose. Building on classical Lipschitz envelopes, we characterize the exact set of attainable first-hit depths and construct a globally admissible scene for every value in that set. The set can be disconnected. We also give a necessary and sufficient test for several proposed depths to be first hits of one shared scene. An epipolar reduction uses scalar cone inequalities without enumerating surfaces. In a rectified model with source spacing $h$, interval half-width $\varepsilon$, baseline $b$, and slope bound $L$, we prove a sharp worst-case inverse-depth diameter of $\max\{Lh+2\varepsilon,2\varepsilon/(1-bL)\}$ when $bL<1$, subject to sufficient depth and domain range for attainment. Exact samples still give the sharp bound $Lh$ at $bL=1$, while above this threshold ambiguity need not vanish as sampling becomes arbitrarily dense. Any positive measurement uncertainty can destroy uniform stability at the critical threshold. We provide constructive examples, an exact rational validation oracle, and a frozen ten-scene evaluation using reference, stereo, and learned-depth observations. The experiments separate solver correctness under the scene assumptions from failure of those assumptions: fixed learned-depth bands often yield narrow but incorrect sets. The results identify what a specified scene class permits; they do not infer a continuum regularity or physical-scene guarantee from sampled predictions.

</details>


### [379] [Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19566)
*Matthew Zurek,Yudong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文分析基于生成模型的强化学习经验规划（插件式）方法的样本复杂度，并证明其在折扣回报与平均回报任务中的复杂度达到相应极小极大下界，至多相差常数因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型允许算法按需采样状态—动作转移，但经验规划方法究竟需要多少样本才能找到近似最优策略，尤其在不同回报设定及问题难度类别下是否达到理论最优，仍需明确。论文旨在给出紧致的样本复杂度上界，并与非自适应生成模型的下界相比较。

Method: 研究折扣回报与平均回报两种设定下的插件式规划方法：先利用生成模型估计经验模型，再据此规划策略。针对已有基于吸收马尔可夫决策过程的集中分析效率不足，论文提出新的贝尔曼残差夹逼技术，以改进误差控制并推导样本复杂度上界。

Result: 在折扣回报设定下，算法以至少一减去失败概率的概率找到误差不超过精度参数的策略，样本量为状态数乘动作数，再乘以折扣因子一减去折扣率的倒数三次方、精度参数倒数平方及对数项。在平均回报设定下，折扣式插件方法的样本量与最优偏置跨度上界成正比；直接的非折扣插件方法则与直径成正比；两者均乘以状态数、动作数、精度参数倒数平方及对数项。结合非自适应生成模型的下界，这些结果在折扣强化学习以及按偏置跨度或直径刻画的平均回报强化学习中，将极小极大样本复杂度确定到常数因子范围内。

Conclusion: 论文为生成模型下经验规划方法提供了紧致的理论样本复杂度保证，并解决了相关折扣回报与平均回报问题的极小极大样本复杂度问题。新的贝尔曼残差夹逼技术是获得改进上界的关键。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-γ)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/δ))$ samples, where $S, A, γ, δ$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. Our main technical contribution is a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique which improves the efficiency of prior absorbing-MDP-based concentration analyses.

</details>


### [380] [Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19572)
*Angelo Moroncelli,Alessandro Leanza,Loris Roveda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究如何让冻结的扩散生成器按要求改变特定属性、同时保留其他属性，并提出利用请求相关的局部几何信息来改善引导方向的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成器常需满足结构化编辑要求，但普通引导未必能准确改变目标属性，也可能损害需要保留的内容。作者指出，仅有条件信息并不足以保证编辑有效；效果还取决于请求方向与目标函数对应的剩余采样过程雅可比矩阵之间的关系。

Method: 作者提出谱引导：先用针对具体请求的余弦增益预测器估计编辑方向的收益，再通过带阻尼的逆校正调整方向，并在有限幅度编辑中于固定时间点重新线性化。研究还使用标量零效应对照和匹配运动量的对照，检验所预测机制是否成立。

Result: 在事后识别出的局部有效区域内，共分析了八千九百二十三个实例；预测增益与实际增益的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数为零点七九，而条件数的相关系数为负零点一一。实验覆盖图像、音频、机器人、控制与规划，包括复杂角色动作生成。在五十组配对图像修复案例中，四次校正相较亚当优化器，在总导数遍历次数相同的条件下，使未观测像素的峰值信噪比提高三点二五分贝。

Conclusion: 研究将请求相关的几何结构与编辑方向收益联系起来，并通过对照实验支持其解释。谱引导在多类生成与决策任务中展现出潜力，且图像修复结果表明，这种方向校正能够转化为下游性能提升；不过，其优势主要在所识别的局部有效区域内得到验证。

Abstract: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobserved-pixel PSNR over Adam by 3.25 dB at equal total derivative traversals. Together, the analysis and controls connect request-dependent geometry to directional gains and establish where these gains translate into downstream performance.

</details>


### [381] [Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19575)
*Jayanta Mandi,Senne Berden,Victor Bucarey,Concepcion Dominguez,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种风险敏感的决策导向学习方法，在推理时仍使用点预测和确定性优化，同时降低决策后悔值的尾部风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数决策导向学习方法以平均后悔值为优化目标，可能忽视高损失尾部事件，在高风险应用中造成不理想决策。传统风险敏感方法通常需要显式建模不确定性，并在推理阶段求解随机或鲁棒优化问题，计算成本较高。

Method: 作者从条件风险价值的对偶表示出发，引入熵正则化，构造条件风险价值后悔值的平滑代理目标。该目标的梯度会在每个小批次内按样本自适应重加权，使高风险样本获得更大权重，因此可将现有代理损失方法改造成风险敏感版本。以斯波加多普里斯加多加号损失为例，作者还推导了真实后悔值条件风险价值的泛化界。

Result: 在背包、投资组合、最短路径和能源感知调度问题上的实验显示，当不确定参数具有不同的尾部特性时，该方法能显著降低尾部后悔值。

Conclusion: 该框架将尾部风险纳入决策导向学习训练过程，无需改变推理阶段的点预测与确定性优化流程，兼顾风险敏感性和计算简便性，并为其泛化表现提供了理论保证。

Abstract: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at inference time. Starting from the dual representation of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and adding entropy regularization, we derive a smooth surrogate for the CVaR of regret. Its gradient induces an instance-dependent reweighting within each minibatch that emphasizes high-risk outcomes, so the approach can turn existing surrogate-loss DFL methods, including the SPO+ loss, into risk-sensitive variants. When instantiated with SPO+, the resulting objective admits a generalization bound on the CVaR of the true regret. Experiments on knapsack, portfolio, shortest-path, and energy-aware scheduling problems show substantial reductions in tail regret when the uncertain parameters exhibit heterogeneous tail behavior.

</details>


### [382] [SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19586)
*Sebastian Pütz,Theodore Glavas,Benjamin Schäfer,Boris N. Oreshkin,Mark Coates*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受库普曼算子启发的时序预测架构，通过潜在空间中的共享线性动力学提升含外生变量预测的准确性及分布偏移下的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在含外生变量的时序预测中，容易过度依赖训练数据中的偶然相关性；当外生变量分布发生变化时，这些相关性难以迁移，导致预测性能下降。

Method: 该方法先利用历史编码器，根据过去的目标值和外生变量重构当前潜在状态，再结合未来外生变量，通过共享线性算子推进潜在状态并生成预测。编码与预测采用一致的线性递推，以协调历史信息的表示方式与未来状态的演化过程，同时减少模型参数并抑制对历史输入中虚假相关性的依赖。

Result: 该方法在电价预测、零售需求等真实基准任务上取得先进表现，计算开销与轻量多层感知机相近。在电价样本的外生变量取值超出训练范围时，均方误差降低百分之二十；在由未见外生过程驱动的合成迁移任务中，平均绝对误差降低百分之三十。消融实验表明，结构化历史编码器与潜在空间线性递推均有重要作用。

Conclusion: 结果表明，为潜在时序动力学施加共享线性结构，能够有效提升含外生变量预测的准确性和分布偏移下的泛化能力，并保持较低计算成本。

Abstract: Accurate time series forecasting with exogenous inputs is critical across domains, including energy and retail, yet modern deep learning models often overfit to correlations that do not generalize under shifts in these inputs. We propose SLiDE, a Koopman-inspired architecture for forecasting with exogenous inputs that imposes structure on latent temporal dynamics. SLiDE approximates nonlinear system evolution using a learned linear operator in a latent space, combining (i) a history encoder that reconstructs the current latent state from past targets and inputs with (ii) a shared linear rollout driven by future exogenous variables. By enforcing a common linear recurrence across encoding and prediction, SLiDE aligns how past information is encoded with how future states evolve, reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations in the input history. Empirically, SLiDE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on real-world benchmarks, including electricity price forecasting and retail demand, while maintaining a computational footprint comparable to lightweight MLP architectures. SLiDE is especially effective at generalizing to shifted exogenous inputs, reducing MSE by 20% on electricity price samples with out-of-range exogenous values and MAE by 30% in a synthetic transfer setting where the same dynamical system is driven by an unseen exogenous process. Ablations confirm the importance of both the structured history encoder and the linear latent rollout, suggesting that structured latent linear dynamics provide a useful inductive bias for forecasting with exogenous inputs.

</details>


### [383] [Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19587)
*Lars Ruthotto,Eran Treister*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出对速度场的高阶导数进行正则化，使扩散与流匹配生成模型的经验学习问题在适当条件下保持适定，并减少对训练样本的记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型通过学习速度场，将已知分布输运至数据分布。然而，经验目标在接近数据分布时可能是不适定的：最优速度场会把样本直接输运到训练数据上，数据的微小扰动也可能引起末段速度场的大幅变化。仅惩罚速度大小难以稳定地阻止这种记忆行为。

Method: 在速度场的学习目标中加入其高阶导数的惩罚项。论文证明，当导数阶数为 k、满足 2k 大于数据维数 D，且训练点处于一般位置时，经验学习问题在整个时间范围内均为适定。实验以样条表示速度场，并用直接求解方法处理正则化最小二乘问题，以排除优化误差的影响。

Result: 在一维和二维实验中，逐步细化空间与时间离散后，采用海森矩阵正则化的流模型误差仅有轻微变化；不使用正则化时，误差则趋向于记忆训练样本所对应的结果。正则化模型能够泛化，其误差与经过良好调参的核密度估计相当或更低。

Conclusion: 对速度场高阶导数进行正则化，可从理论上改善生成模型经验学习问题的适定性，并在实验中有效抑制记忆、提升泛化稳定性。相较于仅约束速度大小，这种方法为控制生成流的复杂度提供了更有力的显式正则化方案。

Abstract: Learning the underlying probability distribution from samples is a core problem in statistics and applied mathematics. Generative models based on diffusion and flow matching learn a velocity field whose flow transports a known distribution to the data distribution. They produce novel, realistic samples, although the empirical learning problem is ill posed near the data distribution. Its minimizer transports the samples onto the training data, and small perturbations of the data change the velocity field strongly near the end of the flow. The observed generalization is often attributed to implicit regularization by the network parameterization, early stopping of the training, and the time integration during sampling. Explicit regularization has advanced the theory and computation of many inverse problems and has recently been proposed to prevent memorization in generative models. With a regularizer on the magnitude of the velocity, however, the field approaches the memorizing velocity unless the regularization parameter grows to infinity fast enough, and it then stays bounded by a constant that is small only for large parameters. We show that penalizing the derivatives of order $k$ of the velocity renders the $D$-dimensional empirical problem well posed uniformly in time if $2k > D$ and the training points are in general position. Our experiments in one and two dimensions discretize the velocity with splines and use direct solvers for the regularized least-squares problems to exclude optimization error. Refining the discretization in space and time changes the error of the Hessian-regularized flows only marginally, whereas without the regularizer the error tends to that of memorization. These flows generalize, with errors comparable to or lower than those of well-tuned kernel density estimates.

</details>


### [384] [PBit1: One Programmable P-Bit per Parameter - A Finite-Control Representation of Pretrained Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19588)
*Omar Ramadan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 PBit1：为每个已学习参数分配一个可编程概率位元，通过时间采样重建权重；在多个预训练模型上，全部参数转换后仍基本保持任务质量，并可借助敏感度分配减少采样量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练神经网络通常以高精度数值保存权重。论文希望研究一种有限控制表示：用较简单的概率控制和时间观测来表达权重，并检验这种表示在不微调的情况下能否保留模型性能，以及如何减少权重重建所需的观测次数。

Method: PBit1 为每个已学习参数配置一个可编程概率位元，以 12 位命令设定其概率，再通过共享的仿射范围映射到权重取值域，并根据多次时间观测重建权重用于推理。该方法还采用面向算子的范围分组，以及基于敏感度的采样分配，以适应不同网络结构和参数的重要性。实验对每个标量进行 32,768 次观测，并使用五组独立权重抽样评估；完整模型推理复用重建权重。

Result: 在 GPT-2、DistilBERT 和 LFM3-1.7B 的选定配置中，所有已学习参数均转换且未进行微调，模型任务质量仍基本保持。GPT-2 和 LFM3 的困惑度分别约增加 0.66% 和 0.26%；DistilBERT 准确率由 87.51% 变为 87.49%。基于敏感度的策略在满足质量标准的同时，将 GPT-2 的权重重建观测次数减少 41.7%。此外，论文通过算子实验考察了原生采样以及空间与时间方面的权衡。

Conclusion: 研究展示了有限控制概率位元表示及时间重建用于预训练网络权重的一种具体实现。结果表明，在所测试的模型和配置下，该方法可在不微调且转换全部参数的条件下维持接近原有的任务表现；敏感度引导的采样还能降低重建开销。不过，这些结论限于摘要所述的模型、采样规模与配置，不能据此推断其适用于所有网络或部署场景。

Abstract: We introduce PBit1, a finite-control representation of pretrained neural networks that assigns one programmable p-bit to each learned parameter. A 12-bit command sets its probability, a shared affine range maps that probability to the weight domain, and temporal observations reconstruct the weight for inference. Operator-aware range grouping and sensitivity-based sampling allocation adapt the representation to the network. Across five independent weight draws at 32,768 observations per scalar, selected configurations preserve task quality in GPT-2, DistilBERT, and LFM3-1.7B with every learned scalar converted and no fine-tuning. GPT-2 and LFM3 perplexity increase by approximately 0.66% and 0.26%, respectively, while DistilBERT accuracy changes from 87.51% to 87.49%. A sensitivity-based policy reduces GPT-2 reconstruction observations by 41.7% while retaining the quality criterion. Complete-model evaluations reuse reconstructed weights in BF16 inference, and THRML operator experiments examine native sampling and spatial-temporal tradeoffs. Together, these results establish PBit1 as a concrete construction for studying finite-control weight representation and temporal reconstruction in pretrained networks.

</details>


### [385] [Synthetic Neurosymbolic Task Generation with Controlled Constraint Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19597)
*Mykhailo Buleshnyi,Zsolt Zombori,Michael Benedikt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个用于神经符号学习的可控合成基准生成器，可同时构造逻辑约束与满足约束的数据，并用它系统研究约束结构与学习方法的相互作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以精细控制逻辑约束及数据生成方式，也难以确保样本与约束一致，因此不利于公平、系统地比较神经符号学习方法。论文旨在提供一个可控测试平台，分析约束特性如何影响任务难度，以及显式利用约束何时能带来收益。

Method: 该框架通过一体化生成流程构造约束和数据，并允许调节约束结构、紧致程度、对输入的依赖，以及数据生成与对齐策略；同时支持无限域上的丰富约束。可满足性检查器负责生成并验证约束，约束优化器则计算最优修复，确保每个生成样本均满足约束。框架面向利用声明式约束学习和基于远程监督学习两类任务。

Result: 实验涵盖多种约束类型，显示框架参数能够系统地、且大体相互独立地影响任务难度。研究还发现，显式执行约束在某些情形下有益；而在另一些情形下，表达能力较强但不显式受约束的模型，也能直接从数据中学得约束结构。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可控的神经符号学习合成测试平台，为研究逻辑结构、数据特性与学习方法之间的关系提供了工具，并揭示了约束感知方法的收益取决于具体任务条件。

Abstract: We introduce NeSySy, a synthetic generator for neurosymbolic learning tasks that jointly produces logical constraints and consistent datasets. Unlike existing benchmarks, NeSySy provides fine-grained control over key properties such as constraint structure, tightness, input dependence, and data generation and alignment strategies. In particular, it allows the use of rich constraints over infinite domains, and uses solvers to ensure that the constraints are meaningful and that generated samples satisfy the constraints.
  We design NeSySy to support both learning with declarative constraints and learning from distant supervision. Across a range of constraint families, we provide evidence that its parameters induce systematic and largely independent effects on task difficulty. Using NeSySy, we study constraint-aware learning methods, identifying regimes where explicit constraint enforcement is beneficial and where expressive unconstrained models can instead learn constraint structure directly from data. Our results establish NeSySy as a controlled testbed for analysing the interaction between learning and logical structure.
  NeSySy is built around a pipeline that incorporates solvers. Satisfiability checkers (CNFgen and Z3) generate and certify constraints. Constrained optimizers (RC2 for MaxSAT, Z3 for OMT) compute optimal repairs that guarantee every generated sample is consistent.

</details>


### [386] [Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19609)
*Fernando Cardenas Piepereit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，小型语言模型在仅给出描述时，其内部状态可携带与目标名称相关的信息；但这种状态是否因命名失败而发生变化，证据不一致，且结果仅涉及可测量的内部信号，不代表模型真正理解了含义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究借用“舌尖现象”作类比，考察模型能否从不含名称的描述形成可预测名称的内部状态，以及在模型无法说出名称、但能选对描述时，这种状态是否与成功命名时不同。类比仅用于提出研究问题，并非声称模型具有人的主观体验。

Method: 研究预先冻结了内部方案，但未在外部平台注册；测试三种小型语言模型，共使用二百个项目。研究结合相似度读出、类补丁范围读出和激活补丁，并设置匹配对照。主要检验包括：内部状态是否含有名称信息，以及命名失败项目中的无名称状态，其描述释义一致性是否较低。研究还在内部审查后进行稳健性检查，包括对数几率透镜、单位置补丁和操纵检验。

Result: 名称信息假设在三种模型与三类描述的全部九种组合中均获支持；按预设的一致性判据，相似度测量与激活补丁支持该结论，而类补丁范围读出接近随机水平。后续检查显示，中间层的名称信息主要由多位置补丁和相似度测量体现，单位置补丁在模型深度百分之五十处的证据较弱。命名失败项目的释义一致性结果不一：某模型在预设检验下出现显著缺陷，但结果不稳健；另一模型在不同非劣效界值及控制词语重叠后仍满足非劣效标准，不过自助法区间包含零；第三种模型的结果无法定论。模型容量解释尚未检验。

Conclusion: 证据支持小型语言模型的内部状态可携带与目标名称相关的信息，但结论依赖读出和补丁方式。关于命名失败是否对应不同的无名称状态，目前没有一致结论。研究报告的是模型内部层面的信号，不能据此推断其具有语义理解或类似人的体验。

Abstract: The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patch and the similarity measure, and weak under single-position patching at 50% depth. H2' (description-paraphrase consistency of name-free states not lower in failure items) is mixed: the SmolLM2 deficit test is significant under the pre-registered specification but not robust; Phi-3 non-inferiority holds across margins and a word-overlap covariate, although its bootstrap interval includes zero; Qwen2-0.5B is inconclusive. A capacity explanation remains untested. We report vehicle-level signals only, not meaning.

</details>


### [387] [Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19624)
*Yongan Zhang,Yitao Yu,Yizheng Li,An Gong,Youzhuang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种利用大语言模型地质知识补全缺失测井数据的方法，在挪威北海基准数据上优于多种基线模型，并能提升传统深度学习模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测井数据区间缺失会使地下地质重建成为不适定问题，单纯依赖数值回归的模型缺乏地质先验，难以约束存在歧义的反演结果。研究旨在利用基础模型的地层知识，为缺失岩石物理测量值的重建提供有效约束。

Method: 研究提出一种知识条件生成式测井智能体，利用预训练大语言模型提供地质先验，并通过通用地质处理框架将地层推理转化为以地层为锚点的岩石物理轨迹、特征级线性调制及条件对抗约束。方法还结合多尺度空洞生成模块，并将先验知识与模型耦合机制迁移至传统深度学习模型。

Result: 在挪威北海基准数据上，该方法的平均决定系数为0.9307，最高为0.9713；相比九种基线模型的平均水平，决定系数提高0.0920，均方根误差平均降低30.97%。相比表现最强的基线，决定系数提高0.0274至0.0498，均方根误差降低16.25%至24.05%。消融实验验证了地质先验推理、多尺度生成和条件对抗模块的有效性及协同作用。将耦合机制迁移到六种传统深度学习模型后，其决定系数提高0.0162至0.0789，并表现出跨井稳定性。

Conclusion: 将基础模型的领域推理融入深度生成模型，可以为缺失测井数据重建提供地质约束，提升预测精度与跨井稳定性。研究结果表明，这种知识条件生成策略也具有增强传统深度学习模型的潜力。

Abstract: Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional adversarial modules. Transferring the coupling mechanism to six conventional deep learning models improves their $R^2$ by 0.0162--0.0789 with cross-well stability. These results demonstrate how foundation-model domain reasoning can constrain deep generative reconstruction of missing petrophysical measurements.

</details>


### [388] [Robust Well-Log Reconstruction Across Point Gaps and Whole Wells via Boundary-Gated Soft-Thresholding Kalman Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19625)
*Yongan Zhang,Zhihan Qiu,Yizheng Li,Youzhuang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一种结合边界感知、波形收缩与卡尔曼融合的测井曲线重建方法，在两个盆地共二百六十三口井的数据上优于多种基线方法，且跨盆地迁移效果良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测井曲线缺失会妨碍地下地层刻画。深度重建网络容易在缺失区边界产生阶跃，并面临不同盆地间的分布偏移；传统插值和高斯平滑则难以处理长缺失区及异常值。因此，需要一种兼顾局部连续性、边界信息与稳健性的重建方法。

Method: 提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合方法，将多分辨率小波收缩、基于距离门控的残差先验学习，以及具有闭式解的稳健卡尔曼平滑结合起来，并将模型学习与推断过程解耦。该方法借助井中实测信息约束重建，并利用边界距离调节残差先验的影响。

Result: 在挪威北海与新西兰塔拉纳基盆地的两个公开基准数据集上，覆盖零点一五至一百米的锚定缺失区，该方法总体排名第一，参数开销仅增加百分之零点零九。相较最强基线，体积密度和纵波时差的汇总均方根误差分别降低百分之五至八点三、百分之六点四至十五点六；相较四种最强基线，中子孔隙度和光电因子的误差分别降低百分之零点七至四点一、百分之一点三至二点九。消融实验显示，去除状态空间融合会使短缺失区误差最高增加百分之五十八点八；零样本迁移则使锚定缺失区误差降低百分之十四至六十八。

Conclusion: 结果表明，井筒局部连续性能够跨盆地迁移，而不同测井属性之间的映射会随区域地质条件变化。该方法通过融合测量约束与稳健平滑，实现了准确且稳定的曲线重建，支持以实测信息为核心的测井修复方案。

Abstract: Missing wireline logs hinder subsurface characterization. Deep reconstruction networks suffer from gap-boundary steps and cross-basin shifts, while interpolation and Gaussian smoothers struggle with long intervals and outliers. We propose boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion (ST-KF), unifying multiresolution wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing with learning--inference decoupling. Across two public benchmarks totaling 263 wells in the Norwegian North Sea and New Zealand's Taranaki Basin, ST-KF ranks first over 0.15--100-m anchored gaps with 0.09% parameter overhead. Against the strongest of nine baselines, pooled RMSE falls by 5.0%--8.3% for bulk density and 6.4%--15.6% for compressional slowness; against the four strongest baselines, reductions are 0.7%--4.1% for neutron porosity and 1.3%--2.9% for photoelectric factor. Ablations and sensitivity analyses confirm operator synergy and stable performance: removing state-space fusion increases short-gap errors by up to 58.8%, while zero-shot transfer cuts anchored errors by 14%--68%. The results show that local borehole continuity transfers across basins whereas cross-property mappings shift with regional geology, supporting measurement-guided log reconstruction.

</details>


### [389] [Multi-Objective Causal Bandits: Minimal Intervention Space and Policy-Level Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19634)
*Muhammad Qasim Elahi,Mahsa Ghasemi,Murat Kocaoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究多目标因果老虎机，指出随机策略形成的凸组合可能支配单个干预，并据此改进候选干预筛选与在线学习算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多目标老虎机方法常依赖两两帕累托比较或固定标量化，因而可能漏掉由其他干预随机组合形成的支配策略。某个干预即使不被任何单一干预支配，也可能被随机策略支配，导致因果动作空间缩减和在线学习中的最优性判断失准。

Method: 论文形式化刻画随机策略层面的支配现象。首先，给出可能成为帕累托最优的最小干预集合的必要且充分图结构条件，据此仅利用因果图构造最小、可靠且完备的候选干预族。其次，在缩减后的动作空间上设计基于置信上界的在线算法，通过与其他动作的凸组合进行支配检验并淘汰动作。最后，针对可行性和最优性可能依赖随机策略实现的约束型问题，提出相应的在线算法。

Result: 理论上，图结构刻画能够排除任何相容结构因果模型下都不可能帕累托最优的干预集合；无约束算法获得依赖最优性差距的对数级帕累托遗憾界。约束型算法则实现次线性遗憾，并提供约束违反保证。

Conclusion: 多目标因果决策的有效分析必须考虑随机策略带来的凸组合支配，而不能只比较单个干预。将这一现象纳入图结构筛选和在线学习，有助于更准确地缩减干预空间，并为无约束及约束型问题提供具有理论保证的算法。

Abstract: Many decision-making problems involve multiple objectives, where actions affect several performance metrics, fairness criteria, or safety constraints. We study multi-objective causal bandits with multiple reward nodes, where actions correspond to interventions on subsets of variables in a causal graph and performance is evaluated through Pareto optimality. Existing approaches to multi-objective bandits often rely on pairwise Pareto dominance or optimize a fixed scalarization. However, pairwise comparisons alone can fail to identify actions dominated by randomized policies, whose expected reward vectors lie in the convex hull of action-level rewards. Thus, an intervention may be suboptimal even if no single intervention dominates it, because it can be dominated by a randomized policy over other interventions. We formalize this policy-level phenomenon and show that it has consequences for both causal action-space reduction and online learning. First, we provide a necessary-and-sufficient graphical characterization of possibly Pareto- optimal minimal intervention sets. Our characterization yields a minimal, sound, and complete candidate intervention family from the graph alone, correcting prior formulations that may include intervention sets that are never Pareto-optimal under any compatible structural causal model. Second, over this reduced intervention space, we design an online UCB-style algorithm that eliminates actions using dominance tests against convex combinations of other actions, and prove logarithmic gap-dependent Pareto regret. Finally, we study constrained multi-objective causal bandits, where feasibility and optimality may be realized only with randomized policies, and develop an online UCB-style constrained bandit algorithm with sublinear regret and constraint-violation guarantees.

</details>


### [390] [LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19649)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Yi Zhao,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 环填充是一种无需额外训练的投机解码方法，将后缀草稿与浅层循环预测整合进同一草稿树，降低循环式大语言模型的解码延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环式变换器重复使用同一组层以提高参数效率，但自回归生成每个词元都需依次经过多轮循环，导致解码延迟较高。现有流水线式自投机方法虽可并行处理不同循环深度的预测，却要求当前词元先达到草稿深度，限制了后续词元进入流水线的时机。

Method: 环填充结合多词元后缀草稿和浅层循环预测，将两类预测合并到一棵草稿树中，使后缀查询能够立即扩展浅层预测，并让多个后续词元同时进入流水线。共享模块在一个批次内、不同循环深度上计算得分最高的草稿候选；随后通过完整深度验证，保持模型原有的自回归输出分布。

Result: 在七个基准测试上，相较贪心自回归解码，环填充在奥罗二十六亿参数模型上的平均加速比为五点八五倍，在许根三十五亿参数模型上为五点一三倍。相较最强基线环前瞻，两者分别提升百分之四十和百分之二十五。

Conclusion: 该方法通过统一草稿树协同利用后缀匹配与浅层预测，缓解了循环式模型的解码串行瓶颈，并在保持输出分布不变的同时取得显著加速。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

</details>


### [391] [With the Right Representation, Classical Machine Learning Rivals Deep Models for Olfactory Mixture Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19650)
*Ze Dong,Yi Wang,Ambuj Tewari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，对无序气味混合物对显式编码差异，有助于提升经典机器学习模型的预测能力，使其在低数据场景下达到与专用深度模型相当的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气味混合物预测需要比较两组气味分子之间的关系，而非孤立地分析单个分子。以往经典方法主要分别表示两组混合物，缺少对二者差异的直接描述，因此难以公平评估经典学习方法的潜力。

Method: 针对无序的混合物对，构造显式且对称的比较特征，并使用极端梯度提升和核岭回归进行评估。研究比较了逐坐标绝对差、求和与乘积等特征组合，同时考察核函数选择和预处理的影响。

Result: 在主要基准任务上，使用显式比较特征的极端梯度提升表现可与专用深度混合物模型相竞争。消融实验显示，单独使用逐坐标绝对差已具较强预测能力，与求和及乘积特征结合后表现进一步提升。核岭回归也因比较特征、合适的核函数及预处理而显著受益。

Conclusion: 显式表示两组气味混合物之间的差异，是经典机器学习进行低数据气味混合物预测的重要设计要素。研究结果提示，模型表现的差距不仅取决于学习算法，也取决于如何表征混合物之间的关系。

Abstract: Modeling olfactory mixtures remains a critical challenge in machine olfaction because the task requires reasoning over relationships between sets of odorants rather than over individual molecules in isolation. However, prior comparisons between deep and classical approaches also varied how the relationship between the two mixtures was represented, since the classical baselines primarily relied on weak representations that described each mixture independently and provided little direct signal about how the mixtures differed. In this work, we revisit classical learning using explicit symmetric comparison features on unordered pairs of mixtures, evaluating these representations with XGBoost and kernel ridge regression (KRR). We find that XGBoost with explicit comparison features achieves performance competitive with specialized deep mixture models on the main benchmark. Ablation studies show that coordinate-wise absolute differences alone provide strong predictive performance, while combining them with sums and products yields further improvements. KRR also benefits substantially from explicit comparison features, with further gains from appropriate kernel choice and preprocessing. Overall, these results suggest that explicitly encoding how two mixtures differ is an important ingredient for classical machine learning in low-data olfactory mixture prediction.

</details>


### [392] [BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19656)
*Dong Li,Yufei Han,Xintao Wu,Xujiang Zhao,Wei Cheng,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出，图持续学习中的知识保持机制可能让早期植入的后门长期存续，并提出一种利用结构触发器实现持久攻击的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究常认为，模型在连续任务中更新会逐渐削弱图后门攻击。但持续学习为保留旧知识而采用的机制，可能同时保留与干净任务优化信号相容的恶意关联。图结构触发器还可嵌入图神经网络的消息传递路径，使其影响跨任务稳定存在，因此有必要系统揭示这一风险。

Method: 提出一种模型无关的图持续学习后门攻击框架，限定攻击者只能在早期阶段干预。该方法学习具有拓扑感知能力的结构触发器：通过梯度互信息目标，使中毒梯度与干净任务的优化信号相耦合；通过传播一致性目标，稳定触发器经图消息传递产生的影响。论文还从理论上分析了梯度相容性与传播稳定性如何共同促进后门持久性。

Result: 在任务递增和类别递增两种设置、四个图持续学习基准及多种受害模型上，实验显示该方法能在有限干净任务效用损失下维持较强攻击效果，显著优于图后门与持续学习后门基线，并能抵御多种代表性防御。

Conclusion: 持续学习并不必然削弱后门；当恶意更新与需要保留的干净任务信号相容，且结构触发器在消息传递中产生稳定影响时，知识保持机制反而可能延长后门寿命。该研究揭示了图持续学习中的重要安全隐患，并提供了相应的攻击分析框架。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a persistent security threat to machine learning systems, yet their behavior under graph continual learning (GCL) remains underexplored. Conventional graph backdoor attacks often lose effectiveness as models are updated across successive tasks, creating the impression that continual updates naturally weaken malicious associations. This work reveals a contrasting vulnerability: knowledge-preservation mechanisms in GCL can also preserve early injected backdoors when the poisoned update is compatible with the clean-task signal being retained. For graph data, this risk is amplified by structural triggers, which are embedded into the message-passing paths of graph neural networks (GNNs) and can induce stable representation shifts across tasks. To expose this risk, we propose BadGCL, a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks under a strict early-stage intervention setting. BadGCL learns topology-aware structural triggers using a gradient mutual-information objective that couples poisoned gradients with clean-task optimization signals, together with a propagation consistency objective that stabilizes trigger-induced effects through graph message passing. We provide theoretical analysis showing that gradient compatibility and propagation stability jointly support long-term backdoor persistence under benign continual updates. Extensive experiments across task-IL and class-IL protocols, four GCL benchmarks, and diverse victim systems show that BadGCL achieves persistent attack effectiveness with limited clean-utility degradation, substantially outperforming graph and continual-learning backdoor baselines and remaining robust against representative defenses.

</details>


### [393] [Mesoscale Neural Operators: Learning Nonlinear Constitutive Laws from Molecular Dynamics for Scalable Fracture Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19658)
*Yue Yu,Jihong Wang,Stewart Silling,Ziwei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出介观神经算子，从分子动力学数据中学习具有物理一致性的非局部断裂模型，并将其用于远大于训练尺度的连续体断裂模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子动力学能够刻画原子尺度的断裂过程，但计算成本过高，难以覆盖实际应用所需的空间与时间尺度。现有机器学习替代模型虽可降低成本，却难以保证预测符合物理规律，因此需要一种兼具效率、跨尺度能力与物理一致性的模型。

Method: 介观神经算子是一种由分子动力学中的加载与位移数据直接训练得到的数据驱动非局部本构模型。它利用非局部模型的特征长度——视界——实现尺度转换，并通过两项结构设计维持跨尺度物理一致性：归一化核函数使应变能密度不随视界缩放而改变；重新缩放的临界键伸长量则保证能量释放率跨尺度一致。训练流程旨在识别非局部核函数及非线性本构关系。

Result: 合成数据测试表明，该方法能够识别非局部连续体多尺度模型。应用于粗粒化分子动力学数据后，模型在测试问题中对比应变能密度和临界能量释放率的误差均在百分之三以内；在分布外拉伸测试中，峰值传递力的预测误差在百分之六以内。进一步地，模型被用于面积为训练试样四千倍、含初始缺陷的板材，并复现了动态脆性断裂的主要特征，包括分支及级联分支网络。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将非局部模型的尺度结构与物理约束融入神经算子，可以从原子尺度数据中学习可扩展的断裂本构模型。该方法有望以较低计算成本，将分子动力学中的断裂信息传递到更大尺度的连续体模拟中。

Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can capture the nanoscale physics of fracture at the atomistic level, but their computational cost prohibits predictions at the length scales and time scales needed for many applications. Machine learning approaches, on the other hand, have been proposed as heuristic surrogates for material fracture, yet they cannot guarantee the physical consistency of the predicted response. To address this shortcoming, we propose the mesoscale neural operator (MNO): a data-driven nonlocal constitutive model that is learned directly from MD loading and displacement data. After training, it can be used in continuum fracture simulations on much larger domains and grid sizes. The key idea of the MNO is to exploit the built-in characteristic length of a nonlocal model, called the horizon, to travel across scales. Physical consistency across scales is obtained by building two structural ingredients into the MNO: a normalized kernel that renders the strain energy density invariant under horizon rescaling, and a rescaled critical bond stretch that keeps the energy release rate consistent across scales. Through tests on synthetic data, we show that the MNO and its learning workflow indeed discover the nonlocal continuum multiscale model in the form of the nonlocal kernel and the nonlinear constitutive relation. We then apply the framework to coarse-grained MD data and find that in a test problem, the learned model matches the MD strain energy density and critical energy release rate within 3%. It also predicts the peak transmitted forces within 6% in out-of-distribution tension tests. As a further demonstration, the model is applied to a plate with 4000 times the area of the training specimens and containing an initial defect. In this problem, the model reproduces the main features of dynamic brittle fracture, including branch and cascading branch networks.

</details>


### [394] [Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19676)
*Xinghao Dong,Huchen Yang,Jin-Long Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于评分扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，无需直接获取闭合数据，即可通过间接离线学习和在线数据同化学习闭合统计特征，并改善复杂动力系统的状态预测与跨工况泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂多尺度、多物理场系统的降阶模型会不可避免地丢失信息，传统确定性闭合难以充分描述这些误差。随机闭合建模虽有潜力，但通常需要难以测量或计算成本极高的真实闭合数据，因此需要一种不依赖直接闭合数据的学习方法。

Method: 构建基于评分扩散模型的随机闭合框架：利用间接信息进行离线训练，并在运行过程中结合数据同化更新闭合模型。框架将学习到的闭合与已知物理动力学结合；同时采用后验评分同化表征闭合中的非高斯特征，并进一步结合状态层面的数据同化来提升预测。

Result: 二维湍流数值实验表明，间接离线学习能够捕捉关键闭合统计特征并改善系统状态预测。与直接预测状态的纯数据驱动模型相比，结合已知物理动力学的闭合模型在不同工况间具有更好的泛化能力。相较于假设高斯分布的标准数据同化方法，后验评分同化更能表示闭合的不确定性特征；再结合状态层面的数据同化，可进一步提升状态预测效果。

Conclusion: 该框架为真实闭合数据不可得、且模型不确定性具有显著非高斯特征的复杂动力系统提供了可行的随机闭合学习与在线同化方案，适用于力学和工程等具有挑战性的场景。

Abstract: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.

</details>


### [395] [RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19681)
*Jinhee Won,Mardavij Roozbehani,Munther Dahleh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出奖励改进场迁移方法，利用源域低、高回报转移之间的变化规律增强目标域离线数据，在多种动力学变化任务中取得更好的总体表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨域离线强化学习常面临目标域数据有限的问题，源域数据虽丰富，却因动力学差异而难以直接复用。论文关注不同领域是否仍共享有用的低回报到高回报结构，并据此寻找比直接迁移源域高回报样本更稳健的数据增强方式。

Method: 该方法将源域与目标域的转移编码到共享潜在空间；通过最优传输配对源域低回报与高回报转移，并拟合描述两者位移的仿射场。随后，将该场作用于目标域的低回报锚点，解码生成样本并扩充目标数据集。论文还在共享类别几何等条件下界定合成误差，分析以目标域样本为锚点相较于直接移植源域高回报样本的适用条件，并推导其与下游回报之间的条件性联系。

Result: 在重力、形态和摩擦变化下的稠密回报运动任务中，实验显示该方法相较现有基线取得了更好的总体表现。摘要未提供具体数值或各任务的单项结果。

Conclusion: 当不同领域的动力学存在差异时，迁移源域低到高回报的变化结构，并以目标域数据作为生成锚点，可能比直接复用源域转移更有效。实验结果支持该思路在所测试任务中的价值，但其效果仍依赖领域间存在可共享的回报改进结构。

Abstract: Learning from limited target data is a central challenge in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning. Abundant source data can help, but dynamics differences can make direct transition reuse unreliable. We propose Reward Improvement Field Transfer (RIFT), which instead learns how low- and high-reward source transitions differ. RIFT encodes source and target transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low- and high-reward source transitions using optimal transport, and fits an affine field to their displacements. It applies this field to low-reward target anchors and decodes the results to augment the target dataset. The approach builds on the hypothesis that related domains can share useful low-to-high reward structure despite different dynamics. We bound synthesis error under shared class geometry, identify conditions favoring target anchoring over source-high transplant, and derive a conditional connection to downstream return. Experiments on dense-reward locomotion tasks under gravity, morphology, and friction shifts show improved aggregate performance over existing baselines.

</details>


### [396] [Elicited Adaptation: Auditable Localized Fairness via Pairwise Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19686)
*Shrey Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究公平标准变化时，预测分数至少需要调整多少，并分析事先不知道新标准、只能通过查询了解标准时的调整代价与信息需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同社区可能采用不同的公平标准，这些标准由哪些群体应被视为相似，以及可接受的分数差距共同决定。标准变化后，模型既要满足新的要求，也可能希望保留原有标准；论文旨在刻画实现这些目标所需的最小分数改动，并衡量提前作出调整承诺的风险。

Method: 在固定的个体集合上，将公平要求表示为相似性约束及分数差距容忍度，研究满足原标准的分数在适应新标准时所需的最小统一改动。论文利用最短路径上的连续目标约束刻画最优放大系数，并进一步分析仅修复新标准、预先承诺适应方案、边约束预算下限及有界几何等情形。对于查询式修复，论文考察仅通过相似性查询进行近似修复的可行性与容忍度查询复杂度，并补充了关于容忍度选择和预测效用的用户研究及训练比较。

Result: 保留原标准进行适应的最坏放大系数为个体数量的一半向下取整；论文还给出了有限新标准修复预算下的完整代价曲线。若必须在新标准揭晓前承诺方案，代价可能达到揭晓后最坏修复代价的个体数量减一倍，即使候选标准限于同一个二维马氏度量凸集。边约束预算下限可限制这两种放大因子，有界几何也能降低承诺代价。在达到承诺代价上界的构造中，对于两个内部目标，仅用相似性查询即可在容忍度不超过个体数量减一的倒数一半时实现可行的二倍近似修复，其分数改动相较常见修复方法可降低与个体数量成线性关系的倍数。若要求达到一加容差倍的近似最优，在固定斜率逻辑斯谛模型下，最坏查询复杂度为容差倒数平方乘个体数量平方，再乘置信参数对数。

Conclusion: 公平标准变化带来的调整成本，取决于约束在个体关系图中的结构，也取决于是否能等到新标准揭晓后再行动。论文区分了获得显著适应收益所需的信息与实现近乎最优分数改动所需的精确信息：前者可用较少的相似性信息实现，而后者可能需要大量查询。实际应用还应同时考量容忍度如何确定，以及数值上的公平合规是否会影响预测效用。

Abstract: How much must a predictor's scores change when a community's elicited fairness standard changes? Similarity and tolerance judgments define protected comparisons and acceptable score gaps. We study minimum uniform score movement on a fixed pool of $n$ profiles. For scores satisfying a source standard, we characterize the exact cost of retaining that standard during adaptation: runs of consecutive target constraints along shortest paths determine the optimal amplification factor. Its sharp worst case is $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, and a full cost curve describes finite target-only repair budgets. Committing before the target is known can cost $n-1$ times the worst repair after revelation, even within one fixed convex ball of two-dimensional Mahalanobis metrics. Positive edge-budget floors cap both factors; bounded geometry also limits the commitment cost. At two interior targets of the construction attaining the $n-1$ bound, similarity queries alone yield a feasible $2$-approximate repair for tolerance $\eps\le1/[2(n-1)]$, reducing movement relative to common repair by a factor linear in $n$. Feasible $(1+α)$-optimal repair on this family has worst-case tolerance-query complexity $Θ(α^{-2}n^2\log(1/δ))$ under a fixed-slope logistic model. The analysis separates the information needed for a substantial adaptation benefit from the precision needed for nearly optimal movement. Elicitation studies and training comparisons examine tolerance choice and the relation between numerical compliance and predictive utility.

</details>


### [397] [MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19692)
*Jason Lee,Dikshanta Pokhrel,Phonn Nay Khant,Victor Lee,Moritz Weckbecker,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek,Mark Riedl,Glenn Matlin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，基于影响函数的轨迹归因在经过验证的短训练窗口内能准确预测数据删除效果，但全程归因不稳定；跨训练运行可复现的主要是数据格式层面的规律，而非单个训练块的排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影响函数方法能够为训练轨迹中的数据给出一阶归因分数，但分数是否真正预测删除数据后的模型变化，仍需通过重新训练验证。论文旨在检验这类归因在不同模型规模、训练时间范围和数据粒度下的可靠性与可迁移性。

Method: 作者在两种规模的类 GPT-2 模型上，从头训练多步算术任务，训练数据包括经过筛选的网络文本及四类合成数学数据。将影响函数归因结果与实际删除数据后重新训练所得变化进行比较，并使用线性数据建模分数衡量预测准确性；同时考察全程归因、带元梯度裁剪的归因、连续短检查点窗口，以及单检查点梯度点积基线，并分析训练块和数据格式层级的规律能否跨运行复现。

Result: 较小模型的全程归因出现数值溢出；加入元梯度裁剪后，与重新训练结果的相关性仍接近随机水平，分数为零点一七至零点二二。相比之下，短检查点窗口在两种模型规模下均能稳定预测删除效果；较大模型的四个百步窗口分数达到零点八六至零点九九，而单检查点基线的相关性接近零。单个训练块的排名只在同一次运行内有预测力，跨随机种子或超参数不迁移，相关系数不超过零点零九；数据格式层面的模式则能跨运行复现。示例讲解和基础事实两类数据在有益与有害的前百分之五分数尾部中，占比均为其语料占比的二点一至二点六倍，说明它们具有强烈的双向局部敏感性；这种局部敏感性不等同于多轮训练中删除整个数据类别的净效益。

Conclusion: 轨迹归因并非在整个训练过程中都可靠：其有效性依赖于短而经过验证的时间窗口。采用这种局部评估时，归因可以准确预测数据删除的影响，并揭示可跨运行泛化的数据格式层面规律；但不应将单个训练块的分数排名视为普遍规律，也不应把局部有害或有益分数直接等同于整类数据的净贡献。

Abstract: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. Rankings of individual training blocks predict retraining only within that single run and do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters ($ρ\le 0.09$), whereas format-level patterns replicate across runs. Two data families, worked examples and primitive facts, occupy $2.1$--$2.6\times$ their corpus share in both the helpful and harmful $5\%$ score tails, reflecting strong bidirectional local sensitivity distinct from net benefit under multi-epoch family deletion. These results show that trajectory attribution is reliable within short, validated windows and yields family-level insights that generalize across runs.

</details>


### [398] [Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19698)
*Glenn Matlin,Chandreyi Chakraborty,Mohammed Rehan Parwani,Saehee Eom,Anthony Wen-Ming Zang,Akhil Theerthala,Arjun Chatterjee,Tejas Khandwekar,Brandon Michaels,Alvin Deng,Mark Riedl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文主张将训练数据归因从单次训练的数据排序工具，转变为发现可复用数据筛选规则的方法，并提出可证伪、等总计算成本的评估方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练数据筛选决定模型学习什么，但文档的价值取决于模型已有知识。针对某次训练计算出的文档影响力排名，未必能推广到其他语料或模型检查点；常见质量指标也可能与实测效用不一致。因此，需要从归因结果中提炼可检验、可复用的数据属性。

Method: 提出一个反馈循环：解释归因所指向的数据来源，测试候选数据变化，并明确五类主张各自需要什么证据、以及这些证据不能证明什么。进一步设计可证伪的比较，在发现规则所需成本也计入后，将该方法与困惑度筛选、分类器筛选和数据混合基线按相同总计算成本进行比较，并在新数据上评估。

Result: 摘要未报告实验结果或具体性能提升，而是提出方法框架与评估标准。其核心可检验命题是：由归因发现的数据属性，能否在新语料或不同检查点上形成有效筛选准则，并在等总计算成本下优于较廉价的基线。

Conclusion: 训练数据归因的价值不应仅以改善某一次训练的数据排序来衡量，还应看它能否揭示可解释、可迁移且经实验验证的数据规律。论文强调区分历史贡献、解释性说明与未来数据价值，并要求对这些不同主张分别提供相应证据。

Abstract: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.

</details>


### [399] [Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19700)
*Parsa Mirtaheri,Mohammadreza Armandpour,Keivan Alizadeh,Iman Mirzadeh,Parshin Shojaee,Aryo Lotfi,David Harrison,Mehrdad Farajtabar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究比较上下文经验复用、基于可验证奖励的强化学习与自我蒸馏，发现上下文学习单独效果最佳，而与强化学习结合可进一步提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体在同一代码库、数据库或应用环境中反复执行任务时，不同任务往往共享潜在结构。智能体可以从过往尝试和环境反馈中学习并复用知识，但这种经验既可保留在上下文中，也可通过更新模型参数来吸收。以往研究通常分开考察这两种途径，因此它们各自的作用及协同方式尚不明确。

Method: 研究采用统一的在线实验流程与模块化框架，比较上下文学习、基于可验证奖励的群组相对策略优化、自我蒸馏，以及这些方法的组合。智能体先在每项任务上接受评估，再针对该任务进行适应；学习信号仅来自自身尝试和环境反馈。实验使用九十亿参数模型，在四类环境的109项任务上测试14种适应机制和一个无状态基线，并为每类环境设置5种任务顺序。

Result: 上下文学习带来最大的单独收益：最佳策略的跨环境平均成功率从28.8%升至49.4%。在该策略上加入强化学习后，平均成功率达到最高值51.6%；强化学习在所有受测上下文学习策略上都提升了总体平均表现。自我蒸馏的效果则不一致。行为轨迹分析显示，上下文学习减少了环境查询次数并缩短了尝试过程，但也常使智能体跳过对当前任务的检查与验证；加入强化学习后，检查和验证行为有所恢复，同时仍保留较少环境查询的特点。

Conclusion: 保留经验与更新模型参数并非互相替代：上下文中的经验复用能显著提升表现，而基于可验证奖励的强化学习可进一步改善智能体对这些经验的使用方式。研究结果支持联合考察上下文管理和参数更新，并提示应关注效率提升是否以牺牲当前任务的检查与验证为代价。

Abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

</details>


### [400] [Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19701)
*Konstantinos Stavropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“分布偏移多重准确性”作为新的误差基准，使可检验分布偏移学习在无偏移时退化为多重准确性，并通过高效归约与统计刻画，将其与经典不可知学习联系起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可检验分布偏移学习要求学习者利用带标签训练数据和无标签测试数据，产生测试误差较低的预测器，或检测到分布偏移。然而，标准保证即使训练与测试分布相同，也可能允许最优误差被常数倍放大，因而无法直接恢复经典不可知学习的保证。研究旨在建立更恰当的误差基准与统一理论框架。

Method: 提出受算法公平性领域多重准确性启发的“分布偏移多重准确性”基准，并据此定义新的可检验分布偏移学习框架。该框架在无分布偏移时等价于多重准确性。借助已有的、从不可知学习到多重准确预测的非平凡归约，作者构造出保持训练边缘分布的高效归约；此外，将该模型与恒等性检验联系起来，并以拉德马赫复杂度给出统计刻画。

Result: 新框架首次通过保持训练边缘分布的高效归约，在形式上推广经典不可知学习；同时保留已有算法上界，并继承不可知学习的计算复杂性下界。作者还首次给出不可知分布偏移可检验学习的统计刻画，并指出该误差基准可直接优化，因为其定义不依赖不可观测的测试标签。

Conclusion: 分布偏移多重准确性为分布偏移学习提供了更精细、与经典不可知学习相兼容的误差标准。它不仅统一了相关的计算与统计理论，也可能用于无监督领域自适应，并带来更紧的分布外泛化保证。

Abstract: Agnostic learning has a well-developed theory of computational and statistical complexity. For learning with distribution shift, even the choice of an appropriate error benchmark remains challenging. Testable learning with distribution shift (TDS) was introduced to develop computational foundations for this setting: using labeled training data and unlabeled test data, the learner must either produce a predictor with low test error or detect distribution shift. However, standard agnostic TDS guarantees allow a constant-factor amplification of the optimum error even when the training and test distributions coincide. They therefore do not directly recover the guarantee of classical agnostic learning.
  We introduce shift multiaccuracy, a stronger error benchmark inspired by multiaccuracy from algorithmic fairness. This yields a TDS formulation that becomes equivalent to multiaccuracy when there is no shift. Using a recent nontrivial reduction from agnostic learning to multiaccurate prediction from prior work, we obtain the first TDS framework that formally generalizes agnostic learning through an efficient reduction preserving the training marginal. The framework retains existing algorithmic upper bounds and inherits computational lower bounds from agnostic learning. Moreover, we establish a direct connection between our model and identity testing, yielding the first statistical characterization of agnostic TDS learning, in terms of Rademacher complexity.
  More broadly, we argue that shift multiaccuracy might be of independent interest in unsupervised domain adaptation, as it leads to sharper out-of-distribution generalization guarantees, and can be minimized directly, since its definition does not involve the unobserved test labels.

</details>


### [401] [Sample-Efficient Ensemble Reinforcement Learning at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19733)
*Yoav Feigenbaum,Dmitrii Krylov,Roy Fox*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将集成学习与大规模强化学习架构结合的方法，在雅达利十万步基准上提升了样本效率与性能，同时控制计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成方法已能提升较小型无模型深度强化学习架构的样本效率，但其对更大规模架构的作用尚未得到研究。研究还指出，单纯扩大网络规模可能反而损害性能，因此需要探索如何有效利用新增模型容量。

Method: 提出一种混合无模型强化学习算法，将均值集成方法与大规模强化学习架构结合。该方法把新增参数组织成相对独立的学习器，以利用模型容量提升性能，并降低计算开销。

Result: 在雅达利十万步基准上，经统计严谨的评估发现，直接扩大原有架构的网络规模会降低性能；相比之下，所提方法能够利用增加的模型容量，取得优于原架构的表现，并保持较高的计算效率。

Conclusion: 集成学习有望帮助大规模强化学习架构有效利用额外模型容量，避免单纯扩展网络带来的性能退化。论文还讨论了性能与计算成本之间的权衡，为实际应用中的高样本效率强化学习提供参考。

Abstract: Ensemble methods such as MeanQ have been shown to improve the sample efficiency of relatively small model-free deep reinforcement learning (RL) architectures, including DQN and similarly sized variants such as Rainbow. However, to our knowledge, the effects of ensembling on large-scale architectures such as Bigger Better Faster (BBF) have not been studied. In this work, we present MeanQ-BBF, a hybrid model-free algorithm that combines the principles of MeanQ and BBF. Through statistically rigorous evaluation on the Atari 100K benchmark, we show that in contrast to naive scaling of the network size of BBF, which degrades performance, MeanQ-BBF is able to leverage the increase in model capacity to improve performance over BBF. Moreover, MeanQ-BBF does this in a computationally efficient way by organizing the added parameters into largely independent learners. Finally, we discuss the performance-cost tradeoff in the context of practical sample-efficient RL.

</details>


### [402] [Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19742)
*Pengfei Zheng,Wuchao Li,Shiyao Wang,Honghui Bao,Hongyi Xie,Jiaxin Deng,Xingmei Wang,Jinghao Zhang,Yufei Ye,Ruiming Tang,Guorui Zhou,Han Li,Kun Gai,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出梯度有界策略优化，通过限制梯度并结合策略置信度加权，使生成式推荐中的强化学习训练更稳定，同时保持有竞争力的推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统级联推荐系统各阶段的优化目标不一致，难以端到端优化；生成式推荐为强化学习提供了统一的自回归框架，但直接应用强化学习容易造成训练不稳定和推荐质量下降。论文进一步分析现有基于概率比率的目标，指出其存在梯度失活、负向更新可能过度放大，以及无法充分反映策略绝对置信度等问题。

Method: 作者从统一的对数几率梯度视角重新分析组相对策略优化及其他比率目标，并提出梯度有界策略优化。该方法采用停止梯度的归一化，使正向与负向更新都保持梯度有效且幅度有界，同时依据当前策略概率对更新进行置信度加权。因此，策略对正样本越确信、对负样本越不确信时，相应更新会平稳减弱。

Result: 在论文评估的设置中，梯度有界策略优化取得了有竞争力的推荐表现，且相比其他强化学习方法训练更加稳定。摘要未提供具体数据或评测基准。

Conclusion: 论文认为，改进生成式推荐中的强化学习目标，不应只依赖概率比率裁剪，还应同时控制梯度幅度并考虑策略置信度。所提出的方法针对现有目标的梯度缺陷进行了设计，为更稳定地优化完整推荐生成过程提供了简洁方案。

Abstract: Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality.
  We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish.
  Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded for both positive and negative updates, and (c) explicitly confidence-weighted under current policy probabilities. This ensures that updates gracefully vanish for $π\!\to\!1$ positives and $π\!\to\!0$ negatives. Across the evaluated settings, GBPO achieves competitive recommendation performance with more stable training than competing RL methods.

</details>


### [403] [When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19762)
*Mahtab Movahhedrad,Hamidreza Hasani Balyani,Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究不同任务、群体或图像扰动的占比变化是否会改变两个固定不确定性分数的受试者工作特征曲线下面积排序，并提出检验这种排序稳健性的理论与实证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汇总数据上的曲线下面积比较依赖群体混合比例，因此某个分数在特定数据构成中胜出，并不意味着它在其他构成下仍占优。论文旨在刻画这种排序反转何时可能发生，以及如何可靠地审计其稳健性。

Method: 作者针对固定二元目标和固定群体条件分布的混合情形，利用跨群体曲线下面积分解证明：任意有理的对称二次比较几何都能由有限标量分数分布实现；普遍占优检验具有余困难性，检查少于指定群体数的所有混合仍可能漏掉反转。论文还给出维数无关、误差阶为一除以网格数的近似认证界，并利用跨群体分数边缘分布对齐，使比较分子变为线性，同时提供对齐不完美时的误差界。基于这些结果，作者构造有限数据组审计、显式反转混合与距离，并给出同时适用于多个总体的结论。

Result: 在冻结的残差网络五十模型对图像扰动数据的失效检测实验中，发现集上的十八组置信分数比较有十五组在每类扰动内均胜出；这十五组在留出集的所有扰动族混合中均获有限数据组认证。但覆盖全部十五种扰动时，十四个发现集胜者中，网格检验认证十个、对三个无法判定，并发现一组至少相差零点零五的确认集反转。对稳定语言模型二十二十亿参数模型发布的全部一万一千零十九条输出及三十五种不确定性方法进行审计后，发现六十六组比较虽在四项任务内各自胜出，却在任务混合后反转；依据发现集拟合的边缘秩对齐消除了这些反转，带对齐误差界的检验认证了八十三组比较。标签核查也改变了若干选定反转。

Conclusion: 分数比较的稳健性取决于混合比例，不能仅凭各组内排序或单一汇总结果推断。论文提供了可计算的有限数据组审计与误差认证工具，并展示边缘分布对齐的价值；但结论只针对评估过的固定分数和数据组，不证明对人类错误检测、未见过的图像扰动或评估范围之外情形的泛化能力。

Abstract: Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statements. For failure detection with a frozen ResNet-50 on ImageNet-C, 15 of 18 confidence-score comparisons win in every corruption family on a discovery split, and all 15 are finite-bank certified over all family mixtures on a held-out split; over all 15 corruption types, of 14 discovery winners the corrected grid certifies 10, leaves 3 unresolved, and finds one confirmation reversal of at least 0.05 AUROC. An audit of all 11,019 released Stable LM 2 12B outputs and 35 uncertainty methods finds 66 confirmation-set comparisons that win within all four tasks yet reverse under mixing. Discovery-fitted marginal rank alignment removes all 66; an alignment-error envelope certifies 83 comparisons. Label checks also change several selected reversals. The findings distinguish robustness of frozen scores from robustness after calibration; they do not establish human-error detection, robustness to unseen corruptions, or generalization beyond the evaluated banks.

</details>


### [404] [PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19768)
*Yuming Zhang,Xianchen Zhou,Hongxia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的测试时引导方法，通过增强扩散模型预测与约束结构之间的对齐，提升组合优化解的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式组合优化求解器通常依据预测分数对候选变量进行贪心排序，再通过硬约束筛除不可行选择。若高分候选与约束不匹配，解码器就会跳过它们并采用排名较低的候选，导致解质量下降。现有测试时方法主要改进搜索、采样或解码过程，未直接增强解码前的预测—约束对齐。作者观察到，训练好的去噪器本身已包含与约束结构相符的信号，因此可在推理阶段利用这些信号。

Method: 提出“扰动实例结构引导”方法，无需额外训练。在每个去噪步骤中，方法构造一个结构信息受损的预测，并将原始预测沿着远离该受损预测的方向外推，从而强化原预测中的结构信号，改善候选变量的排序，再交由带约束的贪心解码器生成可行解。信号分析表明，该引导主要作用于约束关键变量，而非对所有分数进行均匀缩放。

Result: 在不使用后续改进、仅采用贪心解码的条件下，该方法在旅行商问题的全部十六种求解器与规模组合上均取得提升，并在四种最大独立集求解器上也均有改善，最高降低求解成本百分之四点八。加入二边交换改进后，多数大规模设定仍保持收益。初步实验还显示，该方法可扩展至基于变换器的求解器。

Conclusion: 研究表明，预测结果与约束结构的对齐是提升扩散式组合优化性能的有效测试时方向。扰动实例结构引导能够直接强化去噪器已有的结构信号，无需重新训练，并在多类求解器和问题规模上改善解码结果。

Abstract: Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. Building on this observation, we propose Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG), a training-free method that amplifies these signals at test time. At each denoising step, PISG constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction away from it. The resulting guided prediction improves candidate rankings before constrained decoding. Signal analysis shows that this guidance concentrates on constraint-critical variables rather than uniformly rescaling scores. Under greedy decoding and without downstream refinement, PISG improves all 16 TSP solver-scale pairs across DIFUSCO, T2T, FastT2T, and StruDiCO, and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to +4.8%. The gains persist on most large-scale settings after 2-opt, and a preliminary study extends PISG to a Transformer-based solver. These results identify prediction-constraint alignment as an effective test-time enhancement direction for diffusion-based combinatorial optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/Ming-321/PISG.

</details>


### [405] [How Should Parallel Langevin Chains Share Noise?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19784)
*Ryan Farell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种中心化耦合方法：在保持每条链有限步长下边际采样路径不变的同时，使多链高斯噪声相互抵消，从而显著降低后验均值估计的方差；但对某些二次型统计量存在方差代价，加入接受拒绝校正后收益也会减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行朗之万采样通常让各条链使用独立高斯噪声，链集合均值中的噪声方差随链数增加而下降，但仍为单链噪声方差的倒数链数。经典反变量思路提示，通过让链间噪声负相关，可以进一步降低均值估计的波动。关键问题是能否在降低集体噪声的同时，不改变每条链自身的采样路径分布，以及这种耦合对不同统计量和接受拒绝校正的影响。

Method: 对每一步各链的高斯噪声，先减去链间的列均值，再进行缩放，使每条链的噪声边际分布仍为标准高斯，而各链噪声之和为零。作者针对二次目标推导由集合均值计算的线性估计量的联合协方差，并将其分解为初始状态与高斯噪声两部分；耦合效应可由一个标量刻画。对于非二次目标，作者给出剩余方差的上界，并分析中心化噪声用于二次型统计量时的方差代价。最后在三个温度化逻辑回归后验上进行实验，并考察加入接受拒绝校正后的效果。

Result: 在二次目标下，只要各链噪声之和为零，噪声对链集合均值的贡献便被消除；每条链在任意有限运行长度内仍保持普通未校正朗之万算法的路径分布。对于非二次目标，仍可对残余方差作界定。代价是：对中心化高斯状态的二次型，集合平均方差为单链的 1/(链数减一)，而独立噪声对应 1/链数。三个逻辑回归后验实验中，八条中心化链对后验均值估计的坐标方差总和，比八条独立链低一至两个数量级，并且在方差及方差乘采样时间两项指标上优于一百二十八条独立链。加入接受拒绝校正后，方差降幅缩小至约三至八倍；观测结果与由拒绝频率和噪声能量得到的首阶预测一致。

Conclusion: 中心化噪声耦合能够在不改变单链未校正采样边际分布的前提下，显著提升并行朗之万采样对后验均值等线性统计量的效率，尤其适用于目标近似二次的情形。但收益依赖统计量类型：某些二次型会承受方差惩罚；接受拒绝机制也会破坏噪声的完全抵消。因此，实际应用中应结合目标分布、估计量和拒绝率评估其净收益。

Abstract: Parallel Langevin sampling usually draws an array of independent Gaussian vectors, one row per chain. The average row drives the ensemble mean, with variance $1/K$ per coordinate for $K$ chains. Yet the unadjusted Langevin algorithm (ULA) specifies only each row's distribution. Subtracting the column means and rescaling, as in classical antithetic sampling, makes that variance zero. Each chain keeps its ordinary ULA path law for any finite run. For quadratic targets we derive the joint covariance of linear estimates computed from the ensemble mean, including coefficient estimates, time averages and predictions. The identity separates contributions from initial states and Gaussian draws. The coupling changes the second through one scalar, which is zero whenever the draws sum to zero across chains. For nonquadratic targets we bound the remaining variance. Centering has a price: for a quadratic form in the mean-subtracted Gaussian state, the ensemble average has variance $1/(K-1)$ relative to one chain, compared with $1/K$ under independent draws. On three tempered logistic posteriors, eight centered chains reduced the variance of the posterior-mean estimate, summed over coordinates, by two to three orders of magnitude compared with eight independent chains. They also beat 128 independent chains on variance and on variance times sampling time. Under Metropolis correction the reduction shrank to about three- to eightfold: rejected draws no longer balance accepted ones. The measured variance ratios were consistent with a leading-order prediction from rejection frequency and noise energy.

</details>


### [406] [Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19794)
*Dhruv Trehan,Paras Chopra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种评估大语言模型“研究品味”的方法：让模型在给定研究目标和已有结果后，从两个未来研究方向中作出选择，并分析其与论文作者建议的一致、稳定分歧及选择不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式科学研究往往需要在尚无明确、可验证目标时先选择研究方向，因此研究品味会影响人工智能科学家的研究决策。然而，大语言模型的研究品味仍缺乏系统测量。作者希望评估模型倾向选择哪些方向，而不是以事后科研指标衡量方向优劣，或假设作者选择必然正确。

Method: 研究将研究品味具体化为科学工作流程中的方向选择任务。作者从四个机器学习子领域的十九篇论文中构建八十组成对比较；每道题提供研究目标、已检验的假设及关键结果，并要求模型在作者推荐的后续方向与来自相似论文的合理干扰方向之间选择。研究测试八种大语言模型，并考察作者方向一致率、稳定分歧和选择不稳定性；此外还进行相似度控制、提示消融和作者偏好框架检验，并用方向类别标签及示例分析模型偏好的变化类型。

Result: 八种模型与作者推荐方向的一致率为百分之四十五至百分之六十七点五，稳定偏离作者选择的比例为百分之十五至百分之三十六点二。多数分歧在相似度控制、提示消融及作者偏好框架检验后仍然存在；模型之间的选择一致性也显示，部分非作者偏好可能为多个模型共同具有。定性分析发现，模型反复倾向于扩大规模或增强泛化能力，并在方法改进与基础设施、数据扩展之间表现出取舍。

Conclusion: 这项研究提供了评估大语言模型研究方向偏好的初步描述性框架。结果表明，模型不仅会与作者建议不一致，而且这种分歧可能具有稳定、可辨识的倾向。后续工作可进一步刻画模型的研究品味，并探索如何理解和引导这些偏好，以支持模型参与开放式科学发现。

Abstract: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available.
