For the final tuned world models of our companion paper on nine data sets, baseline and lift add up under each model's own plan, but a deeper price cut lowers the forecast in 29% to 83% of item-week steps on Dominick's (23% to 80% within prices seen in training), and the world model and LightGBM both state about twice the measured response. Across 703 configurations from the settings searches, checks passed were not related to forecast accuracy (Spearman 0.02, 95% interval -0.02 to 0.05); with no known answer for those versions, this concerns accuracy, while whether an explanation is right is measured only in the generated data.

</details>


### [476] [TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21178)
*Erkan Bayram,Debanjan Ghosh,Li Zhu,Sambarta Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出可在设备端运行的故障诊断系统，结合时序信号编码器、小型语言模型和可验证计算工具，在模拟基准上取得较高诊断准确率，并能处理分布外故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多负载电源管理系统的故障诊断通常依赖专家人工检查电流与电压波形，难以扩展到大量部署设备。将传感器数据发送至云端还可能泄露专有信息，并带来较高的接口调用成本，因此需要一种可本地运行、诊断结果可信且便于规模化应用的方法。

Method: 研究提出轨迹系统，将时序编码器与小型语言模型结合，根据电流、电压波形生成结构化且符合物理规律的诊断报告；对需要精确计算的内容调用工具，以获得可核验结果。系统在设备端运行，使传感器数据留在本地。研究还设计了基于评分细则的评估框架，分别考察报告结构、信号忠实度、物理推理、故障诊断和行动建议，并对各项给出判定。

Result: 在包含十五类故障的多负载模拟基准上，该系统的故障类别准确率超过百分之九十五，并能泛化至分布外故障。作为对比，表现最好的编码器探测基线准确率为百分之五十八。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将时序信号理解、小型语言模型与可核验计算相结合，有望实现兼顾诊断性能、物理依据、隐私保护和部署成本的电源系统故障诊断。现有结果来自模拟基准；其在真实设备和实际运行环境中的表现仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

</details>


### [477] [Generative AI-Driven Parametric Design Optimization Framework for Vehicle Closure Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20451)
*Dongeon Lee,Yurim Lee,Jiyong Kim,Sanghyeon Kim,Sanghyun Lee,Seungyeon Shin,Jeahong Kim,Namwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一套面向工业车辆尾门的生成式人工智能参数化优化框架，将性能导向的设计生成、可编辑计算机辅助设计模型与原生工程仿真验证相结合；经验证，折中方案减重百分之七点一、最大位移降低百分之二十九点四。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业车辆闭合系统几何复杂、部件耦合，设计还需同时满足性能目标与工程可行性。传统优化难以兼顾高效探索、实际可编辑的参数化模型以及可靠的工程仿真验证，因此需要打通生成式设计与工业设计分析流程的方法。

Method: 研究以汽车尾门总成为案例，将面向生产的计算机辅助设计模型重构为基于参考关系、具有十三维设计变量的参数化模板，并建立自动化建模与结构仿真流程，收集质量、最大位移和最大等效应力数据。采用高斯过程回归建立性能代理模型，再利用扩散模型和流匹配模型生成候选设计；通过代理模型引导和性能感知训练损失，将工程目标融入生成过程，并考察引导强度及损失权重的影响。生成式搜索与第二代非支配排序遗传算法在相同评估预算和代理模型下进行比较，选取候选方案后重建参数化模型并进行原生工程仿真验证。

Result: 相较基准方案，帕累托前沿折中点方案的质量降低百分之七点一，最大位移降低百分之二十九点四；经验证的极端方案分别实现最高百分之十点三的减重和百分之三十七点三的最大位移降低。所有选定候选方案均成功重建并通过原生仿真分析。最大等效应力作为工程可行性约束参与评估。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了生成式多目标设计探索与可编辑工业参数化模型及原生工程验证相结合的可行性，可用于复杂工业部件的性能优化。研究结果表明，生成式搜索能够找到有竞争力的候选方案，并将其可靠地带入实际计算机辅助设计与工程分析流程。

Abstract: This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework integrating performance-oriented generation with editable computer-aided design (CAD) and downstream computer-aided engineering (CAE) analysis for industrial vehicle closure systems. The framework is demonstrated on an automotive tailgate assembly with complex geometry, coupled components, and competing performance and feasibility requirements. A production-oriented CATIA model is restructured into a reference-based parametric template with a 13-dimensional design representation. An automated CAD/CAE workflow generates parametric models, performs structural analysis, and constructs a database of mass, maximum displacement, and maximum von Mises stress. Gaussian process regression surrogates predict performance, while diffusion and flow matching models generate design candidates. The design problem minimizes mass and maximum displacement, with stress assessed as an engineering feasibility constraint. Performance-guided generation using surrogate guidance and performance-aware training using a performance-aware loss incorporate engineering objectives, with sensitivity to guidance scale and loss weight evaluated. Generative search is compared with NSGA-II under matched evaluation budgets using a common surrogate model. Selected Pareto-region candidates are reconstructed in CATIA and re-evaluated through native CAE; all verified candidates are successfully regenerated and analyzed. Relative to the baseline, the knee-point design reduces mass by 7.1% and maximum displacement by 29.4%, while extreme verified solutions achieve maximum reductions of 10.3% and 37.3%, respectively. The results demonstrate performance-oriented multi-objective design exploration compatible with editable industrial CAD and native engineering verification.

</details>


### [478] [Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20981)
*Özgün Turgut,Daniel Rueckert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种通过特征空间约束缓解时间序列编码器输出令牌部分坍塌的方法，使模型能够随规模扩大而持续提升，并在多类数据集上取得有竞争力的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用时间序列编码器有望用单一骨干网络适配不同任务与领域，但现有模型难以随参数规模扩展。论文指出，主流的掩码数据建模仅在输入空间监督重建，未能约束特征空间中的令牌表示，因而容易出现维度冗余和部分坍塌。

Method: 在输入空间的重建目标之外，加入两项特征空间目标：利用指数移动平均教师进行自蒸馏，并通过柯莱奥正则化促进表示分散。作者据此构建新一代时间序列编码器，并在相同训练条件下与前代模型比较。

Result: 相较前代模型，新编码器的输出令牌余弦相似度更低、有效秩更高；参数量从七百一十万扩展至一亿一千六百万时，性能仍单调提升，而前代模型表现下降。该模型在一百四十三个单变量与多变量数据集上达到或超过现有通用时间序列编码器。

Conclusion: 研究表明，仅依赖输入空间重建不足以避免时间序列编码器的表示坍塌；补充特征空间自蒸馏与分散正则化，有助于提升表示质量和模型可扩展性。作者同时公开了代码与预训练权重，以支持后续研究。

Abstract: General-purpose time series encoders promise a single backbone that generalises across tasks and domains; however, they currently do not scale. We trace this down to a critical point of failure: under the predominant masked data modelling supervision, the encoder's output tokens partially collapse. This is the natural consequence of supervising encoders only in the input space, which leaves no constraint against redundant token dimensions in the feature space. We introduce OTISv2, which suppresses the collapse by complementing the reconstruction objective in input space with two objectives in the feature space: a self-distillation loss against an exponential-moving-average teacher, and a KoLeo regulariser. Under matched training, the resulting encoder reduces the cosine similarity and lifts the effective rank of its output tokens relative to its predecessor, and it scales monotonically from 7.1 M to 116 M parameters where its predecessor declines. It matches or surpasses existing general-purpose time series encoders across 143 uni- and multi-variate datasets. To foster further research, we release our code and pre-trained weights.

</details>


### [479] [Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21241)
*Xiaoyu Li,Jiangxuan Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出适用于自适应推理系统的时间一致风险证书，并分析自洽投票中计算量、错误风险与计算分配的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理系统常在反复查看校准数据后，自适应选择采样预算、提示词、验证器或聚合规则。此类选择会使常规验证误差范围过于乐观，因为它们通常只适用于事先固定的方案，无法覆盖选择过程本身。论文旨在为部署前的方案搜索及部署后的风险与计算成本报告提供可靠保证。

Method: 将测试时扩展方案建模为具有随机成本的随机预测器，提出时间一致的贝叶斯型风险证书。该证书同时适用于所有校准时刻、方案的后验混合以及依赖数据的停止规则。对于有限的预算与验证器组合，惩罚项为熟悉的对数方案数除以样本量；非均匀先验和局部化后验混合可进一步改善结构化搜索的证书。论文还分析自洽投票：只有当正确答案是生成器唯一的最高频答案时，增加采样量才会使错误率指数下降；否则更多计算可能放大错误。基于同一边际分析，论文推导了计算资源分配的最优注水规律。

Result: 合成实验量化了自适应预算选择导致的乐观偏差。一个包含一百九十二个样例的数学推理审计展示了真实推理流程中的风险—成本报告。在更大规模的两种模型、两个数学推理基准实验中，经过选择的最佳方案误差范围在最多百分之二十二点五的随机划分中低于划分外风险，尽管其名义水平为百分之五；所提证书则未出现这种失效。在完整测试划分上，证书进一步收紧至零点一零九，而留出风险为零点零三九。

Conclusion: 该研究为自适应推理系统提供了一种轻量且不依赖特定数据分布的风险与计算成本评估方法。核心启示是，风险保证必须覆盖方案选择过程；同时，增加采样计算并非总能改善准确率，资源分配应考虑正确答案相对于生成分布的边际优势。

Abstract: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.

</details>


### [480] [AdaModalX: Synchronization-Free MFM Inference for Distributed Multimodal Mobile Sensing via Progressive Data Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20464)
*Xiangrui Xu,Sicong Liu,Zhiwen Yu,Zimu Zhou,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向异步移动感知数据的渐进式多模态推理框架，根据已到达信息的效用决定何时推理，而非等待所有模态齐备；实验显示其能兼顾准确率与时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动感知中的不同数据流受网络状况和数据量差异影响，常常异步到达。现有多模态推理通常要求输入完整且同步：等待所有模态会增加端到端时延，使用不完整输入又可能降低准确率。因此，推理时机应取决于当前信息的实际效用，而不是模态是否全部到齐。

Method: 该框架将推理执行与模态同步解耦，并在运行时依据效用进行编排。设备端利用由边缘侧多模态基础模型蒸馏得到的轻量探测器评估样本：可靠样本可在本地结束处理，不确定样本则继续上传。边缘端从已完整接收的样本构造候选输入；必要时，也利用延迟输入的部分信息生成估补特征。随后，基于冻结的多模态编码器构建轻量贡献评估器，估计候选输入的效用，并在其达到相应阈值时启动多模态基础模型。

Result: 在四种移动感知应用上的实验表明，该框架改善了准确率与时延之间的权衡：准确率最高提升百分之二十六点九七，端到端时延最高降低百分之六十四点七五。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，异步多模态推理不必等待所有输入齐备；通过评估现有信息的效用，并结合设备端筛选、边缘端候选构造和按需模型激活，可以在保持或提升准确率的同时降低推理时延。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models (MFMs) support generalizable inference in distributed mobile sensing applications by integrating heterogeneous data streams. However, existing MFM inference pipelines typically require complete and synchronized multimodal inputs, whereas mobile sensing streams arrive asynchronously due to network variability and heterogeneous data volumes across modalities. Waiting for all modalities increases end-to-end latency, while inference with incomplete inputs can reduce accuracy. We argue that multimodal inference should depend on the utility of available information rather than modality completeness. Based on this principle, we propose AdaModalX, a progressive multimodal inference framework that decouples inference execution from modality synchronization through runtime utility-aware orchestration. At each device, importance-aware data uploading uses a lightweight probe distilled from the edge-side MFM to allow reliable samples to exit locally while uncertain samples continue uploading. At the edge, on-demand MFM activation constructs candidates from fully received samples and, when needed, imputed features derived from partially received delayed inputs. A lightweight contribution assessor built on frozen MFM encoders estimates candidate utility and activates the MFM once the candidate meets its corresponding utility threshold. Experiments on four mobile sensing applications show that AdaModalX improves the accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving up to 26.97% accuracy improvement and up to 64.75% end-to-end latency reduction.

</details>


### [481] [Explaining Cross-Label Decision Structure in Multi-Output Tree Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20996)
*Sylvio Barbon Junior,Hiago F. F. Oliveira,Rafael Figueira Gonçalves,Jessica Fernandes Lopes,Ricardo Cerri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出多汇点决策谓词图及共享谓词流，用于衡量多输出树集成中不同标签共用决策条件的程度；实验表明，原生多输出森林通常比逐标签训练的二元相关模型共享更多决策结构，但高共享度不代表标签间存在共享预测信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多输出树集成往往让多个标签共用决策路径，但常见归因方法逐个标签分析，无法直接说明模型在标签之间复用了哪些决策条件，也难以衡量复用程度。论文旨在提供一种全局、以决策谓词为单位的分析方式。

Method: 论文将决策谓词图扩展为多汇点决策谓词图，为每个标签设置一个汇点；每个叶节点按其样本中各标签为正的数量，向相应汇点贡献权重。在此基础上定义共享谓词流，衡量某标签的决策质量中有多少经过一对标签共同激活的条件；再通过收缩后的图及标签特定的提升量，判断共享条件是同时提高两个标签的预测概率，还是使一个标签受益而另一个受损。

Result: 受控实验显示，共享谓词流反映的是共享决策条件，而不只是特征重叠。在九个多标签基准上，原生多输出森林有八个基准表现出比二元相关模型更多的共享决策结构；其中五个基准的预测性能相当，即使超参数相同也如此。逐标签的树模型归因排名能反映模型架构变化，却不能说明共享程度。另一个重要发现是，在八个基准上移除特征与标签间的信号后，共享谓词流反而上升。

Conclusion: 多汇点决策谓词图为分析多输出集成模型如何在标签间复用决策条件提供了全局、谓词级工具。但共享谓词流描述的是已拟合模型的决策结构，而非数据本身的关联；因此，高共享度不能作为标签间存在共享预测信息的证据。

Abstract: A multi-output tree ensemble predicts several binary labels through decision paths that it largely shares across those labels, yet the attribution methods commonly used to explain such models treat each output in isolation. We propose multi-sink Decision Predicate Graphs (ms-DPGs), which extend decision predicate graphs with one sink per label: each leaf contributes to the sink of every label its in-bag positive count for that label. On this representation we define Shared Predicate Flow (SPF), the share of a label's decision mass that passes through conditions active for both labels of a pair, and a contracted view of the graph in which label-specific lifts indicate whether a shared condition raises the probability of both labels or of one at the expense of the other. Controlled experiments show that SPF captures shared decision conditions rather than mere feature overlap. On nine multi-label benchmarks, native multi-output forests share substantially more decision structure than Binary Relevance on eight, including five of the six on which the two are at predictive parity, even at equal hyperparameters, whereas per-label TreeSHAP rankings register the change of architecture without showing whether more is shared. Because a native forest routes every label through the same splits, SPF describes the fitted model rather than the data, and on eight of the nine benchmarks it rises when the feature-label signal is removed; a high SPF is therefore not evidence of shared predictive information. ms-DPG offers a global, predicate-level account of how a multi-output ensemble reuses decision conditions across its labels.

</details>


### [482] [The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21251)
*Xiaoyu Li,Jiangxuan Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将提示构造视为自适应数据分析，并以“上下文容量”衡量提示对数据存储信息的依赖；据此给出上下文泛化界、匹配下界和两种检索认证规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习分析常假设提示示例在学习器确定前就已抽取。但实际系统会在看到查询和数据存储后检索、筛选、重排、编辑并反复测试示例，因此被选中的上下文与数据存在依赖，直接用这些示例评估风险可能产生选择偏差。论文旨在刻画这种自适应选择对泛化保证的影响。

Method: 论文以条件随机核演算形式化自适应提示构造，并用数据存储与最终提示记录之间的互信息或近似最大信息定义上下文容量 κ。对于任意冻结的上下文学习器和容量为 κ 的自适应上下文流程，作者证明有限样本泛化误差界为 κ 与评分样本数 k 之比平方根量级，并给出匹配下界；当对数 k 远小于 κ、且 κ 远小于 k 时，下界常数精确。此外，论文提出两种基于概率近似的贝叶斯检索规则：一阶吉布斯规则对依赖数据的候选筛选门控计入先验概率质量，二阶规则采用自归一化处理。论文还将理论应用于贝叶斯线性上下文回归，并分析与查询对齐的高斯前 k 检索。

Result: 在银行业意图数据集上，使用 64 种检索方案和两类模型进行实验，所有 24,000 次重采样选择事件中的理论证书均成立。复用 64 个或 128 个验证查询时，吉布斯规则在超过 99% 的验证抽样中认证出低于零样本错误率的风险界。理论上，泛化界随上下文容量增大而变宽，随用于评分的示例数增加而收紧；下界表明这一依赖关系在量级上不可改进。

Conclusion: 上下文质量与上下文证据能否可靠认证是两个不同问题。更长或更相关的上下文未必自动带来可信的风险评估；只有当选择上下文的流程足够稳定、其自适应依赖受到控制时，选中示例上的表现才能推广到目标风险。

Abstract: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.

</details>


### [483] [On the Applicability of $p$-adic Numbers in Computational Modules for Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20467)
*Vladimir Evgrafov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，在所测试的设置下，将 $p$ 进数运算作为现有机器学习流程的中间模块，无法可靠复现线性回归预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨能否在不改变机器学习流程其余部分的情况下，用 $p$ 进数算术作为中间计算模块，并通过简单线性回归检验其适用性。

Method: 使用糖尿病数据集中的单特征线性回归作为测试模型，将拟合系数表示在 $p$ 进数域中并据此计算预测，再对结果进行有理数重构。实验比较了不同计算精度下的实现结果，也考察了正向转换及基于数字反转的替代表示。

Result: 在所测设置中，相关实现的有理数重构要么无法给出结果，要么与基准预测不一致；改变计算精度还可能改变重构值的大小和符号。另一种数字反转表示无法保持普通加法，因为进位会破坏其对应关系。所有测试预测均未能正确重构。

Conclusion: 这些实验说明，所测试的转换与重构方法即使应用于线性回归，也无法构成与现有机器学习流程兼容的中间模块。后续研究可考虑直接在 $p$ 进数数据与运算上定义模型。

Abstract: The applicability of $p$-adic arithmetic as an intermediate computational module in an otherwise unchanged machine-learning pipeline is investigated. A one-feature linear regression on the scikit-learn Diabetes dataset serves as the test model. The fitted coefficients are represented in $\mathbb{Q}_p$, predictions are computed in that field, and rational reconstruction is applied to the outputs. In the pyAdic experiments, rational reconstruction either returns no result or produces values that differ from the baseline predictions; changing computational precision can change both the magnitude and sign of the reconstructed value. In SageMath, forward conversions succeed, but the reconstructed predictions differ from the baseline. An alternative representation based on digit reversal fails to preserve ordinary addition because of carry propagation. Under the tested settings, none of the test predictions is reconstructed correctly. These results show that the tested conversion and reconstruction procedures do not provide a compatible intermediate module even for linear regression. Models defined directly over $p$-adic data and operations offer a direction for further investigation.

</details>


### [484] [SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21079)
*Pan Liu,Dongxin Lyu,Yusen Tan,Yifan Li,Hai-tao Yu,Yunhua Zhong,Zikun Wang,Tianze Ling,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种半监督从头肽段测序框架，联合利用已鉴定与未标注的质谱数据，以提升肽段识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型主要依赖数据库检索得到的高置信度肽段—谱图匹配进行训练，导致大量未能鉴定的谱图未被利用。训练数据因此与实际应用中的完整谱图分布存在偏差，限制了从头肽段测序的性能。

Method: 该框架首先构建来自多个公开蛋白质组学项目、经过质量控制的大规模未标注谱图数据集，以拓展训练数据并缓解分布偏差；随后结合逐步质量约束的自回归解码与累积路径置信度，从未标注谱图中筛选可靠监督信号；此外，采用按注意力头进行的化学证据门控，以改善对噪声及不完整碎裂信息的整合。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中表现优于或具有竞争力于现有先进方法。摘要未提供具体数值或各项指标。

Conclusion: 将未标注谱图纳入半监督训练，并利用质量约束、路径置信度和化学证据门控，有望缓解仅依赖数据库检索结果训练所带来的偏差，提升从头肽段测序的识别效果。

Abstract: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. SemiNovo first constructs DarkSpec, a large-scale quality-controlled corpus of unlabeled spectra collected from diverse public proteomics projects, thereby extending training beyond search-identified spectra and mitigating the resulting shift in DNPS supervision. It then combines stepwise mass-constrained autoregressive decoding with cumulative path confidence to derive reliable supervision from unlabeled spectra. Moreover, SemiNovo introduces head-wise chemical-evidence gating to improve spectral evidence aggregation under noisy and incomplete fragmentation. Experiments show that SemiNovo performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset are publicly available.

</details>


### [485] [Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21276)
*Donghyeok Lee,Sangkwon Park,Munyoung Chang,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅用于训练阶段的结构感知对齐正则化方法，使分子语言模型的表示更符合分子结构相似关系，同时保留其多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子语言模型虽由分子结构与文本配对数据训练，但其嵌入空间未必能体现分子之间由近及远的结构相似关系。若表示不符合化学领域已有的相似性知识，模型在检索及性质预测等任务中的化学可靠性可能受限。

Method: 作者提出结构感知引导对齐方法，在训练时使用中心化核对齐，将神经分子表示与基于分子指纹及塔尼莫托相似度得到的结构相似关系对齐。该方法不增加模型参数，也不要求推理时计算分子指纹。

Result: 在两种分子语言模型上的实验显示，该方法提升了分子—文本检索表现，使非完全匹配的检索结果更倾向于结构相近的类似物，并提高了骨架划分下性质预测的平均表现。单次运行的消融实验还表明，分子描述与文本到分子的生成能力得到改善或至少保持不变。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将成熟的化学信息学先验融入训练过程，可以使分子语言模型的表示更符合化学结构关系，并在不牺牲多模态实用性的前提下改善多项任务表现。

Abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.

</details>


### [486] [A Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-Head Attention Model: A Surrogate for Parallel DEVS Semiconductor Fab Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20493)
*Vamsi Krishna Pendyala,Hessam S. Sarjoughian,Edward J. Yellig,Bharadhwaj Balasubramaniam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出结合时间卷积网络与多头注意力的预测模型，用较低计算成本预测半导体工厂设备及设备组合的吞吐量和周转时间变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体制造流程复杂，晶圆批次需经过多台设备、多个加工步骤，并可能重复进入流程，生产周期可长达数天至数周。工厂运营因此需要快速、准确地预测设备吞吐量和周转时间，以支持排产、产能规划及维护决策；但高精度离散事件仿真计算成本较高。

Method: 作者提出时间卷积网络与多头注意力相结合的架构，并使用基准半导体工厂模型生成的仿真数据进行训练和评估。仿真涵盖不同批次规模、均匀或正弦变化的晶圆到达模式，以及预防性维护情形；批次规模、到达模式和维护策略作为静态协变量输入。模型针对选定的吞吐量与周转时间离散事件轨迹进行时间序列预测，并与其他模型架构比较。

Result: 在常用的平均绝对百分比误差、均方误差和决定系数等指标上，该模型的预测精度与其他架构相当或更高；模型参数规模和每轮训练时间也与其他架构相近。尽管其精度低于高分辨率仿真，但推理速度相对仿真可提升多个数量级。

Conclusion: 该方法在预测精度与计算效率之间取得实用平衡，可作为高成本仿真的快速替代或补充，支持更频繁的产品排产、产能规划和维护规划。

Abstract: Semiconductor factories process many kinds of wafers organized into lots of various sizes and configurations. Different kinds of machines, each with its own operations, process wafers for hours to days, and the wafers undergo many incremental fabrication steps (with re-entry) and flows spanning days to weeks across connected machines. Fast and accurate predictions of throughput ($TH$) and turnaround time ($TA$) dynamics for individual machines and their combinations are essential for factory operations. To use machine learning methods for this purpose, this paper presents a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) architecture. It uses simulated datasets from a benchmark Parallel DEVS (PDEVS) semiconductor fabrication factory model. The factory processes configurable wafer lots with uniform and sinusoidal wafer arrival profiles and may undergo preventive maintenance. The wafer lot size, arrival profile, and factory maintenance policy are used as static covariates. TCNA is applied to a selected set of simulated discrete-event throughput and turnaround time trajectories. The $TH$ and $TA$ time series predicted by TCNA, evaluated with the common $MAPE$, $MSE$, and $R^2$ measures, show comparable or higher accuracy relative to other model architectures, with similar parameter counts and epoch times; the TCNA model size and execution time are similar to those of other architectures such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer. Although time series predictions are less accurate than high-resolution simulations, they can be deployed at a much lower computational cost. The TCNA achieves orders-of-magnitude speedup over PDEVS simulation with an acceptable loss of accuracy, enabling frequent product scheduling, capacity planning, and maintenance planning.

</details>


### [487] [Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21111)
*Thomas Woehrle,Linus Ericsson,Henry Gouk,Elliot J. Crowley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将一种高表达性的神经架构搜索空间扩展到自回归序列建模，使搜索能够从基础运算出发构建模型，而非依赖预设的架构偏置；实验表明，该空间能够从头搜索出有效的自回归模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经架构搜索空间往往只能覆盖有限的既有架构类型；即使表达能力较强的空间，也主要针对图像分类。对于应用广泛的自回归序列建模，现有方法通常预先限定模型结构，缺少能够以基础运算为组件进行构造与搜索的通用空间。

Method: 将高表达性的神经架构搜索空间扩展为适用于自回归建模的搜索空间，使其能够用基础运算表示并搜索序列模型。论文通过一系列实验评估这一扩展，并强调搜索过程不依赖强结构先验。

Result: 实验显示，提出的搜索空间能够从头搜索出具备良好能力的自回归序列模型，说明其可以在不施加强架构偏置的条件下支持此类模型的构建。

Conclusion: 该工作为神经架构搜索工具箱补充了面向自回归建模的高表达性搜索空间，也提出了将自回归建模整合进其他表达性搜索空间的可借鉴思路。摘要未提供具体性能数值或与特定基线的比较结果。

Abstract: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.

</details>


### [488] [Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21408)
*Javier Aguilar Martín*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文检验了四种利用嵌入空间距离指导创意构思的做法。总体发现：远离已有内容的方向难以转化为有意义的文本，也很少能预测哪些领域会增长；模型续写通常更像原文，而非后续真实论文；按距离挑选灵感材料也未呈现预期的倒置曲线关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一种常见的创意构思方法认为，已有作品的嵌入空间可作为地图：寻找远离现有作品的位置，再将这些位置解码为新想法。论文旨在实证检验这种直觉，判断距离是否真的能帮助生成有意义的新颖内容、预测未来发展，或改善创意质量。

Method: 论文比较四类距离驱动方法与后来出现的作品：一是测试随机远方向是否能对应后续文本，并评估模型在有无邻近作品提示时生成目标内容的能力；二是在仅使用过去数据构建的聚类单元中，检验多种空缺度指标能否预测单元后续增长；三是比较模型对论文的续写与真实引用论文、提案改写及后续论文的相似度，并测试批评、真实后续标题及多种反馈的影响；四是按距离提供灵感材料，检验创意表现是否随距离呈倒置曲线变化。主要测试预先登记，部分后续测试在主要结果之后提出。

Result: 随机远方向与后续文本的余弦相似度极低；有邻近作品提示的模型在六组目标中都复述邻近内容。无邻居搜索能生成连贯文本，在内部空缺处的相似度中位数为零点五七和零点四七，并在多数比较中优于最近已有作品，但对远点的相似度仅为零点零七和零点零六。聚类空缺指标主要反映单元规模与位置，对后续增长的预测大多不优于机会水平，也未在游戏平台和预印本数据中带来超越增长动量的预测信息；专利结果不确定。模型续写比真实引用论文更接近原文；批评能使续写走得更远，但揭示真实后续论文标题所产生的方向性改变较小，且难以与一般修订或更长的生成步骤区分。灵感材料实验未发现倒置曲线，所谓“预期性”差异更多与材料形式而非内容相关。

Conclusion: 研究总体不支持“在嵌入空间中寻找远点即可获得有价值创意”这一简单策略。距离指标对未来增长的预测力有限，模型续写也容易停留在原文附近；即使反馈或批评能增加文本变化，也不能据此确认产生了真正面向后续工作的创新。结论仍需结合研究限制理解：部分后续分析并非预先登记，时间依据仅为本地版本提交记录。

Abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.

</details>


### [489] [RoShift: Lazy Shift and Weight-aware Rotation for Activation Sparsity in LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20549)
*Geunsoo Song,Jiwon Seo,Hoeseok Yang,Youngmin Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练的激活稀疏化方法，通过重心平移与旋转变换提升大语言模型解码效率，并尽量降低精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跳过不必要的权重读取和计算可以加速模型解码，但基于硅线性单元的模型天然激活稀疏度较低；若强行提高稀疏度，往往会显著损害准确率。因此，需要在不重新训练模型的前提下，改善激活分布并控制稀疏化带来的误差。

Method: 该方法首先采用延迟平移，将硅线性单元的激活分布重新居中至零附近，并把平移产生的修正推迟到前馈网络末端处理，以获得更高稀疏度。其次，利用同时考虑激活与权重信息的旋转变换，减少稀疏化造成的输出误差。最后，将平移和旋转所需的修正融合，以便把稀疏性收益转化为实际解码加速。

Result: 在五个模型上的实验显示，稀疏度为百分之五十和百分之六十时，该方法相较于对比方法的平均准确率分别提高一点六零和三点二九个百分点。在英伟达五零九零显卡上，百分之五十稀疏度下相较于密集计算最高实现一点七二倍解码加速，且准确率与速度之间的权衡优于对比方法。

Conclusion: 该方法通过改变激活表示而非重新训练模型，在提升稀疏度的同时有效控制精度损失，并取得实际解码加速。实验结果表明，它在准确率与速度的综合权衡上优于所比较的基线方法。

Abstract: Activation sparsity accelerates LLM decoding by skipping unnecessary weight reads and computation. However, SiLU-based LLMs exhibit little natural sparsity, and imposing high sparsity can substantially degrade accuracy. We propose RoShift, a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations. RoShift introduces lazy shift, which recenters SiLU activation distributions around zero and defers correction to the end of the FFN to obtain additional sparsity. It also reduces sparsification-induced output error through rotation that jointly accounts for activation and weight information. By fusing the corrections required for shifting and rotation, RoShift translates these gains into decoding speedup. At 50% and 60% sparsity, RoShift improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points, respectively, across five models. It achieves up to $1.72\times$ decoding speedup over the dense model on an RTX 5090 at 50% sparsity and yields a better accuracy-speedup Pareto frontier than TEAL. Code is available at https://github.com/hulahula3247/RoShift

</details>


### [490] [Conformal Expert Pools: Training-Free Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting Beyond Seasonality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21267)
*Valery Manokhin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出无需训练的符合性专家池方法，在多个时间序列预测基准上优于既有季节性方法、若干非参数预测器及在线集成方法，并以更窄区间、更快速度取得更好的预测表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的符合性季节池研究表明，仅利用季节位置相同的历史观测和过去预测误差、完全不训练模型，也能胜过学习型非参数预测器。但单一季节朴素预测器可能无法适应不同序列；此外，论文希望检验有关在线集成预测器表现优越的既有主张。

Method: 提出符合性专家池：以多个简单预测器组成候选池，依据这些预测器的历史预测误差构造预测分布，并针对当前待预测序列调整专家池及误差信息。方法不训练模型，也不跨序列学习参数；论文还在多步预测任务中，将其与原季节池、非参数预测器及在线集成预测器进行比较。

Result: 在包含232个数据集、24,502个预测窗口的基准上，该方法在78%的数据集上连续排序概率得分更优，在84%的数据集上平均缩放区间得分更优，在83%的数据集上温克勒得分更优。典型数据集的连续排序概率得分降低14%、平均缩放区间得分降低23%，95%预测区间覆盖率从90.1%升至92.2%。其连续排序概率得分也分别在88%、89%、83%的数据集上优于深度非参数预测器、非参数预测器和季节性非参数预测器；改进亦见于开发集之外的数据系列和另外36个基准文件。对在线集成方法的检验显示，原有“几乎胜过所有方法”及“胜过季节池”的主张不成立：季节池在多数数据集上表现更好，该在线方法排名靠后、区间最宽，且冷启动耗时约为季节池的7,700倍。新方法在82%的数据集上连续排序概率得分优于该在线方法，在80%的数据集上平均缩放区间得分更优，区间约窄40%，运行速度快271倍。

Conclusion: 结果表明，针对序列自适应选择简单预测器并利用其历史误差，可以在不训练模型的前提下显著改善预测准确度、区间覆盖与计算效率。论文同时指出，在线集成预测器的既有性能优势并未在所检验的多步预测基准上得到支持。

Abstract: Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP) showed that a forecaster with no training at all, built only from past values at the same point in the season and from past forecast errors, significantly outperformed DeepNPTS, Amazon's learned non-parametric forecaster. We propose Conformal Expert Pools (CEP), a training-free successor. CEP replaces the single seasonal-naive forecast by a pool of simple forecasters, builds its predictive distribution from their past forecast errors, and adapts both the pool and the errors to the series being forecast. No model is trained and no parameter is learned across series. On the CSP benchmark of 232 datasets and 24,502 forecast windows, CEP is better than CSP on 78% of datasets by CRPS, on 84% by MSIS and on 83% by Winkler score; on a typical dataset its CRPS is 14% lower and its MSIS 23% lower (both p < 1e-22, paired Wilcoxon test), and coverage of 95% intervals rises from 90.1% to 92.2%. CEP has a lower CRPS than DeepNPTS on 88% of datasets, than NPTS on 89% and than SeasonalNPTS on 83%. The improvement persists on dataset families outside the development set and on 36 additional fev-bench files. We also test the published claims that Laplace, an online ensemble forecaster, "beats (almost) everything" and "beats" CSP. On 228 datasets at multi-step horizons the claims do not hold: CSP outperforms Laplace on 60% of datasets by CRPS and on 64% by interval score, and Laplace ranks sixth of seven methods, with the widest intervals of all (69% wider than CEP's). Its point forecast is biased low and on 54% of datasets is less accurate than seasonal naive, and from a cold start it takes about 7,700 times longer than CSP. CEP is better than Laplace on 82% of datasets by CRPS and on 80% by MSIS, with intervals about 40% narrower, and runs 271 times faster.

</details>


### [491] [Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21432)
*Matteo Fischetti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在该小型模型上，用简单排序取代稀疏线性规划来分配权重修改，效果与原方法相近；结果表明，这种修改近似于沿循环方向施加恒定偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重空间编程通过修改多层感知机输出矩阵，抑制小型推理模型反复思考的循环。原方法依赖稀疏线性规划来确定神经元的修改幅度，计算较复杂，因此本文考察能否用更简单的规则替代它。

Method: 对模型输出矩阵实施秩一修改。替代方案是计算神经元激活值的变异系数，选取其中最小的八个神经元，并让它们平均分担原线性规划方案实现的推动量。研究还在若干抽样随机种子下比较两种方案，并测试不依赖线性规划确定修改强度的设置。

Result: 在一千道数学题上，排序方案准确率为百分之六十七点零，线性规划方案为百分之六十七点四，未修改模型为百分之九点五。两种修改方案的差值为负零点四个百分点，百分之九十五置信区间为负二点九至正二点一，落在预先设定的五个百分点非劣效界限内。其他抽样种子下，两者差值分别为负零点六和负零点八个百分点，置信区间也支持排序方案与线性规划方案表现接近。排序选中的神经元与线性规划所选神经元存在重合，且承载了后者大部分平均推动量。

Conclusion: 在所测试的模型上，复杂的线性规划并非必需：依据激活稳定性进行简单排序并平均分配修改量，能够获得近似的推理性能。结果也提示，该权重修改的主要作用可理解为沿循环方向施加近似恒定的偏置；结论目前仅由该模型及所述实验范围支持。

Abstract: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.

</details>


### [492] [Calibrated Functional Prediction from Overlapping Nonlinear Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20567)
*Peida Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种针对共享隐藏表格状态的非线性审计预测方法，并通过有限样本风险界进行认证；在多组基准评估中，其完整损失接近甚至优于若干对照方法，伽马求积也显著缩短积分时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个预测任务可能依赖同一个未观测的表格状态，任务之间还存在重叠、重复行和跨行相关性。若忽略这些结构，预测与风险评估可能不够准确。论文旨在利用共享状态中的相关结构，同时为实际部署的混合预测器提供可验证的有限样本风险保证。

Method: 针对舒尔有理算子，先用局部高斯投影构造可共同用于重叠任务、重复行标识及跨行依赖的稀疏核；再以共享状态的残差样本构造半正定特征表示，扩展该核。通过正矩阵积分及样本值包络，将原始输入与实际保存的混合预测器联系起来；随后利用按序校准角色扰动界，认证其在完整有限样本池上的分位数损失。超参数包括岭正则强度、得分尺度和残差权重，由独立的完整损失选择；任务秩校准则提供上界端点。

Result: 实验在十个基准数据群体上进行，使用每个数据集二十个新的参考情境，并设两种任务规模，共四百种评估条件。按数据集计算的平均完整损失比为：相较于二次核为零点九九七七，相较于匹配的完整蒙特卡洛收缩法为零点九九六一，相较于一百七十四种公开配置中的事后最优值为零点九九一一；最后一项的配对参考自助法区间为零点九八九八至零点九九二七。此外，在四十个精度容差为十的负七次方的测试配置中，伽马求积的冷启动时间几何平均比值为零点零六四六，即约为强化阿布—彼得拉斯积分法的百分之六点四六。

Conclusion: 该方法将共享隐藏状态带来的任务相关性纳入核预测，并为最终实际使用的混合预测器提供完整有限样本池上的风险认证。实验显示，其完整损失表现与强基线接近，并在与公开配置事后最优值比较时取得更低损失；伽马求积则在所测配置中带来明显的积分加速。

Abstract: We study prediction of nonlinear audit functionals from scalar observations of a shared hidden table state. For Schur-rational operators, local Gaussian projections yield a common sparse kernel for overlapping tasks, repeated row identities, and cross-row dependence. Shared-state residual samples extend this kernel through a positive-semidefinite feature representation. Positive matrix integration and sample-value enclosures connect the original inputs to the actual saved hybrid prediction. A sorted calibration-role perturbation bound then certifies its complete finite-pool pinball risk. Independent complete-loss selection chooses the ridge, score scale, and residual weight, while task-rank calibration supplies an upper endpoint. Evaluation uses twenty new reference contexts per dataset at two task sizes, giving 400 conditions across ten benchmark populations. The mean dataset complete-loss ratios are 0.9977 to the degree-two kernel, 0.9961 to matched complete-MC shrinkage, and 0.9911 to the retrospective minimum over 174 public configurations. The last ratio has a paired reference-bootstrap interval of [0.9898,0.9927]. On 40 profiles at coefficient tolerance $10^{-7}$, Gamma quadrature has a geometric mean cold-time ratio of .0646 to strengthened Arb/Petras integration.

</details>


### [493] [In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21268)
*Abdullah Ahmed,Yun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究变换器如何从少量含噪轨迹中估计常微分方程的未知参数并预测系统轨迹，并为相关方法给出理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论主要讨论变换器模拟凸统计问题中的梯度算法，或证明一般函数逼近能力，较少利用具体统计结构。常微分方程的参数估计通常是非凸问题，因此需要研究变换器能否在此类问题中通过上下文示例完成可靠估计与预测。

Method: 在满足可辨识性和正则性条件时，构造两阶段近似极大似然估计：先通过粗略搜索找到位于局部强凸区域内的初值，再使用具有局部线性收缩性质的梯度下降进行细化。轨迹预测则将参数估计器与常微分方程解映射的神经网络近似组合；通过参数共享，还可使单个变换器同时执行参数估计和轨迹预测。

Result: 论文为上述构造建立了非渐近保证和有限预训练样本下的预言机不等式，并分别刻画有限预训练数据、有限上下文长度以及变换器规模有限所造成的误差。线性和非线性常微分方程实验显示，预训练后的变换器能够从更长的推理上下文中获益，而无需更新模型权重。

Conclusion: 研究表明，变换器的上下文学习能力可用于具有非凸结构的常微分方程参数估计与轨迹预测。通过分阶段估计、解映射近似和参数共享，可以统一实现估计与预测，并对不同误差来源给出理论分析。

Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.

</details>


### [494] [Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21538)
*Arunkumar V,Manoranjan Gandhudi,Gangadharan G. R.,Arun Prakash,S. Senthilkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文构建了一个可精确计算真实过程奖励的强化学习测试环境，系统研究有缺陷的验证器如何影响训练。研究发现，验证器偏差会引发可预测的不同训练现象，其中乐观高估充分性的验证器会诱发填充式奖励投机，损害真实忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习会继承验证器的错误。在数学和代码之外，验证器通常只是代理指标、评分准则或学习得到的评审器，其与真实目标的偏差往往无法衡量，因此奖励上升并不意味着模型真正变好。论文旨在建立能够精确比较验证器奖励与真实目标的环境，并厘清验证器缺陷如何影响训练。

Method: 研究以可执行的授权策略为对象，覆盖124416种上下文，并构建能够为每项决策列出全部最小充分理由的精确预言机，再据此生成过程级真实奖励。作者沿七个现实维度削弱验证器，包括仅评结果、充分性判断、仅召回、抽取噪声、粗粒度分类、策略过时和大语言模型评审；训练时使用这些有缺陷的验证器，同时用精确验证器评估每次生成。研究还提出无需训练模型的验证器审计方法，考察选择错误、偏差方向，并进行短期饱和度试验。实验涵盖九种配置，变化因素包括训练框架、模型供应方、适配器规模、精度、初始化方式和随机种子。

Result: 实验观察到四类训练表现：乐观型验证器会被填充行为利用，充分性代理分数达到0.940时，96个留出回合上的真实忠实度却从0.731降至0.667；仅评结果的验证器会趋于饱和并停止提供有效学习信号；噪声会稀释训练信号；若验证器保持排序且分差不造成方向性误导，则未观察到损害。验证器审计及短期饱和试验能够预判训练表现。跨配置复现中，充分性损害在全部10个复现单元均为正，7个单元超过两个标准误；乐观偏差始终是更陡峭的损害分支。不过，损害幅度未能稳定复现，作者也报告了五项未能解释该差异的预注册尝试。

Conclusion: 验证器的分数不能单独作为真实进步的证据；验证器偏差的类型会导致不同且可预测的训练后果，尤其是乐观的充分性判断可能诱发奖励投机。训练前对验证器进行无模型审计、检查偏差方向并测试是否快速饱和，有助于识别风险。论文同时发布测试环境、训练监测工具及14项转化为可执行预言机的真实公开策略，为后续研究验证器可靠性提供了资源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.

</details>


### [495] [Quantum Computing-Based Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks for Airfoil Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20602)
*Abdur Rahman Ovy,Xiaosong Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以参数化量子电路作为生成器的量子瓦瑟斯坦生成对抗网络，用于翼型参数化；其整体拟合表现与经典模型相当，并在多项分布差异指标上更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 翼型气动优化通常需要在庞大设计空间中搜索，效率较低、可行区域有限，可能导致优化难以收敛。生成对抗网络能够学习已有翼型数据的分布，并生成平滑、合理的几何形状，从而缩小搜索空间。量子计算在部分工程问题中展现出潜力，但此前尚未用于翼型参数化，因此本文探索将量子计算引入这一任务。

Method: 构建量子瓦瑟斯坦生成对抗网络，以参数化量子电路作为生成器，判别器则采用经典结构。模型在由自由形变控制点表示的最优翼型数据集上进行验证；该数据集来自992次翼型气动设计优化，并与经典瓦瑟斯坦生成对抗网络进行比较。

Result: 量子模型对最优自由形变控制点的平均拟合准确率为92.1%，对翼型坐标的准确率为99.2%；经典模型对应为92.28%和99.26%，两者整体表现相近。此外，量子模型的詹森—香农散度、弗雷歇距离和瓦瑟斯坦距离均更低，表明其生成结果与参考翼型分布更一致。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，量子瓦瑟斯坦生成对抗网络可用于翼型参数化，在保持与经典方法相近拟合能力的同时，改善了若干分布一致性指标。该方法具有应用可行性，也为量子生成模型拓展至其他相关工程问题提供了初步依据。

Abstract: Airfoil geometry parameterization is essential in aerodynamic design optimization. Optimization search in the large space suffers from low efficiency and modest feasible region, which could further incur failures to convergence. Generative adversarial networks (GAN), aiming to learn the statistical distribution of existing data, pave a new avenue for shape generation and airfoil parameterization. GAN manages to implicitly reduce design space by generating only smooth, realistic airfoils. Meanwhile, quantum computing has been emergingly exhibiting great potential for achieving superior performance in specific types of engineering problems but has not been introduced to airfoil parameterization. To fill this gap, this work develops quantum computing-based Wasserstein GAN (Q-WGAN) and investigates the performance for airfoil parameterization. The Q-WGAN adopts parameterized quantum circuits as the generator to promote the generative performance, while the discriminator remains classical. The developed Q-WGAN is demonstrated on a dataset of optimal airfoils parameterized by free-form deformation (FFD) control points, resulting from 992 airfoil aerodynamic design optimizations. Results show that Q-WGAN achieves 92.1% mean fitting accuracy on the optimal FFD control points and 99.2% accuracy on airfoil coordinates, comparable with the classical WGAN performance of 92.28% on FFD control points and 99.26% on airfoil coordinates. Q-WGAN achieves lower Jensen-Shannon divergence, Fréchet distance, and Wasserstein distance than the classical WGAN, indicating an improved agreement with the reference airfoil distribution. Therefore, this work presents a convincing evidence that Q-WGAN makes a viable option for parameterizing airfoils and possesses a great potential for other relevant engineering applications.

</details>


### [496] [Programmable Semantic Interventions: Learning Causal Carriers from Behavioral Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21307)
*Paolo Muratore,Mackenzie Weygandt Mathis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出可编程语义干预：研究者直接声明某个变量可能对应哪些答案，以及干预后应得到哪个答案；方法据此学习模型内部的低秩激活子空间，无需人工标注的反事实样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果抽象旨在将模型内部激活与可解释模型中的变量对应起来，并检验两者在干预下是否一致。现有方法通常需要为提示词对构造反事实答案标签，往往依赖预先编写的行为算法；而其优化标准主要利用干预后的目标答案，未能直接表达变量与可能答案之间的语义关系。论文希望降低标注成本，并让研究者更直接地指定干预含义。

Method: 研究者通过“语义程序”声明变量可产生的答案，以及特定干预应产生的答案。可编程语义干预据此学习一个低秩激活子空间，使交换该子空间中的激活时，冻结模型的回答符合程序声明；预期答案则直接从冻结模型自身读取。研究还联合训练子空间以同时实现定位与控制，从而支持不依赖供体提示词的答案引导。

Result: 在多重干预基准上，在数据量和训练预算相同的情况下，该方法表现与监督式对齐相当，但不需要人工整理的反事实样本或真实标签。在隐去标准答案的自然科学问答任务中，它比使用标准答案训练的子空间更能追踪模型自身的回答。联合训练后，该方法对留出请求中由研究者指定的答案实现了百分之九十四点八的成功率，且无需供体提示词。

Conclusion: 语义程序为因果干预提供了更直接、可配置的语义接口，使研究者能够在减少标注依赖的同时定位并操控模型内部表征。实验显示，该方法既能复现监督式对齐的效果，也能依据模型自身答案进行对齐，并支持无需供体提示词的定向控制。

Abstract: Causal abstraction explains a frozen network by aligning its activations with the variables of a simpler, interpretable model, and checking that interventions on the two agree. Finding such an alignment currently requires a counterfactual dataset: for every pair of prompts, the answer the network ought to give once the variable has been changed. In practice, those labels are produced by an executable algorithm for the behavior, written before studying the model supposed to implement it. However, the criterion these methods optimize only leverages the answer an intervention should produce. Here, we develop an approach that lets the investigator define that relationship directly: the answers the variable can produce, and which of them an intervention should yield. We call this interface a semantic program and introduce Programmable Semantic Interventions (PSI): a low-rank activation subspace learned so that interchanging it changes the model's answer as the program declares, with the expected answers read from the frozen model itself. On the MIB benchmark PSI performs on par with supervised alignment at matched data and training budget, without curated pairs, and it needs no ground-truth labels; while on natural science questions with gold labels withheld, it tracks the model's own answers better than a subspace trained on gold labels. The declaration also fixes a coordinate system with known semantics, enabling donor-free steering: jointly training PSI for both localization and control realizes 94.8% of held-out requests for answers the investigator chooses, without the need for donor prompts.

</details>


### [497] [Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21554)
*Arunkumar V,Gangadharan G. R.,S. Senthilkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估语言模型分析央行文本时，是否因训练数据包含未来信息而显得更擅长预测；结果显示，直接测量模型对历史结果的记忆，比仅依赖实时预测表现更可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型可能在阅读历史央行声明时，已经从后续文本中获知当年的经济结果，造成类似测试集污染的时间泄漏。若不区分真实推断能力与对未来信息的记忆，就可能高估模型用于经济预测的能力。

Method: 研究使用二〇〇〇年至二〇二六年的联邦公开市场委员会声明和会议纪要，比较现代开放模型与仅接受某一固定日期之前文本训练的按时间约束模型。研究者让模型仅依据日期回答过去的国内生产总值表现，并将现代模型与无未来信息的模型在相同问题上的表现进行比较；同时检验成员推断分数是否反映模型是否见过特定文件，并评估实时预测中的前视优势及其统计显著性。

Result: 即使无法知道答案的时间约束模型，也能凭日期和时代先验取得最高零点六四的曲线下面积，因此随机猜测并非合适基准。相较这些基准，多数现代模型能回忆哪些年份经济增长较强。成员推断分数主要按年代和文件类型区分文件，而非判断模型是否见过文件；开放预训练语料中的精确计数也支持这一发现。实时预测中估计出的国内生产总值前视优势均小于宏观经济样本规模所能可靠检测的程度；国内生产总值和通胀结果经多重检验校正后，均无优势通过检验。

Conclusion: 评估语言模型的时间泄漏，应在相同问题上直接将现代模型与不可能接触未来信息的模型比较，并以此衡量记忆效应。仅观察预测表现或依赖成员推断，可能无法可靠识别模型对未来信息的记忆。

Abstract: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.

</details>


### [498] [DNA: A Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture for Industrial Digital Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20607)
*Haoran Yang,Yanan Xu,Yinan Zhang,Wenjie Zhang,Peiyu Liu,Jiahui Xiang,Wenhai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构，通过耦合机理模型与数据驱动模型提升工业数字孪生的预测精度；在两个工业系统上，平均绝对误差较最强基线分别降低百分之三点七零四和百分之三点一七五。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业数字孪生需要高保真模型，但机理模型虽具备物理可解释性，预测能力可能有限；数据驱动模型预测能力较强，却缺乏机理透明度。现有混合方法常存在融合不充分、采用单次建模策略等问题，难以适应复杂工业系统。

Method: 提出双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构，将机理建模与数据驱动建模视为相互交织的两条建模路径，并通过两种交互策略促进二者协同增强。架构还采用分层设计，以两种定制的深度学习框架分阶段刻画复杂系统。摘要未进一步说明交互策略及框架的具体实现细节。

Result: 在两个不同工业系统上的评估显示，该方法相较于最强基线，平均绝对误差分别降低百分之三点七零四和百分之三点一七五，表明其在所测试场景中具有更好的预测效果。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将机理模型与数据驱动模型进行深度、分层交互，以兼顾工业模型的预测能力与物理基础。该架构展现出应用于工业数字孪生的潜力，但摘要提供的实验范围有限，尚不足以判断其在更多系统和场景中的普适性。

Abstract: High-fidelity modeling is fundamental to industrial digital twin, yet a trade-off persists between the physical transparency of mechanistic models and the superior predictive power of data-driven approaches. Existing hybrid methods often fail to bridge this gap, suffering from shallow integration and rigid one-shot modeling strategies that struggle with complex industrial systems. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture (DNA)}. Inspired by the double-helix structure of biological \textit{DNA}, our architecture intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling strands through two novel interaction strategies, forming a symbiotic architecture in which the two strands mutually enhance predictive capability. Furthermore, the hierarchical structure of DNA allows it to model complex systems in a multi-stage manner through two tailored deep learning frameworks. We evaluate the proposed approach on two distinct industrial systems, where DNA achieves reductions in MAE of 3.704\% and 3.175\%, respectively, compared to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DNA and suggest its potential to provide new insights for the development of industrial digital twins.

</details>


### [499] [Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21310)
*Amin Golnari,Saeid Sanei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一种仅依据冻结语言模型隐空间的拓扑几何信息、无需梯度训练的模型编辑方法；实验显示类别纯度通常提高，基准准确率基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究关注能否在不读取目标模型原始权重、也不进行常规训练的情况下，仅通过观察其隐空间几何结构，使语言模型的表征组织得更成熟。

Method: 分析模型读取目标模型各层拓扑描述符的定长摘要，并据此提出表征变换；随后通过闭式岭回归将变换写入目标模型的前馈权重，全程不使用梯度训练。研究以轻量级模型开展实验，并比较分析模型与利用类别信息的启发式方法；还采用五模型轮换配对方案进行测试。

Result: 共进行了126次实验。结果显示，未见过的词语和句子上的类别纯度有所提高，而基准任务准确率的变化处于抽样误差范围内。分析模型达到与类别感知启发式方法相近的效果，但编辑幅度更温和。在五模型轮换配对实验中，16组配对提高了纯度，4组未改变目标模型。

Conclusion: 该研究为利用语言模型指导、无需训练且不依赖目标模型原始权重的模型编辑提供了初步基线。结果表明，拓扑几何摘要可能有助于改善表征组织，同时保持任务表现；但其结论目前主要限于轻量级模型和所测试的实验设置。

Abstract: Can an AI make a trained language model more mature, in the sense of a better organized latent space, by looking only at the geometry of that space? An analyst model reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors of the layers of a frozen target and proposes a transformation, which closed-form ridge regression writes into the feed-forward weights without gradient training. Using lightweight models, 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits. In a five-model round robin approach, 16 pairs raised purity and four left the target unchanged. The results provide a baseline for future work on LLM-guided, training-free model editing without using raw weights.

</details>


### [500] [Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21602)
*Ilia Azizi,Frederick Iat-Hin Tam,Marc-Olivier Boldi,Valérie Chavez-Demoulin,Tom Beucler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，国家飓风中心的热带气旋讨论文本可为数值环境预测因子提供额外信息，尤其能改善二十四小时最大持续风速预测；但快速增强时预测区间覆盖不足，且研究结果不宜直接用于实时业务预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带气旋预报讨论包含预报员对风暴强度及其变化的判断。研究旨在量化这些文字信息相对于数值预测因子的增量价值，并探索结合文本与环境数据能否提升强度预报、揭示专家判断的预测贡献。

Method: 研究分析了二〇〇二至二〇二三年大西洋和东太平洋的六百三十七个热带气旋个例，利用国家飓风中心发布的讨论文本，以及来自飓风统计预报系统和第五代欧洲中期天气预报中心再分析资料的十三项环境因子与十米风场，预测提前二十四至一百二十小时的强度变化。研究采用三种建模方法，并通过五个文本模型组成的集成模型评估文本与数值因子的联合效果；同时以整场风暴为单位重抽样评估不确定性，并分析文本特征的重要性及预测区间覆盖率。

Result: 端到端深度学习模型显示，仅使用讨论文本进行二十四小时强度预报，其价值与飓风统计预报因子相近。对二〇二二至二〇二三年风暴，集成模型加入讨论文本后，二十四小时最大持续风速预测的平均绝对误差由九点八九节降至八点九〇节，按整场风暴重抽样得到的置信区间不包含零。再分析风场对风速预测误差的影响较小；不同模型在不同预测变量和提前时效上的表现排序并不一致。预测区间在快速增强情形下未达到预设的百分之九十覆盖率。与强度及强度变化相关的词语，如增强、减弱、眼墙和等级，对模型预测较为重要。

Conclusion: 回顾性结果表明，预报员讨论文本含有数值环境因子未完全涵盖的有效信息，结合文本与数值资料有望改善热带气旋强度预报，也可用于研究专家判断的预测作用。不过，研究使用的再分析资料与实时分析存在差异，讨论文本的发布时间至少晚于其他输入资料对应时刻三小时，因此结果不能直接解释为实时业务预报能力。

Abstract: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.

</details>


### [501] [GPromptShield: Elevating Resilience in Graph Prompt Tuning against Adversarial Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20621)
*Shuhan Song,Ping Li,Ming Dun,Maolei Huang,Huawei Cao,Xiaochun Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文关注图提示学习在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，提出由直接处理与间接增强组成的防御系统，以提升下游图任务中提示的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图提示研究主要追求预训练任务与下游任务之间的兼容性，却较少考虑安全问题。研究发现，即使下游数据与预训练任务高度匹配，攻击者仍可通过隐蔽且简单的欺骗手段生成误导性提示，说明仅依靠任务兼容性不足以保障提示可靠。

Method: 提出一种可扩展的提示防御系统，从两个角度增强鲁棒性：一是直接处理，在输入图的特征空间中加入混合式多重防御提示，抵御不可靠偏见带来的无效信息；二是间接增强，通过训练策略绕开无效成分并强化有效部分。论文还从理论上推导其可行性，指出在特定的不可靠数据条件下存在无偏提示。

Result: 在多种对抗攻击场景下开展的实验表明，防御系统中的提示具有更强的抗攻击能力，并表现出优越性。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标或数值结果。

Conclusion: 本文将图提示学习的重点从任务兼容性拓展到对抗场景下的脆弱性与防御，为下游图任务中的鲁棒提示调优提供了新的思路和方法。

Abstract: The paradigm of ``pre-training and prompt-tuning", with its effectiveness and lightweight characteristics, has rapidly spread from the language field to the graph field. Several pioneering studies have designed specialized prompt functions for diverse downstream graph tasks based on various graph pre-training strategies. These prompts concentrate on the compatibility between the pre-training pretext and downstream graph tasks, aiming to bridge the gap between them. However, designing prompts blindly to adapt to downstream tasks based on this concept neglects crucial security issues. By conducting covert attacks on downstream graph data, we find that even when the downstream task data closely matches that of the pre-training tasks, it is still feasible to generate highly misleading prompts using simple deceptive techniques. In this paper, we shift the primary focus of graph prompts from compatibility to vulnerability issues in adversarial attack scenarios. We design a highly extensible shield defense system for the prompts, which enhances their robustness from two perspectives: Direct Handling and Indirect Amplification. When downstream graph data contains unreliable biases, the former directly combats invalid information by incorporating hybrid multi-defense prompts to the input graph's feature space, while the latter adopts a training strategy to bypass the invalid components and amplifies valid part. We provide a theoretical derivation that proves their feasibility, indicating that unbiased prompts exist under certain conditions on unreliable data. Extensive experiments across various scenarios of adversarial attacks indicate that the prompts within our defense system exhibit enhanced resilience and superiority. This paper explores a new perspective in graph prompt learning, offering a novel option for robust prompt tuning in downstream tasks.

</details>


### [502] [Representational Change Under Self-Consuming Training: A Sparse Autoencoder Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21348)
*Suchit Gupte,Zhongteng Cai,Xueru Zhang,Mohammad Mahdi Khalili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 模型反复使用自身生成的数据训练，会导致内部表征逐代漂移。稀疏自编码器经微调后虽能恢复重构能力，但任务信息不再集中于少数特征，因此重构良好并不代表仍适合解释模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于模型自我循环训练的研究主要关注生成质量和下游表现，对模型内部表征如何变化，以及稀疏自编码器在这种变化下是否仍可靠，了解不足。

Method: 研究追踪五代自我循环训练过程，并将使用合成数据训练的模型与训练设置相同、使用真实数据训练的对照模型进行比较。评估训练于自我循环之前的稀疏自编码器迁移至后续代际时的重构能力与稀疏性，并考察不同宽度、架构和模型层的差异。随后对原有自编码器逐代微调，通过稀疏探测检验任务相关信息是否仍集中在少数潜在特征中。

Result: 未经适配的稀疏自编码器在自我循环模型上的表现逐代下降，重构和稀疏性差距不断扩大，且不同层之间差异明显。微调大体恢复了重构能力，但未恢复特征层面的实用性：任务信息仍存在于完整潜在空间中，却分散到更多特征里。

Conclusion: 自我循环训练会引发模型表征漂移。仅凭重构保真度，无法判断适配后的稀疏自编码器是否仍能有效揭示模型特征；解释性评估还应考察任务信息在特征中的集中程度。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly exposed to model-generated text, raising the possibility that future models will be trained recursively on the outputs of their predecessors. Prior work on such self-consuming training loops has largely focused on output quality and downstream performance, leaving their effects on internal representations poorly understood. We study how representations evolve across five generations of self-consumption and whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) remain reliable under this shift. At each generation, we compare a lineage trained on synthetic data with a matched control trained on real data under the same training settings. We evaluate how well SAEs trained before self-consumption transfer to later generations, measuring reconstruction and sparsity across SAE widths, architectures, and model layers. We then fine-tune the original SAE on each generation and use sparse probing to test whether task-relevant information remains concentrated in a small number of latents or becomes more distributed across the representation. We find that zero-shot SAE performance degrades progressively under self-consumption, with growing reconstruction and sparsity gaps that vary substantially across layers. Fine-tuning largely restores reconstruction, but not feature-level usefulness: task-relevant information remains accessible in the full latent space while becoming less concentrated in individual features. These results show that self-consumption induces representational drift and that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient to establish that an adapted SAE remains equally useful for interpretation.

</details>


### [503] [Latent Lattice Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21608)
*Shivam Duggal,Zongze Wu,William T. Freeman,Antonio Torralba,Richard Zhang,Eli Shechtman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“潜变量格架”，为模型各层增加跨词元持续更新的计算状态。在参数量匹配的实验中，该方法降低了验证困惑度，并能与多种架构及残差改进方法结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提升语言模型计算能力的方式，通常依赖增加网络深度、循环计算或潜在推理步骤；改进残差连接则主要优化层间信息流。论文关注另一种扩展方向：增加模型在每个词元处理过程中可维持的活跃计算状态，使模型拥有更丰富的计算能力。

Method: 在每一层加入沿序列时间方向循环更新的横向潜变量流，与沿网络深度传递的纵向残差流并行工作。这些潜变量不仅充当序列记忆，还直接影响残差流的注意力计算、键值缓存写入、多层感知机运算和解码过程。该方法可与超连接、输入残差连接以及多种循环或混合架构组合。

Result: 在使用约二百亿个教育类网页文本词元训练的实验中，参数量约四亿零六百万的潜变量格架模型，将验证困惑度从基线模型的15.41降至14.40。结合超连接与输入残差后，困惑度进一步从相应增强基线的14.22降至13.61。在多种门控差分网络、状态空间模型及混合架构上，该方法也在所有测试的原生状态规模下改善困惑度；部分变体甚至超过原生状态规模大四倍的基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明，跨词元持续存在的逐层计算状态，是区别于加深网络或改进残差路径的有效扩展维度。潜变量格架能够与既有增强方法和多种架构互补，为提升语言模型计算能力提供了有前景的途径。

Abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

</details>


### [504] [Contrastive Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation for Memory-Efficient LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20635)
*Weiyun Huang,Alessio Galatolo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该方法利用偏好回答与拒绝回答之间的激活差异构造低秩搜索空间，在无需反向传播的情况下提升偏好优化效果，并降低显存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接偏好优化虽简化了基于人类反馈的强化学习，但仍依赖反向传播，激活值会带来较高显存开销。零阶优化无需反向传播，却通常采用各向同性扰动；对于由偏好回答与拒绝回答之差定义的目标，这类扰动容易产生噪声较大的更新。

Method: 提出对比激活引导的零阶直接偏好优化。对每组偏好样本，计算偏好回答与拒绝回答的激活差异，并据此构造低秩搜索子空间；优化扰动仅在该子空间内进行。同时，在低秩坐标中维护动量，以保留零阶训练的显存优势。

Result: 在使用人类反馈数据集对一款十五亿参数模型进行实验时，该方法优于常见的零阶优化基线，并在成对偏好评估中达到与一阶直接偏好优化相近的表现。在序列长度为二千零四十八时，其峰值显存降低约百分之五十九，同时保留了零阶训练随序列长度变化的扩展特性。

Conclusion: 通过利用偏好回答与拒绝回答的激活差异来引导低秩扰动，该方法缓解了零阶优化在偏好目标上的更新噪声，并兼顾了偏好效果与显存效率，为资源受限的大模型偏好训练提供了一种可行方案。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback, but still relies on traditional backpropagation and its associated activation-memory cost. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation avoids backpropagation, yet isotropic perturbations can produce noisy updates for preference objectives defined by differences between chosen and rejected responses. We introduce Contrastive Activation-guided Zeroth-Order Direct Preference Optimisation (CA-ZODPO), which constructs a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between the chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair. Perturbations are restricted to this subspace, while momentum is maintained in low-rank coordinates to preserve the memory advantages of ZO training. On Qwen2.5-1.5B with Anthropic HH-RLHF, CA-ZODPO outperforms common ZO baselines and remains competitive with first-order DPO in pairwise preference evaluation. It also reduces peak GPU memory by about 59\% at a sequence length of 2048 while retaining the sequence-length scaling behaviour of zeroth-order training.

</details>


### [505] [Emergent Steering Beyond Endpoint Alignment in Chemical Reaction Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21423)
*Yili Shen,Kehan Guo,Haomin Zhuang,Xiangliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的正向反应与逆合成分析框架，通过潜在空间中的位移分解，揭示模型如何利用目标信息引导预测，并支持超越终点准确率的失效审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学反应预测通常只依据最终产物或反应物是否正确来评估，但这种指标无法说明模型如何表征化学变化，也难以解释预测失败的原因。研究旨在提供一种可审查模型内部反应表征与方向性更新的方法。

Method: 提出统一的正向反应与逆合成框架，将两类任务表示为共享潜在空间中受方向条件控制的终点再分布。框架对齐源状态、转化状态和编码后的目标终点，并将从编码器源状态到解码器侧转化状态的潜在位移，分解为与目标终点方向平行的分量及其正交残差；作者将这种残差引导作用称为“涌现式引导”。该分解还用于构建模型侧失效的代理分类。

Result: 实验表明，涌现式引导具有实际功能：在逆合成任务中，它保留了模型大部分效用；在随机、打乱及原型对照下仍然有效，并会直接影响哪些化学键编辑被促进或抑制。残差强于平行分量这一排序，在不同对齐强度、解码器接口校准、与角度匹配的随机轴比较以及另一种图编辑架构中均保持成立；不过，其效应大小会随参考轴和优化过程而变化。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，反应模型的内部预测机制不能仅由终点准确率刻画。对潜在位移进行方向性分解，可揭示目标信息如何影响化学键编辑，并为模型失效审计提供新的代理工具；但分解结果的强弱依赖参考方向与训练优化设置。

Abstract: Machine learning models for chemical reaction prediction are usually evaluated by endpoint accuracy, but endpoint correctness alone does not reveal how a model represents chemical transformation or why it fails. We introduce UniRxnAxis, a unified forward-retrosynthesis framework that models both tasks as direction-conditioned endpoint redistribution in a shared latent space. By aligning source states, transformed states, and encoded target endpoints, UniRxnAxis enables directional auditing of learned latent updates. This shared latent geometry allows the learned displacement (from the encoder source state $S_0$ to the decoder-facing transformed state $S_1$) to be decomposed into an endpoint-parallel component and an endpoint-orthogonal residual, which we call emergent steering. Our evaluation shows that emergent steering is functionally important: in retrosynthesis, it recovers most of the model's utility, remains effective under random, shuffled, and prototype controls, and directly affects which bond edits are promoted or suppressed. The residual-over-parallel ordering persists across alignment strengths, after decoder-interface calibration, against angle-matched random axes, and in a second graph-edit architecture, although its magnitude depends on the reference axis and optimization. The decomposition also supports a proxy taxonomy of model-side failures, showing how reaction models can be audited beyond endpoint accuracy.

</details>


### [506] [Enhancing Mixed Oil Length Prediction through Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20660)
*Xinyi Hong,Hai Shu,Zhaoyang Zhang,Lei Chen,Yanfeng Yang,Ziqi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种融入样本依赖关系的图表示学习模型，用于预测成品油管道输送中的混油段长度；案例结果显示，其预测误差较现有最优方法降低超过百分之十。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成品油管道输送中不可避免地产生混油段，长度预测不准会带来经济损失。既有机器学习和深度学习方法虽取得较好效果，却忽略了实际混油样本之间的统计依赖关系，因而限制了预测精度。

Method: 将样本和管道特征表示为图中的节点，并依据样本共享的特征连接具有依赖关系的样本。模型通过图上的信息传递，在相关样本之间传播信息，以学习样本间的统计依赖并预测混油段长度。

Result: 在混油数据集上的案例研究表明，该模型优于表现最强的现有方法，均方根误差和平均绝对误差均降低超过百分之十。

Conclusion: 将样本间依赖关系纳入图表示学习，有助于弥补传统方法对这类关系建模不足的问题，并提升混油段长度预测的准确性。

Abstract: During the pipeline transportation of refined oil products, the inevitable formation of mixed oil segments poses considerable economic challenges to pipeline networks. Therefore, it is important to accurately predict the length of these mixed oil segments. Although previous methods have achieved relatively accurate predictions by integrating machine and deep learning algorithms, they ignore the statistical dependencies that remain among real-world mixed oil samples, which degrades model accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a novel Sample Dependencies Incorporated Graph Representation Learning (SDI-GRL) model. By representing samples and pipeline features as nodes of a graph, SDI-GRL connects dependent samples through their shared features, allowing message passing to propagate information across related samples. This graph-based framework allows our model to capture the statistical dependencies among samples absent in prior works. A case study on a mixed oil dataset demonstrates that our SDI-GRL model surpasses the strongest existing approach, reducing both the RMSE and the MAE by more than 10%.

</details>


### [507] [A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21439)
*Jacky Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究将标准模型有效场论中多算符组合的探索转化为强化学习问题，并表明该方法能够高效发现多样且拟合效果良好的新物理理论假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粒子物理实验与标准模型预测之间存在偏差时，标准模型有效场论可用于系统描述多种可能的新物理模型。但大量算符可能同时影响多个观测量，彼此作用相关，且不同算符组合可能同样适配数据，使搜索迅速变成困难的组合优化问题。研究旨在提升这一搜索的效率，并避免只寻找单一最佳拟合解。

Method: 将算符空间探索建模为序贯决策过程，采用约含四万个可训练参数的轻量级行动者—评论家强化学习架构。智能体逐步构造多算符理论假设，目标是发现一组多样且质量较高的解释，而非仅优化一个最佳解。研究在涵盖粒子物理多个领域、共含一百三十二个观测量的现象学环境中进行测试，其中二十四项测量与标准模型预测相差超过一点五个标准差；并与随机子集搜索及随机序贯搜索进行比较。

Result: 强化学习策略能够高效构造多算符理论，并显著改善整体数据拟合。与两种随机搜索基线的比较显示，该策略能够有效应对庞大的组合空间，并发现多种高质量假设。

Conclusion: 研究表明，强化学习可作为系统探索标准模型有效场论算符空间的框架，用于发掘多样的新物理相互作用模式。其价值不仅在于改善拟合，也在于有组织地搜索多种可能的理论解释。

Abstract: In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total. Rather than searching for a single best-fit theory, our method is designed to discover a diverse set of high-quality theory hypotheses. We test the method in a complex phenomenological environment comprising 132 observables across several sectors of particle physics, including 24 measurements that deviate from their SM predictions by more than $1.5σ$. We show that the learned RL policy efficiently constructs multi-operator theories that substantially improve the global fit. Comparisons with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches demonstrate the ability of the RL policy to navigate this large combinatorial space. Our results establish RL as a systematic framework for exploring diverse patterns of new physics (NP) interactions within SMEFT.

</details>


### [508] [ParGLU: Partial Gating Improves Language Modeling in MoE Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20663)
*Yuting Ge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种部分门控前馈网络，在相同参数量和主要矩阵计算预算下结合两种不同激活分支；在中大型混合专家模型中优于传统全门控结构，尤其改善低频词建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 门控结构能够提升变换器前馈网络的效果，但在固定参数预算下会压缩中间表示宽度。对于单个专家容量有限的混合专家模型，这种容量取舍尤为重要。论文因此探讨：是否可以通过部分门控，更有效地利用专家的参数预算。

Method: 提出部分门控前馈网络，将由平滑门控线性单元构成的分支与采用平方修正线性单元的分支并行组合。该结构与传统平滑门控线性单元前馈网络保持相同的参数量和主要矩阵计算预算。研究在三种规模的混合专家语言模型上进行实验，每种规模使用三个随机种子，并通过消融实验分析模型宽度、专家宽度及各分支的作用。

Result: 在七千五百万和一亿五千二百万规模下，部分门控结构的三个随机种子均优于传统结构，验证集平均负对数似然分别降低零点零二零零和零点零二四九；三千万规模的结果则不一致。消融结果显示，增大骨干网络宽度或专家宽度会增强部分门控结构的相对优势；两种分支结合也优于单独使用任一分支。按词频分析发现，低频词的改善更明显。

Conclusion: 混合专家模型中，完全门控的前馈网络并非总能最有效地利用有限的专家参数预算。将门控与非门控计算结合的部分门控设计，在较大模型规模下能够提升语言建模效果，且对低频词尤其有益。

Abstract: Multiplicative gating improves Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs), but it reduces intermediate representation width under a fixed parameter budget. This trade-off is particularly relevant to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where individual experts have limited capacity. We introduce ParGLU, a partially gated FFN that combines SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ in two parallel branches. ParGLU matches the parameter count and principal matrix computation budget of conventional SwiGLU. We evaluate ParGLU in 30M, 75M, and 152M MoE language models using three random seeds per scale. ParGLU outperforms SwiGLU across all three seeds at 75M and 152M, reducing mean validation NLL by 0.0200 and 0.0249, respectively. Results at 30M are mixed. Controlled ablations show that increasing backbone width or expert width strengthens ParGLU's relative performance. Ablation studies further show that combining SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ improves performance over either architecture alone. Token-frequency analysis reveals larger improvements on low-frequency tokens. These findings show that fully gated FFNs are not always the most effective use of an MoE expert's parameter budget. Partial gating can improve language modeling in MoE Transformers.

</details>


### [509] [Warm Starting Neural Dynamics Models From Few Jacobian Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21465)
*Maxime Rochkoulets,Joppe De Jonghe,Mariya Ishteva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种利用状态转移雅可比矩阵预热神经动力学模型的方法，在低数据量场景下提升模型学习效率，并减少回合间训练步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习依赖环境动力学模型进行规划和生成样本。已有证据表明，合理的模型初始化能显著提高学习效率，但随机初始化等方式可能在数据有限时收敛较慢，因此论文探索利用转移雅可比信息改进初始化。

Method: 作者提出一种基于张量分解的解耦算法：将多组转移雅可比样本堆叠成张量并进行分解，以恢复网络权重及灵活的非线性函数，再据此初始化前馈神经网络动力学模型。

Result: 在多个基准环境的低数据量实验中，该方法优于随机初始化和价值训练；与索伯列夫训练相比，表现持平或更好，同时回合之间所需的训练步数更少。摘要未提供具体数值或统计显著性信息。

Conclusion: 利用转移雅可比进行结构化初始化，可作为提升神经动力学模型学习效率的有效手段，尤其适用于数据有限的基于模型的强化学习场景。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) leverages a model of the environment, used for planning and generating samples without interacting with the real world. Motivated by evidence that informed initialization significantly improves the efficiency of MBRL, we propose TDec-Init, an algorithm to warm-start neural dynamics models using transition Jacobians. Using a decoupling algorithm based on the decomposition of a tensor of stacked Jacobian samples, we recover weights and flexible nonlinearities, and use them to initialize a feedforward neural network. In the low-data regime, we show on several benchmark environments that our approach outperforms random initialization and value training, and either matches or outperforms Sobolev training, while requiring fewer training steps between episodes.

</details>


### [510] [Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20666)
*Mike Hänseroth,Niklas Wahlström,Thomas B. Schön,Thomas Seel,Jan-Hendrik Ewering*

Main category: cs.LG
