In this paper, we obtain finite-time bounds for heterogeneous FRL with average rewards. We show that optimal convergence rate and linear speedup are achievable even with a universal stepsize choice, independent of the underlying dynamics. To achieve our result, we modify the existing one-timescale FRL method to a novel two-timescale variant that additionally incorporates iterate averaging. We remark that this idea also extends to other settings already studied in the literature, such as the homogeneous FRL or the heterogeneous case with a discounted cost function.

</details>


### [544] [Learning What Pairs Miss for Higher-Order Multimodal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21372)
*Kunyu Zhang,Shenghui Feng,Xiangjie Shi,Zeqing Wang,Yingxu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种利用“配对模型难以区分的诱饵样本”训练高阶残差的方法，使模型更善于识别必须结合三种模态才能判断的样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态对比学习虽可使用能够表达联合分布的评分函数，但训练中的负样本往往同时破坏多个模态配对，单独检查某一对模态就足以将其排除。因此，当多数样本仅凭配对关系即可区分时，高阶交互项难以获得有效梯度，模型容易退化为若干配对关系的集合。

Method: 该方法先建立经过校准的配对模型，再从中生成该模型认为合理的诱饵负样本。由于这些样本较难通过单一模态配对排除，模型通常需要利用三种模态的联合信息加以区分。生成诱饵只需对记忆库进行一次内积查询。理论上，最优残差对应数据分布与配对模型之间的对数比值；诱饵损失也因此能够衡量配对模型遗漏的信息。

Result: 在仅有十分之一训练样本需要综合三种模态才能判别的基准数据集上，该方法在这类样本上的准确率比八种基线中最强者高二十一点二个百分点。在所有真实数据集的二对一设置中，该方法也取得最佳结果。此外，学得的残差无需重新训练即可提升其他检索器的表现。

Conclusion: 通过针对配对模型难以解释的样本训练残差，该方法能更有效地学习多模态高阶交互，尤其适用于配对线索不足以完成判别的情形；其残差还具有迁移价值，可用于增强现有检索模型。

Abstract: Contrastive learning beyond two modalities now scores the whole tuple with multilinear products, volumes, and fusion heads, critics that can represent the joint distribution. In practice these critics still behave like bags of pairs. Their negatives break at least two of the three pairs, a single pairwise check rejects them, and when most samples can be solved by pairs the higher-order term receives almost no gradient. To solve this problem, we propose CHORD (Contrastive Higher-Order Residuals with Decoys), which trains a residual against decoys drawn from a calibrated pairwise model, negatives that the pairwise model finds plausible, so that rejecting them often needs all three modalities. Drawing decoys costs one inner-product query over a memory bank, and the optimal residual is the log-ratio between the data and the pairwise model, so the decoy loss also bounds what that model misses. On M3-Mix, where one in ten training samples needs all three modalities, our CHORD improves accuracy on those samples by 21.2 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines. CHORD also gives the best two-to-one results on every real dataset, and its residual improves other retrievers without retraining.

</details>


### [545] [MegNIST, A Benchmark for Non-Invasive Inner Speech Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21399)
*Teyun Kwon,Pratik Somaiya,Gereon Elvers,Francesco Mantegna,Anna Camera,Sven Braeutigam,Mark Woolrich,Oiwi Parker Jones*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究发布了一个用于脑磁图内言语解码的标准化数据集，并提供基准结果与工具，便于研究者开发和比较非侵入式脑机接口方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内言语解码有望支持非侵入式脑机接口，但研究发展需要可复用、划分规范且便于评测的数据资源。该数据集旨在降低数据处理和实验复现门槛，促进方法开发与公平比较。

Method: 数据集包含一名参与者在四次实验中想象说出数字零至九的共一万二千个试次。每个试次记录三百零六通道脑磁信号，采样率为每秒二百五十次，并经过信号空间分离、滤波和降采样处理。数据按完整实验运行划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，分别包含一万个、一千个和一千个试次，以减少时间相关性造成的信息泄漏；同时提供适用于神经影像分析和机器学习流程的格式、基准方法及示例工具。

Result: 基准分类实验表明，想象的数字可以被解码，且准确率显著高于随机水平。摘要未提供具体准确率或不同方法之间的比较结果。

Conclusion: 该数据集为脑磁图内言语解码提供了标准化的基准资源。预定义数据划分、已验证的基准结果和配套工具有助于提升研究的可复现性，并加快非侵入式脑机接口解码方法的开发与评估。

Abstract: MegNIST is a benchmark dataset for developing and evaluating machine learning methods for inner speech decoding from magnetoencephalography (MEG). The dataset comprises 12,000 trials of a single participant imagining speaking the digits zero through nine, recorded across four sessions. Each trial contains 306-channel MEG recordings sampled at 250 Hz, preprocessed using signal space separation, filtering, and downsampling. Data are provided as pre-defined training (10,000 trials), validation (1,000 trials), and test (1,000 trials) splits, with entire experimental runs assigned to each split to preserve temporal independence. The dataset is available in both BIDS format for neuroimaging analysis and as serialised tensors for machine learning workflows. Baseline classification results demonstrate that imagined digits can be decoded significantly above chance. Standardised splits, validated baselines, example code, and a PyTorch-compatible loader in the pnpl Python library enable straightforward integration with machine learning frameworks, lowering barriers for researchers to rapidly develop and benchmark inner speech decoding methods for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.

</details>


### [546] [Efficient Modeling of Multi-Agent Systems via Structure-Aware Physics-Informed Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21404)
*Yulun Wu,Nicola Bastianello,Karl Henrik Johansson,Matthieu Barreau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大规模多智能体系统的物理信息神经网络方法，以共享时间特征和个体系数表示轨迹，并利用局部交互降低计算与存储开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多智能体网络规模扩大、耦合增强，轨迹推断和物理参数识别的计算成本迅速上升；部分观测还要求恢复未观测状态。现有方法难以同时兼顾大规模计算效率、轨迹精度和参数识别能力。

Method: 该方法将各个体的轨迹表示为共享时间特征与个体专属系数的组合，并设计交替训练流程，依次学习特征、拟合耦合轨迹和估计物理参数。针对轨迹拟合，采用无需显式构造大型全局矩阵的矩阵自由更新，并利用网络拓扑和个体间相似性减少计算与内存需求。

Result: 在洛伦兹环、洛特卡—沃尔泰拉网络和罗斯勒振子等系统上的实验表明，该方法相较基线取得了更高的轨迹推断与参数识别精度，并适用于大规模系统、部分观测以及拓扑未知的情形。系数拟合阶段还实现了显著的计算节省。

Conclusion: 通过结合共享特征表示、网络结构信息和局部交互计算，该方法为大规模多智能体系统的轨迹重建与参数识别提供了兼顾精度和效率的方案；实验结果显示其在观测不完整或网络拓扑未知时仍具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Modeling large multi-agent systems poses challenges for trajectory inference and parameter identification, as network size and coupling increase computational demands and partial observations require reconstructing unobserved states. We propose MAS-PINN, a neural-network architecture with a tailored training algorithm for a physics-informed learning framework that leverages the network topology and the agents' similarity to reduce computational and memory costs of simulating and identifying multi-agent systems. Its architecture represents agent trajectories through shared temporal features and agent-specific coefficients. Training alternates between learning features, fitting coupled trajectories, and estimating physical parameters. A matrix-free update exploits local interactions to fit trajectories without forming large global matrices. Experiments on Lorenz rings, Lotka--Volterra networks, and Rössler oscillators show improved trajectory and parameter accuracy over baselines, including inference in large systems and identification under partial observations or unknown topology, alongside substantial computational savings in coefficient fitting.

</details>


### [547] [Variational Monte Carlo for Quantum Excited States via Nested Low-Rank Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21434)
*Minchan Jeong,J. Jon Ryu,Se-Young Yun,Gregory W. Wornell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出嵌套低秩近似变分蒙特卡洛方法，以较低计算开销求解分子低能激发态；在锂至氖原子、十个态的测试中，精度与现有先进方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络变分蒙特卡洛已能以化学精度求解小分子的基态，但推广到激发态面临效率与稳定性的权衡：惩罚法每步需计算与态数成正比的拉普拉斯项，却必须调节重叠惩罚权重；无惩罚的自然激发态方法则因将多个波函数组合成一个行列式，每步需要计算与态数平方成正比的拉普拉斯项。

Method: 作者利用低秩近似原理重新参数化秩为态数的变分目标，构造可与变分蒙特卡洛结合的随机梯度估计器，并通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛从各态的玻恩概率密度采样。再采用逐级嵌套方案，依次恢复按能量排序的最低若干本征态，形成嵌套低秩近似变分蒙特卡洛算法。

Result: 在锂至氖的第一周期原子、计算十个态的实验中，该方法取得的精度与自然激发态变分蒙特卡洛及先进惩罚法相当。摘要还指出，该算法继承了低秩近似原理所提供的全局最优性保证。

Conclusion: 该方法针对激发态求解中惩罚权重调节与高昂计算开销之间的矛盾，提出了兼具无惩罚优化、较低计算复杂度和全局最优性保证的方案，并展示了与现有先进方法相当的数值精度。

Abstract: The electronic Schrödinger equation encodes a molecule's electronic structure and quantum properties, but solving it scales exponentially with the number of electrons. Solving this equation with neural-network variational Monte Carlo (VMC) has reached chemical accuracy on the ground state of small molecules; extending this success to excited states is constrained by two existing paradigms. Penalty-based methods need $K$ Laplacians per step but require tuning the overlap-penalty weights against the energy gaps they aim to compute. Natural excited states VMC (NES-VMC) is penalty-free, but it combines the $K$ ansatzes into one determinant, whose local energy requires $K^2$ Laplacians per step. We resolve this trade-off via low-rank approximation (LoRA) reparameterization of the rank-$K$ variational objective. The reparameterized objective admits a VMC-compatible stochastic gradient estimator via MCMC sampling from the per-state Born densities, and a sequential nesting scheme recovers the lowest $K$ eigenstates in eigenvalue order. The resulting algorithm, NestedLoRA-VMC, inherits a global optimality guarantee from the LoRA principle. On the first-row atoms Li through Ne at $K=10$, its accuracy is comparable to that of NES-VMC and of a state-of-the-art penalty-based method.

</details>


### [548] [DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21571)
*Van Tuan Nguyen,Agathe Guilloux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向动态生存预测的模型无关解释框架，可随患者新数据到来更新解释，并在降低计算开销的同时提供细粒度的时间维度特征重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 融合纵向数据的生存模型预测能力较强，但预测过程难以解释，限制了其临床应用。现有时间维度解释方法计算成本较高，因此需要一种兼顾解释细致程度与效率的方案。

Method: 框架基于夏普利值，采用分层两阶段策略：先筛选重要的纵向特征，再自适应地细化这些特征在不同时间点的重要性。它可处理静态与纵向协变量，并随着患者数据更新提供随时间变化的解释。

Result: 模拟实验和两个临床数据集的结果显示，解释与理论重要性的吻合程度因预测模型而异，表现较好的模型通常吻合更高；真实临床数据中的解释具有可理解性。该框架在不同预测设定下保持稳健，较时间维度解释基线减少百分之四十一至百分之八十的计算时间。

Conclusion: 该框架为动态生存预测提供了高效且细粒度的时间变化解释，有望提升模型在临床场景中的实用性。不过，解释与理论重要性的吻合程度仍受预测模型表现影响。

Abstract: Recent survival models integrating longitudinal data achieve strong predictive performance, but their predictions are often difficult to interpret, limiting their clinical use. We propose DynSurvX, a model-agnostic explainability framework for dynamic survival prediction with mixed static and longitudinal covariates. Based on Shapley values, DynSurvX introduces a hierarchical two-phase strategy that first identifies influential longitudinal features and then adaptively refines their temporal importance, enabling fine-grained explanations while reducing computational cost. The framework provides time-resolved explanations that evolve as new patient data become available. Experiments on simulated and two clinical datasets show varying agreement with theoretical importance across prediction models, with closer agreement for better-performing models, alongside clinically interpretable insights in real-world settings. It remains robust across prediction settings and reduces computation time by 41--80\% relative to the temporal explanation baseline, making dynamic explanations practical.

</details>


### [549] [CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21584)
*Steve Rhyner,Yubo Gao,Stefan de Lasa,Sankeerth Durvasula,Nandita Vijaykumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种使四位微缩浮点格式训练结果实现逐位一致的方法；它在不同运行、并行布局及显卡厂商间保持训练状态一致，但会增加训练步耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用四位微缩浮点格式训练时，即使输入相同，求和顺序、并行布局或显卡厂商不同，也可能产生不同结果。这给调试与训练审计带来困难，并可能导致训练引擎和推理引擎结果不一致，因此需要保证计算结果可复现。

Method: 核心观察是：四位微缩浮点乘积通常可由原生三十二位浮点累加精确求和，且结果不受求和顺序影响。该方法在量化时收集统计信息，用于判断原生矩阵乘法结果是否可获精确性认证；未通过认证的输出则重新精确计算，而认证成功率较低的运算直接采用精确计算内核。此外，它在不同并行布局间保持量化分块不变，并以不引入舍入误差的方式合并部分和；该策略也应用于注意力计算和权重梯度计算。

Result: 在两百步的八十亿参数模型实验中，该方法使训练状态在两种不同厂商的加速器之间逐位一致；在同一厂商设备上改变数据并行、张量并行和上下文并行配置时，也保持逐位一致。在三种八十亿至一百四十亿参数模型的实验中，相较于非精确的四位微缩浮点训练，在较大测试输入规模下，训练步耗时增加百分之十一点八至百分之六十点五；相较于脑浮点十六训练，最高获得一点二四倍加速，相较于确定性脑浮点十六训练，最高获得一点七零倍加速。

Conclusion: 该方法通过统计认证、必要时精确重算及无舍入合并，使低精度训练能够跨运行、并行配置和硬件厂商保持逐位一致。实验表明，这种可复现性具有实际可行性，但需付出一定的训练耗时代价；在所测较大输入规模下，其速度仍可优于两种脑浮点十六基线。

Abstract: Training with MXFP4, a 4-bit microscaling format, is non-deterministic: identical inputs can produce different results across parallelism layouts and GPU vendors. These differences complicate debugging and training audits and can cause training and inference engines to disagree. We present CertiSum to make MXFP4 training bitwise invariant across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors. Its key insight is that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is often already exact for every summation order. CertiSum collects statistics during quantization to certify native matrix multiplication results, recomputes uncertified outputs exactly, and uses exact kernels directly where certification rarely succeeds. CertiSum keeps quantization blocks unchanged across layouts and merges partial sums without rounding, including in attention and weight-gradient computation. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, CertiSum preserves training states bit for bit across AMD MI350X and NVIDIA GB200 and across changes in data, tensor, and context parallelism on MI350X. Across three 8B--14B models on FineWeb-Edu using MI350X, it adds 11.8--60.5% to training-step latency relative to its non-exact MXFP4 counterpart at the larger evaluated input shapes, with speedups of up to $1.24\times$ over BF16 and $1.70\times$ over deterministic BF16.

</details>


### [550] [Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21597)
*Awni Altabaa,John Lafferty,Omar Montasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于自助采样集成的学习方法，可在样本复杂度不随思维链长度增长的情况下学习逐词生成器，并可将集成模型蒸馏为单个生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用思维链示例学习自回归生成器时，示例长度可能使学习所需样本数增加。本文旨在消除这种对思维链长度的依赖，同时控制集成模型的规模，并支持将其压缩为单个生成器。

Method: 对训练数据进行自助采样，在各采样集上分别训练与思维链示例一致的生成器，再以多数投票组合这些生成器。对于二元词元集合，分析基于维数；对于有限词元集合，则采用图维数。还可利用无标签提示，将多数投票集成蒸馏到原假设类中的单个生成器。

Result: 二元词元集合下，样本复杂度为 O((d_VC + log(1/δ))/ε)，达到最优，且与思维链长度 T 无关。有限词元集合下，以图维数 d_G 替代 d_VC，样本复杂度除一个 log|Σ| 因子外达到最优。集成所需生成器数量为 O(log(T/δ))；蒸馏为单个生成器需要 n log(nT) 个无标签提示。

Conclusion: 自助采样与多数投票能够有效利用思维链示例学习生成器，在理论上避免样本复杂度随思维链长度增长。该方法还兼顾了有限规模的集成以及通过无标签提示进行模型蒸馏的可行性。

Abstract: We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\colonΣ^\star\toΣ$ from a class $\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on bootstrap samples of the training data. For binary token sets, it achieves the optimal sample complexity of $O((d_{\mathrm{VC}}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$, independent of the CoT length $T$, where $d_{\mathrm{VC}}$ is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{F}$. For finite token sets $Σ$, the VC dimension is replaced by a multiclass analogue, the Graph dimension $d_{\mathrm{G}}$, and the sample complexity is optimal up to a $\log|Σ|$ factor. The number of generators in the majority-vote ensemble is $O(\log(T/δ))$, and we show that the ensemble can be distilled into a single generator in $\mathcal{F}$ at the expense of $n\log(nT)$ unlabeled prompts.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [551] [Label-Free Detection of Structural Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Randomized Paraphrasing: The Case of Verbosity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18878)
*Carlos Peláez-González,David Herrera-Poyatos,Francisco Herrera,Andrés Herrera-Poyatos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需相关性标注的黑盒审计框架，用于检测大语言模型推荐系统是否受到商品描述等结构特征的影响；在九个模型中均发现描述越长，商品被选中的概率越高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型逐渐用于电商和对话式购物推荐，但模型可能不仅依据商品与用户查询的相关性作出选择，也会受到描述长度等表面特征影响。由于实际场景通常缺少相关性标签，传统审计方法难以区分模型是否存在这类结构偏差，因此需要一种不依赖人工标注的检测方案。

Method: 研究者将候选商品描述交由随机分配的释义模型改写，并随机排列候选项。若推荐模型的选择不受改写影响，则各释义模型应以相同概率对应被选中的商品；这一性质可用于构造无需相关性标签的统计检验。框架通过四步统计流程检验该性质，并在控制查询与商品相关性后，估计各描述特征对选择结果的影响。研究还提供了适用于实际部署审计的操作流程，以及成本和样本量建议。

Result: 研究在两万条商品查询和来自五个模型系列的九个推荐模型上检验描述冗长偏差。控制已测量的相关性信号后，九个模型均表现出描述长度的正向影响：描述长度每增加一个标准差，被选中的胜算最高增加百分之三十八。相关性仍是推荐的主要驱动因素，但描述冗长构成稳定的次要信号，其影响强度因模型系列而异。

Conclusion: 商品描述长度会系统性影响大语言模型推荐结果，即使相关性仍占主导地位。该框架仅需黑盒访问、无需相关性标注，因而适合用于定期审计已部署的购物助手，并帮助识别和量化结构偏差。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as recommenders in e-commerce and conversational shopping systems, where they select a product from a set of retrieved candidates described in natural language. Their decisions should depend on relevance to the user query, but may also be influenced by surface-level properties of the descriptions, such as their length. Detecting such structural biases is difficult because relevance labels are rarely available. We propose a label-free framework to audit LLM-based recommender systems for structural bias. Candidate descriptions are rewritten by randomly assigned paraphrasing models and presented in random order. We prove that, if the recommender's choice is invariant to these rewritings, every paraphraser is selected with equal probability, yielding a statistical test that requires no relevance labels. A four-step statistical pipeline tests this property and quantifies the contribution of each description feature while controlling for query-product relevance. We apply the framework to verbosity bias on 20{,}000 product queries and nine recommender LLMs from five model families. After controlling for the measured relevance signals, description length has a positive effect on selection in all nine models, increasing the odds of selection by up to 38% per standard deviation of length. Relevance remains the primary driver of recommendations, while verbosity acts as a consistent secondary signal whose strength depends on the model family. Since the framework needs only black-box access and no annotations, it can be run as a routine audit of deployed shopping assistants, and we provide an auditing protocol with cost and sample-size guidance.

</details>


### [552] [LMEG-Doc: Layout-Grounded Multi-View Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Long-Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18901)
*Changcheng Fu,Xiao Liu,Qi Yu,Yage Wang,Derek Young,Giri Iyengar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出面向多模态长文档检索的布局关联证据图框架，通过建模跨页面、跨模态证据关系，提升证据召回，并改善下游问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文档中的答案依据常分散在不同页面及文字、图表等模态中。传统方法主要依据各文档元素与问题的独立相似度排序，容易忽略互补证据之间的联系，导致关键图表即使包含必要信息，也可能排名较低。

Method: 构建能够表示文档元素结构关系与上下文关系的证据图；再通过视觉语言模型验证远距离页面间的潜在关联，以补充跨页连接。在此基础上，融合多模态检索信号与图引导的相关性传播，从版面和页面两个层级找回彼此关联的支持证据。

Result: 在三个多模态文档检索基准上，该方法均取得稳定的检索提升；即使未针对特定任务进行训练，表现也优于在其中一个基准上微调的检索器。将其检索证据接入现有问答流程后，两个基准上的答案准确率分别提升百分之七点六和百分之十五点八。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在多模态长文档检索中显式建模证据间关系，有助于找回分散且互补的关键信息，并能进一步提升问答效果。

Abstract: Retrieving relevant evidence from multimodal long documents remains challenging, as supporting information is often distributed across different pages and modalities. Existing retrieval methods primarily rank document elements by their individual similarity to a question, often overlooking relationships among complementary evidence. Consequently, relevant figures and tables may receive low retrieval scores even when they contain essential information. To address this limitation, we introduce LMEG-Doc, a layout-grounded multi-view evidence graph framework for multimodal long-document retrieval. We first construct an evidence graph that captures structural and contextual relationships among document elements, and introduce Cross-Page Relation Refinement (CRR) to discover additional connections across distant pages through VLM-based verification. Building on this graph, we combine multimodal retrieval signals with graph-guided relevance propagation to recover connected supporting evidence at both layout and page levels. Experiments on MMDocIR, DocScope, and FinRAGBench-V demonstrate consistent retrieval improvements, including outperforming retrievers fine-tuned on MMDocIR without task-specific training. Furthermore, augmenting existing question-answering pipelines with our retrieved evidence improves answer accuracy by 7.6% on DocScope and 15.8% on FinRAGBench-V, demonstrating the effectiveness of relationship-aware multimodal retrieval.

</details>


### [553] [TokenFormer V2: Breaking the Resolution-Complexity Dilemma in Unified Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19074)
*Kaihui Wu,Guoming Li,Liang Guo,Yifeng Zhou,Yuehong Hu,Junwei Pan,Zhixiang Feng,Chengguo Yin,Wenqi Fan,Haijie Gu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 第二代令牌变换器通过局部—全局分解，在保留完整行为细节的同时降低计算开销；其离线精度、工业评测表现和线上交易额均取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐面临分辨率与计算复杂度之间的矛盾：密集交互下，对长行为历史进行细致建模成本高；压缩历史则会减少预测可用的信息。研究旨在设计一种统一架构，在严格的在线服务预算内保留丰富的行为证据。

Method: 提出第二代令牌变换器，将表示分辨率与交互密度解耦。模型采用分组令牌布局，联合编码行为片段与非序列上下文，并通过分层合并扩大交互范围；再利用非序列融合和全局同步模块协调不同分组。其局部—全局分解策略将计算集中于结构化交互，同时由全分辨率读出模块直接访问每个已编码事件。

Result: 在二〇二六年腾讯广告算法竞赛基准上，该模型在统一推荐基线中取得领先精度，浮点运算量比领先基线减少五点一倍，并在长历史和行为域不均衡场景中保持优势。在微信视频号广告的十亿参数规模评测中，模型持续优于先进工业基线，整体曲线下面积最高提升零点零七个百分点。与线上生产模型对照的甲乙测试中，商品交易总额显著提升百分之二点三三。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，解耦表示分辨率与交互密度，并结合局部—全局计算，可兼顾细粒度行为建模与工业级效率。第二代令牌变换器在离线和线上评测中的表现，显示其具备规模化部署的应用潜力。

Abstract: Industrial recommendation faces a resolution--complexity dilemma: dense interactions make detailed modeling of long behavior histories expensive, while compact history summaries restrict the evidence available to prediction. A unified backbone must preserve rich behavioral details within strict serving budgets. We introduce \textbf{TokenFormer V2}, a unified architecture that explicitly decouples \emph{representation resolution} from \emph{interaction density}. Its group-wise token layout jointly encodes behavior segments with non-sequential context, expands interaction ranges via hierarchical group merging, and coordinates distributed groups through \emph{NS Fusion} and \emph{Global Sync} modules. Through this \emph{local--global decomposition} paradigm, computation is concentrated on structured interactions while preserving fine-grained evidence, ensuring that every encoded event remains directly accessible to the \emph{Full-Resolution Readout} module. On the Tencent Advertising Algorithm Competition 2026 (TAAC 2026) benchmark, TokenFormer V2 achieves top-ranking accuracy among unified recommendation baselines while using \textbf{5.1$\times$ fewer FLOPs} than leading baselines, sustaining its advantage across long histories and imbalanced behavior domains. Furthermore, in billion-parameter evaluations on WeChat Channels advertising, it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art industrial baselines, yielding up to a \textbf{+0.07 pp} overall AUC gain. In live online A/B testing against the production model, TokenFormer V2 delivers a statistically significant \textbf{2.33\% increase in GMV}. These results establish TokenFormer V2 as a battle-tested blueprint for scalable, full-resolution behavior modeling in industrial recommendation.

</details>


### [554] [Keep it Simple! A Multiple-Choice Task can Benefit Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19320)
*Wei-Hsiang Huang,Jyun-Yu Jiang,Pu-Jen Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文在生成式序列推荐中加入多选题辅助任务，使模型不仅预测用户可能选择的物品，也学习候选物品之间的相对排序；在四个公开数据集上，该方法使基准模型的前十项归一化折损累计增益提升百分之四点九至百分之七十九。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐通常直接生成目标物品的语义标识，较少显式学习负例组合及正负样本之间的相对排序。这与贝叶斯个性化排序强调比较正负样本的思想并不一致，可能限制模型的推荐效果。

Method: 在原有生成式推荐训练目标中加入多选题辅助任务。通过任务标识符和候选集构造，以较小改动合成该任务所需的训练数据，引导模型在生成目标物品的同时辨别候选项并学习相对偏好。论文还从信息论和组合泛化角度分析该任务的理论作用。

Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能够提升基准生成式推荐模型的表现，前十项归一化折损累计增益提升幅度为百分之四点九至百分之七十九。

Conclusion: 多选题辅助任务为生成式推荐补充了显式的候选比较与相对排序信号。该方法实现简单、适配成本低，并在实验中带来显著收益，说明改进训练目标本身可能是提升生成式推荐效果的有效途径。

Abstract: Sequential recommendation has recently witnessed growing interest in generative retrieval. One of the most popular approaches is to autoregressively generate the semantic identifiers (SIDs) of items as recommendations. Existing efforts mainly rely on semantic alignment, sophisticated architectural designs, and extensive hyperparameter tuning. However, the conventional learning framework for generative models could have foundational limitations. Specifically, most generative models directly predict target items without explicitly learning negative compositions and relative ranking signals. This is not well aligned with the philosophy of Bayesian personalized ranking (BPR), which emphasizes the importance of relative rankings between positive and negative samples.
  In this paper, we show that adding a simple multiple-choice auxiliary task into the learning objective can effectively address this issue. With minimal adaptation, we introduce Task Identifiers and Candidate Constructions to synthesize training data for the multiple-choice auxiliary task. In addition, we provide theoretical analysis of the fundamental benefits of the multiple-choice auxiliary task from the perspectives of information theory and compositional generalization. Extensive experiments on four publicly available benchmark datasets show that our approach can improve TIGER, a conventional generative recommendation model, by 4.9% to 79% in NDCG@10.

</details>


### [555] [User First Intelligence: Three Measurements of Search and AI-Answer Analytics (SEO and GEO/AEO), and a Knowledge-Graph Framework for Query Discovery Beyond Search Volume](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19655)
*Venkata Pagadala*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文检验了网站流量估算、用户需求代理指标和人工智能答案来源等工具的可靠性，发现它们在不同工具与平台间差异显著；提出一种衡量网站外部用户需求及内容缺口的框架，但尚未评估其评分效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户表达信息需求的场景远不止搜索框，但搜索引擎优化和生成式人工智能答案优化所依赖的分析工具，只能通过估算值观察部分需求。论文旨在测量这些工具与代理指标的准确性和适用边界，避免将单一平台的估算误当作真实需求。

Method: 论文开展三类测量：比较两家商业分析平台对电信网站流量的估算；将门店评论中的需求与关键词分类体系及搜索量进行对照，并比较各地区代码的维基百科访问量与供应商搜索量；检验某供应商对人工智能答案引用来源的预测，并分析不同答案平台的来源构成。在此基础上提出“用户优先情报”框架：收集网站之外的用户提问，将其关联至行业本体，并评估组织尚未回应的需求；同时发布开放实现。

Result: 两家平台对同一页面的月访问量估算相差约七点五至二十七点一倍，但在六十组六十六组页面比较中，对页面大小关系的判断一致。评论需求与搜索量对门店分支的相关性中等至较高，对主题的相关性很低；地区代码访问量与搜索量仅在排序上有一定一致性，控制关键词后这种一致性消失，数值大小也不吻合。四项预先提出的引用预测中，仅一项成立、一项方向正确、两项失败。视频和社区网站在谷歌人工智能概览及模式中的引用占比中位数为百分之二十一，明显高于其他四类平台；这一现象也出现在十三个国家的教育类答案中。新框架的评分尚未经过评估。

Conclusion: 需求估算和信息来源必须针对具体工具与答案平台分别测量，不能将某种指标视为普遍可靠的真实需求，也不能假定不同平台引用来源相同。论文提出了整合外部提问、行业知识体系与内容缺口的分析框架，但没有宣称因果关系，也未证明该框架评分的有效性。

Abstract: People say what they want to know in many places besides a search box, and the tools that search and AI-answer optimization (SEO and GEO/AEO) rely on see only part of that demand, through models reported as counts. This paper reports three measurements of such instruments and a framework. On the area-code section of a large US telecom provider's site, two commercial analytics platforms differed on estimated monthly visits by 7.5x to 27.1x (8.6x to 29.9x worldwide); across twelve sections of the domain the ratio ran from 0.20x to 7.24x with no detectable relation to section age, while they agreed on which section is larger in 60 of 66 pairs. On 37,193 reviews of 378 telecom stores linked to a 42,994-node keyword taxonomy, review demand and search volume agreed on branches to a varying degree (Spearman 0.47 to 0.75; 0.91 post hoc) and barely on topics (0.18), on links two blind AI annotators judged two-thirds correct; on the 372 area codes, a public count of Wikipedia requests for each code and vendor volume agreed roughly on ranking (0.45 over 240 articles, gone once keywords matched per code are held constant) and not on magnitudes, predictions fixed first. In one vendor's index of AI answers naming or citing the largest companies of each S&P 500 sector, of four predictions written first, one held, one in direction only and two failed; video and community sites took a median 21% of citation incidences on Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode against 0.6% to 9.2% on four other surfaces, in every sector, and in education answers in each of 13 countries read later. Estimates and sources need measuring per instrument and surface. User First Intelligence (UFI), built on that premise, collects what people ask beyond the website, links it to an industry ontology and scores where an organization does not answer; an open implementation is released, its score not evaluated. No causal claim is made.

</details>


### [556] [Reflection Is Not Always Worth It: Budgeted Reflection Allocation for Recommendation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19847)
*Jinfeng Xu,Zheyu Chen,Ziyue Peng,Jianheng Tang,Zheng Lin,Wenhao Yuan,Jian Chen,Shujie Li,Victor Leung*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该方法通过动态分配训练阶段的反思预算，减少不必要的大语言模型调用，同时维持全目录排序与推理阶段重排；部署时需防止资源节省损害弱势用户的个性化效果或商品曝光公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐智能体可能进行过多的大语言模型反思，造成不必要的计算开销。论文希望在不增加用户数据需求或额外模型接触的前提下，提升反思资源分配效率，同时关注效率优化可能带来的公平与隐私风险。

Method: 该方法仅调整训练阶段反思预算的分配方式，根据任务中的排序证据决定反思资源投入，不改变基础智能体协议。部署时建议按用户历史长度、商品流行度和相关群体审计效果；可采用保守分配策略，为随机覆盖或公平性保障预留少量预算，并通过数据最小化、身份匿名化及访问控制保护隐私。

Result: 材料未提供定量实验结果。其主要论述是：该方法旨在节省计算，同时保留全目录排序和推理重排能力；但若预算分配器校准不当，偏好稀疏、小众或代表性不足的用户可能获得较少反思，进而影响个性化质量，并可能间接改变商品曝光。

Conclusion: 该方法可作为兼顾成本与排序能力的资源分配层，但不能仅凭总体召回率或排序指标判断其部署效果。实际应用应开展分群审计，避免依赖敏感属性，并落实隐私保护与稳健的备用分配策略，确保计算节省不会以牺牲弱势用户或负责任的商品曝光为代价。

Abstract: This work aims to make recommendation agents more efficient by reducing unnecessary LLM reflection while preserving full-catalog ranking and inference reranking. Since BRAVE changes only how training-time reflection is allocated, it does not introduce new user data requirements or additional LLM exposure beyond the base agent protocol. The main potential risk is that a poorly calibrated allocator may assign less reflection to users whose preferences are sparse, niche, or under-represented, which could weaken personalization for those users or indirectly affect item exposure.
  This risk can be mitigated through deployment-time auditing and conservative allocation design. In practice, reflection budgets should be evaluated not only by aggregate Recall or NDCG, but also across user-history lengths, item popularity groups, and application-relevant cohorts when such analysis is permitted. The allocator should rely on task-side ranking evidence rather than sensitive attributes, and fallback policies can reserve a small portion of the budget for random or fairness-aware coverage when subgroup robustness is important. Privacy risks can be controlled with the same protections required by the base recommendation agent: minimizing user text sent to the LLM controller, anonymizing user identifiers, retaining only necessary interaction evidence, and applying standard access-control and logging policies. Overall, BRAVE is designed as a cost-aware allocation layer, and its ethical deployment depends on validating that the saved computation does not come at the expense of vulnerable users or responsible exposure.

</details>


### [557] [A Demonstration System for Faithful Temporal Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19926)
*Zhen Jia,Xinghong Hou,Chenyang Jin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向异构数据源的时间问答方法，通过递归回答机制显式化时间约束，并提供可追踪的证据与过程可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间问答需要处理问题中的时间约束或时间信息，但时间条件往往隐含在问题中，且答案可能来自不同类型的数据源。为提升答案的可解释性与可信度，系统需要展示答案依据及其推导过程。

Method: 提出名为“费思”的时间问答方法，支持在异构数据源上回答问题。其核心是递归回答机制，将隐含的时间约束转换为显式条件；同时通过可视化展示答案的计算过程及支持证据的来源，使推理过程可追踪。

Result: 摘要说明该方法及其演示系统已经实现，并公开提供了代码和演示视频；但未报告定量实验结果或与其他方法的对比数据。

Conclusion: 该工作强调在异构数据源上进行时间问答时，将隐含时间条件显式化，并以可追踪证据和过程可视化增强答案的可解释性。

Abstract: Temporal question answering (TQA) aims to answer questions that involve temporal constraints or require temporal information. We propose Faith, a novel TQA approach that operates over heterogeneous sources and ensures explainable answers by presenting traceable and faithful evidence. In Faith, we design a new recursive answering mechanism transforming implicit temporal constraints into explicit conditions. Additionally, we visualize the system functionality to track how the answers are computed and the supporting evidence is derived. The code and video of the demonstration system are publicly available.

</details>


### [558] [DetouR: Plugging Association Routes into Search Agents for Multi-hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19967)
*Tingwei Chen,Yunxiao Shi,Zhendong Chu,Zhiying Deng,Min Xu,Qingsong Wen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需额外搜索或调用大语言模型的插件，通过利用检索页面之间的超链接寻找关联证据，并在筛选上下文时保留完整证据链，从而提升多跳问答表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索智能体主要沿语义路线检索：根据已知问题推断缺失信息，再将其表述为查询。这种方式难以发现问题本身未提及、却可能通过已检索页面中的超链接一步抵达的关键证据。与此同时，构建链接图成本较高，而常见的相关性筛选和证据融合又可能丢弃链接所连接的证据。

Method: 提出一种可插拔方法，直接复用检索页面自带的链接，不进行离线图构建，也不增加搜索或大语言模型调用。其一，链接重路由利用轻量级学习评分器，将近似重复的查询改为指向相关链接页面的检索路线；其二，链感知上下文选择在链接结构上运行个性化网页排序，使相互关联的证据链能够完整进入阅读器的有限上下文。

Result: 在四种搜索智能体上，该方法平均使二跳维基问答的精确匹配率提升四个百分点，使热点问答提升一点四个百分点；在回放测试和实时运行中均有改善，且不增加搜索或大语言模型成本。研究还发现，更大型的大语言模型处理这类非语义关联证据时并未带来明显优势，有时甚至不如简单的选择器。

Conclusion: 关联路线是语义检索的低成本补充，能够帮助搜索智能体发现仅靠问题措辞难以触达的关键页面。复用检索页面中的链接，并在检索和上下文筛选阶段保留证据链，是提升多跳问答效果的有效插件式方案。

Abstract: Search agents answer multi-hop questions by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, deciding at each step what to search next. Existing agents follow semantic routes: they infer what is missing and phrase it as a query, reaching only what the model can name. Yet the decisive page is often one the question never names, frequently just one hyperlink away from evidence already retrieved. Following such association routes reaches more gold pages than semantic search under the same budget. Exploiting them raises two challenges: obtaining the association structure without costly offline graph construction, and keeping linked evidence in the reader's limited context, where relevance- and fusion-based selection discards it. We propose DetouR, a plug-in that reuses the links arriving with retrieved pages and adds no search or LLM call. Link Rerouting replaces near-repeat queries with routes to linked pages, chosen by a lightweight learned scorer; Chain-aware Context Selection runs personalized PageRank over these links so that evidence chains reach the reader intact. Across four agents, DetouR improves EM by 4.0 points on 2Wiki and 1.4 on HotpotQA on average. We also find that heavier LLM models struggle with this non-semantic evidence, adding little over these simple selectors or even falling behind. In summary, our work reveals association routes as a cheap complement to semantic routes that current search agents overlook: added as a plug-in, they improve every agent we test, in replay and in live runs, at no extra search or LLM cost.

</details>


### [559] [Take a Step Back: A Dual-Granularity Raw Feature Empowered Intermediate Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19974)
*Jinfeng Xu,Zheyu Chen,Shuo Yang,Jinze Li,Wenhao Yuan,Ziyue Peng,Puzhen Wu,Shujie Li,Jian Chen,Zheng Lin,Edith C. H. Ngai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出双粒度原始特征赋能的中间融合图卷积网络，利用大型语言模型构造多粒度原始特征，并通过动态跨模态权重校正实现融合；在四个真实数据集及稀疏、冷启动场景中均表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐面临两项关键问题：推荐数据稀疏，使多粒度表示难以充分训练；仅以对比学习对齐不同模态，可能过度压缩有价值的模态特有信息。因此，论文尝试从原始特征建模和融合机制两方面改进。

Method: 提出双粒度原始特征赋能的中间融合图卷积网络。该方法借助大型语言模型的多模态理解能力，直接构建双粒度原始特征；再通过中间融合图卷积网络捕捉跨模态信号，并利用动态跨模态权重校正促进有效融合。

Result: 在四个真实世界数据集上的综合实验表明，该方法持续优于多种强基线。进一步分析显示，其在不同数据稀疏程度和冷启动场景下具有优势；加入基于对比学习的对齐任务后仍可进一步获益。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，借助大型语言模型构造双粒度原始特征，并采用保留模态特性、强化跨模态交互的中间融合机制，有望提升多模态推荐效果，尤其适用于稀疏和冷启动条件。

Abstract: Although multimodal recommendations have shown the ability to learn user preferences and item properties by leveraging explicit multimodal information, they remain constrained by two critical limitations: low-quality representation learning and modality fusion. For the former, existing solutions primarily focus on multi-granularity representation learning; however, we argue that training such representations is difficult due to the inherent data sparsity problem in recommendation scenarios. For the latter, existing solutions often rely on contrastive learning to align representations of different modalities to facilitate modality fusion, yet alignment-only objectives may over-compress valuable modality-specific information. To this end, we suggest \underline{``Take a Step Back"} and propose a \textbf{D}ual-granularity raw feature empowered \textbf{I}ntermediate fusion \textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}onvolutional \textbf{N}etwork (\textbf{DIGCN}) for multimodal recommendation. DIGCN leverages the multimodal understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to construct dual-granularity raw features directly. Furthermore, DIGCN introduces an intermediate fusion graph convolutional network equipped with dynamic cross-modality weight correction, designed to capture cross-modality signals and achieve effective modality fusion. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world datasets validate that DIGCN consistently outperforms a variety of strong baselines. Additional analyses confirm its superiority under varying levels of data sparsity and cold-start scenarios. Notably, DIGCN demonstrates high extensibility, capable of further benefiting from additional contrastive learning-based alignment tasks.

</details>


### [560] [EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20034)
*Shihao Yang,Can Zeng,Xinzhe Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文发现，强化学习搜索智能体会把大量重复转述的错误说法误当成多个独立证据，导致正确答案被推翻、弃答能力下降。作者提出“回声规范”训练方法，使智能体更可靠地越过重复信息寻找关键原始证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实语料中，同一说法可能被许多网页复制或改写，而能解决问题的原始证据可能只出现一次。现有强化学习搜索智能体容易把这些重复内容当作相互独立的佐证，并因过早停止搜索而错过关键证据；若训练还过度奖励给出精确答案，智能体在证据被删除时也更难选择弃答。

Method: 作者先在五种答案已知的语料变换下评估搜索可靠性，再提出分两阶段训练的“回声规范”。第一阶段通过验证式热启动，训练模型识别多跳推理所需的桥接实体，并越过重复回声寻找原始证据；第二阶段采用组强化学习，使用受证据门控的奖励，并加入与最终答案结果无关的证据获取奖励。优势缩放方式则保留了理论上的最优决策规则，使模型在证据不足时仍能合理弃答。

Result: 在五种规模为三十亿至三百二十亿参数的基础模型及七个已发布强化学习智能体上，八条改写后的错误说法会使原本正确的答案有百分之五十八至七十三被推翻；删除关键证据后，精确匹配奖励训练的智能体弃答率低于百分之十五。分析表明，问题主要发生在证据获取阶段：回声占据检索结果前列并使搜索提前停止；关键证据一旦进入上下文，智能体便能像面对一条回声时一样可靠地驳回八条回声。单纯扩大检索预算、强制增加搜索轮次或被动过滤检索结果均不足以解决问题。新方法在通义千问二点五七十亿参数模型上将对八条回声的顺从率降低三十至四十四个百分点，降至百分之二十九至三十一；八条回声条件下找到关键证据的比例接近四倍，达到百分之二十六至二十七，并能迁移到未见过的向量检索和词项检索系统。其单独问答准确率达到百分之四十七至五十五。

Conclusion: 搜索智能体抵御重复错误信息的关键，不是单纯增加检索量，而是改善证据获取：识别回声、恢复多跳检索路径，并持续寻找稀有的原始证据。回声规范通过分阶段训练提升了这种能力，同时兼顾证据不足时的弃答表现，并展现出对新检索器的迁移能力。

Abstract: Search agents trained with reinforcement learning decide what to retrieve, when to search again, and when to answer. In real corpora, one claim is copied and paraphrased across many pages while the primary source settling a question appears once. We show that reinforcement-learned search agents grant echoes the credence of independent sources and lose their ability to abstain. Across five base models from 3B to 32B and seven released RL agents on multi-hop Wikipedia questions with primary evidence intact, eight paraphrased false-claim echoes overturn 58-73% of previously correct answers, while exact-match RL drives deleted-evidence abstention below 15%. Conditioning on retrieval localizes the failure to evidence acquisition: once primary evidence enters context, agents overrule eight echoes as reliably as one, whereas echoes fill top ranks and halt search early, so larger budgets, forced search turns, or passive passage filtering alone fail to recover displaced evidence. We introduce EchoSpec, specifying reliability across five corpus transformations with known target answers and training in two stages. Verification warm-start teaches multi-hop bridge-entity recovery past echoes, after which group RL optimizes an evidence-gated $λ$-reward with an outcome-independent acquisition bonus and scale-preserving advantages retaining the optimal rule $λ/(1+λ)$. Across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B backbones on nine evaluation suites, EchoSpec cuts eight-echo deference by 30-44 points on Qwen2.5-7B down to 29-31%, nearly quadruples eight-echo reach to 26-27% with zero-shot transfer to unseen BGE and BM25 retrievers, and raises standalone QA precision to 47-55%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/unihsy/EchoSpec.

</details>


### [561] [How did data sharing evolve in the decade since the FAIR Principles?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20319)
*Sheeba Samuel,Daniel Mietchen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 对2011至2025年逾680万篇生物医学论文的分析显示，数据可用性声明显著增加，但声明数据可用不等于数据已以机器可读、可复用的形式共享；不同学科、期刊类型、合作方式及作者性别之间仍存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平、可访问、可互操作、可重用的数据原则提出十年后，研究者希望了解数据共享实践、态度与基础设施如何变化，并检验论文中的数据可用性声明是否反映了实际、可复用的数据共享。

Method: 研究分析了2011至2025年间开放获取生物医学论文中的数据可用性声明、仓储链接、数据登录号及补充材料，利用自动化流程对其提取和分类，并为每篇论文计算数据共享评分；此外，对部分论文引用的数据集网址独立评估其是否符合公平数据原则。分析还比较了学科、期刊开放模式、国际合作、作者性别等维度，并考察资助方和期刊要求、标记规范、计算可复现性线索及数据声明与伦理声明的共现情况。

Result: 明确的数据可用性声明比例从2011年的约2%升至2025年的68%；与此同时，“可按要求提供”声明也从接近零增至逾19%。由于论文总量增长，明确提及仓储库的数据声明论文数量从132篇增至94,697篇，而“可按要求提供”的论文从77篇增至173,474篇。结构生物学和基因组学的数据共享评分持续较高，临床研究与公共卫生较低；钻石开放获取期刊优于其他期刊类型，国际合作论文评分高于国内合作论文。女性第一作者论文的评分下降幅度大于男性第一作者论文。

Conclusion: 十年来，数据可用性声明已广泛普及，但从声明到真正共享机器可读、可复用数据之间仍有明显落差。该落差跨越学科、基础设施与人口群体，说明仅增加声明或满足形式要求不足以实现高质量数据共享，仍需改进数据仓储、标准化、政策落实与可复用性保障。

Abstract: A decade after the publication of the FAIR Guiding Principles, what have we learned about data sharing, and what do data availability statements (DAS) and other materials accrued over that period tell us about how data-sharing practices, attitudes, and infrastructures evolved? Here, we present a large-scale longitudinal analysis of over 6.8 million biomedical articles from the PMC Open Access Subset, spanning 2011 to 2025. Using an automated pipeline, we extracted and classified DAS, repository links, accession numbers, and supplementary materials, assigning each article a data-sharing score and independently FAIR-assessing a subset of cited dataset URLs. We find that explicit DAS adoption rose from ~2% in 2011 to 68% in 2025, while "available on request" statements grew in parallel from near zero to over 19%. The corpus growth amplifies both patterns: articles with a DAS containing an explicit repository mention rose from 132 in 2011 to 94,697 in 2025, while "available on request" articles rose from 77 to 173,474 over this span. Structural biology and genomics consistently achieved the highest data-sharing scores, while clinical research and public health ranked lowest. Gold Open Access journals showed a small advantage over subscription journals, while Diamond Open Access journals outperformed both. Internationally collaborative articles scored higher than domestic ones. A gender gap emerged: female first-authored articles' scores declined more than male first-authored ones. The analysis further covered additional dimensions, from compliance with funder/journal mandates and JATS XML tagging standards to computational reproducibility signals and the co-occurrence of DAS with ethics statements. A decade on, the gap between declaring data availability and actually sharing machine-readable, reusable data persists across fields, infrastructures and demographics.

</details>


### [562] [Straight to the Product: What Online Retailers Miss When Shoppers Ask AI First](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20378)
*Michael Iannelli,Alan Ai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究将用户的购物助手对话与其后续零售网站浏览记录相匹配，发现用户常会访问助手推荐的商品，但访问通常不会通过助手提供的链接完成；论文据此提出“产品后续到访率”作为评估购物助手的行为指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭对话内容或链接点击，难以判断购物助手的建议是否真正影响了用户的购买探索。研究希望直接衡量用户在获得推荐后是否到访被推荐商品，并提出一种不依赖引荐数据或平台内部日志的评估方式。

Method: 研究将同一用户的助手对话与其在二十家大型线上零售商的后续浏览记录关联，考察用户是否访问对话中被点名的商品，并与匹配的他人回答及用户此前的浏览情况进行比较；同时在另一段为期五个月的数据中检验结果是否复现，并分析到访来源与搜索行为。

Result: 在前一周未访问该零售商的购物者中，得到推荐后一天内访问被点名商品的频率，从每百次回答中的零点零二次升至二点零七次，增加约二个百分点。发生商品页访问的日期中，百分之四十四展示了用户自己回答中提到的商品，而匹配的他人回答对应比例为百分之一点五；结果在另一段五个月期间复现。百分之八十九的访问没有助手链接痕迹，百分之五十四经由网页搜索进入，与用户平常的访问比例相同。若搜索紧接首次访问之前，搜索词有百分之二十八指向回答中的商品；在更早的数周中这一比例仅为百分之一，显示用户可能把搜索框当作直接输入商品名称的入口。

Conclusion: 助手推荐与用户随后访问被推荐商品之间存在明显关联，但用户通常通过零售商网站内外的常规路径到达，而非点击助手链接。论文提出“产品后续到访率”，即回答后用户访问所推荐商品的比例，可作为购物助手及智能代理的行为评估指标，并能在缺少引荐数据和服务提供方日志时按助手分别计算。

Abstract: When people ask an AI assistant what to buy, what happens next at the store? We link the same people's assistant conversations to their later browsing at twenty large online retailers. People go to the product the assistant named: among shoppers who had not visited the store in the past week, visits to the named product within a day rise from 0.02 to 2.07 per 100 answers (+2.0 points [1.7, 2.4]), and on days with a product-page visit at the store, 44% show a product from their own answer, against 1.5% for a matched answer given to someone else. The result replicates in a separate five-month period. Few arrive through the assistant's link: 89% of visits carry no sign of it, and 54% follow a web search, the same share as their usual visits. When a search comes just before the first visit, it names the answer's product 28% of the time (1% in earlier weeks), as if the search box were an address bar. The chat names the product; the store logs a search. Once there, shoppers keep browsing.
  We propose product follow-through, the share of answers followed by a visit to the product they named, as a way to evaluate shopping assistants and agents by what people do next: it needs no referral data or provider logs and can be computed for each assistant.

</details>


### [563] [What Unlinked Aggregates Still Prove: Ranker Comparisons from Exact and Differentially Private Item Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20388)
*Chang Xu,Hao Wang,Gedi Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究表明，即使评估者无法将用户购买与其收到的推荐逐一对应，商品级购买总数仍能缩小推荐系统性能差异的可能范围；但在实际数据中，这些汇总信息较少足以判定个性化推荐系统的优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私保护可能切断用户购买记录与推荐结果之间的关联，但商家仍可发布评估用户群中每件商品的购买总数。论文探讨这些总数在多大程度上能够帮助判断哪种推荐系统表现更好，以及这种判断会带来多少隐私风险。

Method: 作者将未知的用户—商品购买对应关系视为所有符合商品购买总数的可能分配，并在这些分配范围内计算推荐系统性能差异的上下界。通过缩减后的运输网络处理完整商品目录，并保证界限端点确实可达到。对于差分隐私发布的购买总数，作者构造了一个可同时适用于同次发布中所有比较的置信保证。

Result: 在约两万和十万用户的两个电商群体中，精确购买总数都比忽略总数的界限更能缩小性能差异范围；多数判定涉及偏好热门商品的推荐系统。对于评估前十位排序中已购买商品排名的指标，小规模群体中精确总数在一百六十八种设置里判定了十四种，大规模群体在八十一种设置里没有判定任何一种。小规模群体按用户组细分的精确总数，在百分之九十用户仍可关联时判定了两组个性化推荐系统，但会增加个人购买信息的暴露。整群发布每件商品一个差分隐私计数虽保留了大部分界限收窄效果，却未能判定任何个性化推荐系统；将较不热门商品合并成类别后，隐私计数在小规模群体中判定了一组个性化推荐系统。

Conclusion: 商品级购买总数能够在不恢复具体购买关联的前提下改善推荐系统比较，但其判别力受群体规模、缺失关联方式、计数发布粒度及隐私保护强度影响。总体而言，汇总计数更适合评估偏好热门商品的系统；若要比较个性化系统，往往需要更细粒度的信息，并须权衡评估效用与个人隐私。

Abstract: Privacy controls can prevent an evaluator from linking purchases to the recommendations users received, while a merchant can still release complete item-level purchase counts for the evaluation cohort. We ask when these counts identify which recommender performs better. The counts constrain who could have bought each item. We bound the performance difference over all assignments consistent with the counts. A reduced transportation network handles full catalogs and can certify attainable endpoints. If the interval excludes zero, it identifies the better recommender for that cohort. With differentially private counts, one confidence guarantee applies jointly to all comparisons from the same release. In two e-commerce cohorts of about 20,000 and 100,000 users, exact counts narrowed every interval compared with bounds that ignored the counts. Most decisions involved a recommender that favors popular items. For NDCG@10, which rewards ranking purchased items higher, each setting combined one of three personalized pairs with a pattern and rate of missing links. Exact counts settled 14 of 168 settings in the smaller cohort and none of 81 in the larger cohort. In the smaller cohort, exact counts broken down by user group settled two personalized pairs when 90% of users remained linked, at the cost of revealing more about individual purchases. Whole-cohort private releases with one count per item retained much of the narrowing but settled no personalized pair in either cohort. Grouping less popular items into bins let private counts settle one personalized pair in the smaller cohort.

</details>


### [564] [Overview of the Plagiarism Detection Task at PAN 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20443)
*André Greiner-Petter,Yun-Ang Wu,Yuka Kitamura,Kon Woo Kim,Maik Fröbe,Bela Gipp,Akiko Aizawa,Martin Potthast*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍二〇二六年生成式抄袭检测评测：研究者构建两套合成抄袭数据集，并比较参赛系统与三种基线；六支团队提交的系统整体显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动生成的文本可能隐蔽地复用科学文献内容，使原始来源难以追溯。为推动相关检测能力发展，评测模拟恶意行为者以尽可能少的工作生成论文、同时躲避未披露复用检测的情形，并要求系统找回被抄袭文本的原始科学来源。

Method: 研究者使用四种普及的大型语言模型生成合成抄袭文本，并据此创建两套新数据集。论文概述数据集的构建方式，汇总并比较参赛队伍的结果与三种基线方法。

Result: 评测共收到六支团队提交的二十六份结果。参赛系统整体显著优于三种基线，表明现有方法能够有效应对该任务中的合成抄袭来源检索问题。

Conclusion: 本文为生成式抄袭检测提供了新的评测数据与系统比较结果。参赛系统优于基线，显示该领域具有进展；与此同时，数据集所模拟的低成本、隐蔽式文本复用也凸显了持续提升来源追溯能力的必要性。

Abstract: The generative plagiarism detection task at PAN 2026 aims at retrieving the original scientific sources for given automatically generated textual plagiarism. We created two novel datasets of synthetically generated plagiarism following the premise of a malicious actor trying to generate papers with minimal effort while evading detection of undisclosed re-use. We utilized four widely available LLMs: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 3.5 27B FP8, and DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B. In this task overview paper, we outline the creation of this dataset and summarize and compare the results of all participants with three baselines. For this year's task, we received 26 submissions from six teams that significantly outperformed our baselines.

</details>


### [565] [IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20448)
*Dongjia Zhao,Yuchen Ma,Chunsheng Shi,Ziqiu Gui,Chao Yuan,Jianing Zhu,Zhaoxing Zhang,Yahui Liu,Daoxin Zhang,Yi Wu,Yao Hu,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 意图流通过显式建模用户检索意图，统一多模态候选召回与重排标准，在小红书十亿级索引上实现实时搜索，并显著提升搜索互动表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图文查询中的相关性取决于用户的检索意图，不能仅凭视觉或主题相似度判断。仅对视觉搜索结果重排也无法找回初始候选集中缺失的相关笔记，因此需要在召回和重排阶段采用一致的意图相关性标准。

Method: 系统构建层级化意图分类体系，并针对不同意图制定相关性标准，用于指导数据构建、表征学习和重排。离线智能体数据流程负责获取候选并核验其相关性，生成训练监督信号。嵌入模型结合意图感知对比学习、分级排序和分布蒸馏；轻量重排器则依据预测的层级意图评估查询与候选内容之间的证据。

Result: 在小红书用户级线上对照实验中，相较于现有的视觉搜索后重排系统，前四位查询点击率相对提升百分之二十八点一七，查询点击率提升百分之十八点九六，用户在搜索结果页的平均停留时长提升百分之十二点五六。生产监控显示端到端中位延迟为一点零七秒。

Conclusion: 显式意图建模能够改善多模态搜索中候选召回与相关性判断的一致性，并在工业级规模下兼顾效果与实时性。线上实验表明，该方案可带来显著的搜索参与度提升。

Abstract: Multimodal search with image-text queries helps users find notes in user-generated content (UGC) communities and serves as a key search tool for multimodal search agents. For such queries, query-note relevance depends on the user's retrieval intent and cannot be determined by visual or topical similarity alone. Simply reranking visual search results cannot fully address this challenge, as notes relevant to the user's intent may be missing from the initial candidate set. This motivates explicit intent modeling to align candidate retrieval and reranking under consistent relevance criteria. We present IntentFlow, an intent-driven real-time multimodal search system deployed at Xiaohongshu over an index on the order of ten billion entries. IntentFlow represents retrieval objectives with a hierarchical intent taxonomy and uses intent-specific relevance criteria to guide data construction, representation learning, and reranking. An offline agentic data workflow acquires candidates and verifies their relevance under these criteria to produce training supervision. The embedding model combines intent-aware contrastive learning, graded ranking, and distribution distillation, while a compact reranker assesses query-candidate evidence conditioned on predicted hierarchical intents. Evaluations demonstrate that IntentFlow delivers substantial gains in search engagement while supporting real-time search at industrial scale. In a user-level A/B test on the Xiaohongshu platform, IntentFlow outperforms the existing production system based on visual search followed by reranking, achieving relative gains of 28.17% in Top-4 query click-through rate, 18.96% in query click-through rate, and 12.56% in average time spent on search results pages per user. Production monitoring records an end-to-end P50 latency of 1.07 s.

</details>


### [566] [MAGE: Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence for Transferable Multimodal Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20449)
*Haiyang Jiang,Tong Chen,Xinyi Gao,Hao Wang,Hongzhi Yin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可迁移的多模态图学习框架，通过自适应融合异构邻居信息并为每个预测目标筛选相关证据，使模型无需在目标图上更新参数，也能完成跨域节点分类与链接预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图同时包含文本、视觉属性和关系结构，具有丰富的信息，但在不同图域及不同目标节点之间，邻居的跨模态关联方式和预测所需信息可能不同。因此，源图上训练的模型难以直接泛化到未见目标图。核心问题是如何自适应融合异构邻居中的跨模态信息，以及如何为每个目标节点挑选有用的邻居证据，以支持大语言模型进行预测。

Method: 框架将节点的文本视图和视觉视图分别表示为异构图中的不同类型节点，并由两个互补模块构成：一是元路径自适应多模态传播模块，沿异构元路径自适应聚合邻域信息，并将其压缩为包含图结构信息的软提示词元；二是证据引导指令微调模块，为每个查询选择相关的邻居证据，并将其图感知表示融入指令，供冻结的多模态大语言模型使用。该方法利用多个源图进行迁移，且无需在目标域更新参数。

Result: 实验使用三个源图和四个未见目标图，在节点分类和链接预测任务上验证了方法。摘要报告称，该框架取得了较强的跨域迁移表现，且不需要在目标域进行参数更新；摘要未提供具体数值或基线对比细节。

Conclusion: 该研究通过结合元路径驱动的自适应邻域融合与面向目标节点的证据筛选，缓解了多模态图跨域迁移中的信息差异问题。实验结果表明，这种方式有助于将源图上学到的知识迁移至未见图域，并支持无需目标域微调的预测。

Abstract: Multimodal graphs integrate textual and visual attributes with relational structures, providing a rich representation of complex real-world data. To enable the broad applicability and reuse of graph models, it is crucial for models trained on source graphs to generalize to unseen graph domains. However, this is challenging because cross-modal interactions among neighbors and the neighboring information needed for prediction can vary across target nodes and graph domains. This gives rise to two key challenges: adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion, which captures and integrates cross-modal interactions among neighbors to accommodate variations across nodes and domains; and target-specific evidence selection, which identifies the neighboring textual and visual information needed for each target node to support LLM-based prediction. In light of these challenges, we propose MAGE (Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence Prompting), a framework for transferable multimodal graph learning. MAGE represents textual and visual node views separately in a heterogeneous graph and introduces two complementary components. Meta-path Adaptive Multimodal Propagation (MAMP) adaptively aggregates neighborhood information along heterogeneous meta-paths and compresses it into graph-aware soft tokens. Evidence-Guided Instruction Tuning (EGIT) selects relevant neighboring evidence for each query and incorporates its graph-aware representations into instructions for a frozen multimodal LLM. Together, these components support transfer from multiple source graphs to unseen target graphs without target-domain parameter updates. Experiments with three source graphs and four unseen target graphs demonstrate strong cross-domain transfer performance on node classification and link prediction, without requiring parameter updates on the target domains.

</details>


### [567] [When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20702)
*Nannan Zhao,Jiameng Zhang,Taoyu Zhong,Hao Wang,Bo Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 升级向量索引的嵌入模型最终仍需重编码全部文档；复用旧索引只能改变计算成本的支付时机及过渡期检索质量。研究提出迁移前的策略选择与窗口深度估算规则，并指出质量差距须在实际服务索引上测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更换嵌入模型通常要求重新编码整个语料，成本高且迁移期间可能影响检索质量。已有适配器和窗口重排序方法声称可复用旧索引，但其实际收益、适用条件及计算成本缺乏系统评估，难以在迁移前做出可靠选择。

Method: 研究在段落、代码语料及自然问题数据集上比较多组新旧模型组合，并评估五种适配器方案与窗口重排序。研究通过预注册的重放实验检验仅依据旧索引估算重排序成本和窗口深度的规则，同时进一步考察不同查询负载偏斜程度下的策略选择；质量相关输入则在实际服务索引上测量。

Result: 所有迁移策略最终都必须编码每篇文档，复用并不能免除重编码。五种适配器中，只有同一模型家族的大语言模型桥接方案略微超过旧模型，优势可忽略。窗口重排序成本仅根据旧索引即可准确估算，三组测试均验证了预测；窗口深度估算与达到目标质量的窗口成本偏差不超过语料的十万分之四。负载偏斜实验中，预测策略家族在三十六组预注册重放里有三十二组与结果一致；自然问题数据集的十一组模型配对中，预先制定的方案有十组选对策略家族，且所有窗口成本均估算准确。不过，质量输入在不同语料规模间的迁移可靠性较弱。

Conclusion: 研究给出了三项迁移前决策依据：判断复用是否值得、选择迁移策略，以及确定重排序窗口深度。成本与策略可在迁移前较可靠地规划，但检索质量差距和窗口质量损失不宜直接跨语料规模外推，应在实际服务索引上测量。

Abstract: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.

</details>


### [568] [CARE: Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding with Listwise Reconstruction for Retrieval-Oriented Semantic IDs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20721)
*Yuan Xu,Dawei Chen,Xiaoguang Lin,Xin Chen,Yulong Ou,Haijun Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出面向检索的语义标识符分词器，通过检索对齐和列表级蒸馏提升量化后相关文档的可召回性；工业视频搜索实验中，两种方法均优于残差聚类基线，列表级方法更进一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索通过生成文档的语义标识符来替代近邻搜索，因此标识符分词器会限制检索器能够召回的文档。常见量化方法只优化文档向量本身，未直接考虑量化后查询是否仍能找到相关文档；论文旨在让语义标识符更符合实际检索需求。

Method: 提出两种仅依赖文档进行编码的分词器。第一种先用查询—文档对比损失训练零初始化的残差对齐网络，将表示空间调整为有利于检索；再通过锚定损失和固定为原始向量的重建目标防止表示漂移与坍塌，并采用参考向量评分进行残差量化。第二种在此基础上，针对每个训练查询，将原始向量在候选列表上产生的相似度分布蒸馏到语义标识符重建向量中，并使用保持函数的分层预测头实现列表级重建。

Result: 在工业视频搜索数据上，论文不训练生成器，而以行预算召回率评估语义标识符：分别考察分桶划分视角和标识符重建视角。两种方法在重建视角下均优于残差聚类基线；加入列表级蒸馏的方法进一步提升，主要收益来自该蒸馏过程。对两种文档向量的比较还显示：当向量未在搜索数据上训练时，对比对齐的帮助更明显；向量选择对召回率的影响远大于量化器选择。

Conclusion: 语义标识符的设计应优化量化后的检索能力，而不应只关注文档向量重建或聚类指标。检索对齐与列表级蒸馏能够提升标识符的召回表现，且底层文档表示质量是关键因素。第一种方法已部署于工业视频搜索系统的生成式检索阶段。

Abstract: Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with the generation of a document's semantic ID (SID), so the SID tokenizer bounds what the retriever can recall. Common SID constructions (residual k-means, RQ-VAE, finite scalar quantization, capacity balancing) optimize criteria defined on document embeddings alone and do not control whether a query can still find its relevant documents after quantization. We propose two retrieval-oriented SID tokenizers. CARE-SID (Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding for Semantic IDs) quantizes in a retrieval-aligned space: a zero-initialized residual alignment network is trained with a query-document contrastive loss before quantization, an anchor loss and a reconstruction target fixed to the original embedding prevent drift and collapse, and reference-vector rating residual quantization assigns the codes. CARE-LR (CARE with Listwise Reconstruction) then distills, for each training query, the similarity distribution that the original embeddings induce over a candidate list into the SID reconstructions, through a function-preserving layer-resolved head. Both keep a document-only encoding interface. We judge SIDs without training a generator, by row-budget recall in a bucketing view (the partition) and a reconstruction view (the SID with its reconstruction). In offline evaluation on industrial video search data, both tokenizers achieve higher reconstruction-view recall than residual k-means, and CARE-LR improves further on CARE-SID, mainly through the listwise distillation. A comparison of two document embeddings shows that contrastive alignment helps most when the embedding has not been trained on search data, and that the embedding affects SID recall far more than the quantizer. CARE-SID is deployed in the generative retrieval stage of an industrial video search system.

</details>


### [569] [UniGraph: A Unified Graph-based Index for Dynamic Hybrid Dense-Sparse Vector Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20758)
*Keyu Chen,Xiaoyao Zhong,Jiabao Jin,Peng Cheng,Wangze Ni,Jingkuan Song,Heng Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出统一混合图索引及自适应搜索方法，在支持查询级权重变化的同时提升混合向量检索效率与召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合向量检索通常分别搜索稠密向量索引和稀疏向量索引，再合并候选并重排。这种方式需要两次检索，也可能提前丢弃那些只有在语义与词法信号加权结合后才排名靠前的结果。直接按混合距离构建图索引可以缓解候选丢失，但不同混合权重会改变邻居关系，固定权重构建的静态图难以适应查询级权重变化。

Method: 提出统一混合图，将多个混合权重下计算的邻居集合合并为一个度数受限的图索引，使其无需重建即可支持不同查询权重。另设计自适应权重引导搜索，根据查询权重选择稀疏或稠密向量作为搜索入口，并采用稠密优先的混合距离剪枝策略，避免不必要的精确稀疏距离计算。

Result: 实验显示，该方法在不同查询权重下均取得较好的召回率与查询吞吐量折中。在混合权重场景中，当百位召回率不低于百分之九十五时，其查询吞吐量比各数据集上最快的基线高百分之二十七点六至百分之五十二点三。

Conclusion: 统一混合图能够以单一有界图索引支持动态查询权重，减少传统分离检索带来的开销与候选损失。该方法已在蚂蚁集团生产环境大规模部署，适用于对查询级权重有强需求的混合检索场景。

Abstract: Hybrid dense-sparse vector retrieval combines semantic signals from dense representations with lexical signals from sparse representations, typically ranking items by a query-dependent weighted sum of dense and sparse vector distances. Existing systems commonly search separate dense and sparse vector indexes and rerank the union of their candidates, incurring two retrieval passes and potentially discarding items that rank highly only after the semantic and lexical signals are combined. Constructing a graph-based index directly under a hybrid distance can mitigate this premature candidate loss. However, because varying the hybrid weight alters the underlying neighborhood relationships, a single static graph built at a fixed weight cannot accommodate dynamic query-specific weights. Therefore, we propose a Unified Hybrid Graph (UniGraph), which merges neighbor sets computed at multiple hybrid weights into a single bounded-degree graph index, enabling hybrid vector retrieval with different query-specific weights without index reconstruction. We further develop an adaptive weight-guided search framework that chooses between sparse- and dense-guided entry points according to the query weight, together with a dense-first hybrid distance pruning strategy that avoids unnecessary exact sparse distance computations. Extensive experiments show that UniGraph provides a favorable Recall-QPS trade-off across different query weights. In the mixed-weight setting, UniGraph delivers 27.6%~52.3% higher QPS than the fastest baseline on each dataset at Recall@100 greater than or equal to 0.95. UniGraph has been deployed at scale in Ant Group's production environment, where hybrid retrieval with query-dependent weights is in strong demand.

</details>


### [570] [Evidence Diet: When Graph Evidence Helps LLMs Rank Competing Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20837)
*Yuchong Hu,Zhao Zhang,Ziyao Zhao,Haoyu Wang,Jing Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究发现，协同图证据不仅取决于支持者和路径的总量，也取决于这些证据是否正确分配给具体候选项；正确分配能显著提升排序表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多个候选项都获得图支持时，语言模型排序器是否只利用支持者数量和路径数量等总体信息，还是会关注这些证据分别属于哪个候选项？论文旨在厘清协同证据的归属关系对推荐排序的作用，并排除目录文本干扰、提示形式和候选项支持差异等因素的影响。

Method: 研究在亚马逊图书和影视数据上评估语言模型排序器。作者通过交换用户级证据、替换候选项、加入无关目录文本，以及在受控开发集上匹配候选项度数等方式，比较计数证据与路径证据的作用；同时比较将图记录加入用户历史、以文本呈现计数或将计数直接加入历史评分等做法。针对计数训练的模型，作者还在保持支持状态和提示词长度不变的条件下，交换有支持候选项之间完整的计数对，并在未参与前述实验的图书用户上进行冻结评估。

Result: 交换用户级证据会损害排序，而替换匹配的候选项影响较小；加入无关目录文本后，首位命中率由百分之四十四点七七降至百分之三十八点七零，但百分之九十九点九的排序仍然有效。三个配对随机种子均显示，计数训练后计数提示与路径提示的归一化折损累计增益差异大于路径训练后。度数匹配开发集上，将候选项图记录加入历史，使图书和影视数据的五位归一化折损累计增益分别提高二点二八和二点五四个百分点；目标项与竞争项均有支持时，保留计数对两类训练模型都有利，且将计数直接加入历史评分优于以文本呈现。交换完整计数对后，图书和影视数据的该指标分别下降四点零六和三点二六个百分点。未使用图书用户的冻结评估进一步确认，正确分配证据使成对准确率提高六点零七个百分点，百分之九十五置信区间为四点一八至八点零零个百分点。

Conclusion: 语言模型排序器会利用协同图证据与候选项之间的具体对应关系，而不只是利用总体支持量。正确归属计数等证据能够改善排序；因此，推荐系统在构造提示或融合图信息时，应保留证据的候选项级对应关系，并谨慎处理无关上下文。

Abstract: When several candidates have graph support, does it matter which candidate receives which supporter and path counts? We study how LLM rankers use collaborative evidence on Amazon Books and MovieTV. Swapping user-level evidence degrades ranking, while matched item substitutions have little effect. On fixed clean-trained checkpoints, unrelated catalog text lowers Hit@1 from 44.77% to 38.70%, with 99.9% of rankings still valid. Across all three paired seeds, the NDCG@5 difference between count and path prompts was larger after count training than after path training. Degree matching preserves target paths while giving more rivals support. Across the full degree-matched development pools, adding candidate-level graph records to history improves NDCG@5 by 2.28 points on Books and 2.54 on MovieTV. When the target and a rival both have support, path- and count-trained rankers benefit from retaining counts. On these development queries, adding counts numerically to history scores outperforms presenting them as text. For count-trained rankers, exchanging intact count pairs among supported candidates preserves support and token length, yet lowers NDCG@5 by 4.06 points on 141 Books queries and 3.26 on 104 MovieTV queries. A frozen evaluation on 274 previously unused Books users with supported targets and rivals confirms the attribution effect: correct assignment improves pairwise accuracy by 6.07 percentage points (95% CI [4.18, 8.00]).

</details>


### [571] [EE-Motion: An EEG-based Web Architecture for Live Affective Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21032)
*Sabino Roccotelli,Potito Aghilar,Vito Walter Anelli,Alejandro Bellogín,Tommaso Colafiglio,Michelantonio Trizio,Tommaso Di Noia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出一种网页音乐推荐平台，通过实时脑电信号估计情绪代理坐标，并据此调整推荐结果；新用户只需提供少量喜爱曲目，无须建立持久用户档案或重新训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐情绪会在聆听过程中持续变化，但现有推荐系统主要依赖离散行为记录，难以利用实时生理信号；已有情感推荐方法又常依赖静态用户档案和离线训练，因此不易服务匿名新用户。

Method: 平台通过网页蓝牙连接消费级脑电头带，实时采集脑电数据，并将额叶α波不对称性与唤醒度指标映射为情绪环形模型上的标准化效价—唤醒度代理坐标。情感适配模块将不同结构的推荐模型接入统一的实时评分机制，再结合用户提供的少量喜爱曲目，按当前代理坐标生成推荐。

Result: 论文展示了利用实时脑电推导的控制信号引导音乐推荐的可行性：系统能够面向匿名访客，根据其少量曲目偏好及实时情绪代理坐标调整推荐，无须持久化用户表或重新训练模型。摘要未提供定量实验结果。

Conclusion: 该平台将网页端脑电采集与音乐推荐结合，展示了一种可适配不同推荐模型、支持匿名新用户的实时情感推荐方案。其情绪输入是由脑电指标映射得到的代理坐标，而非对真实情绪的直接测量。

Abstract: Music listening is intrinsically tied to emotion, which drifts continuously within a single session. Although modern browsers interface with wearable brain-computer interfaces, recommendation systems remain structured around discrete logs and lack the infrastructure to integrate continuous physiological signals. Furthermore, existing affect-aware models rely on static user profiles and offline training, failing to serve anonymous newcomers without model retraining. We present a web platform that resolves both challenges. Pairing with a consumer electroencephalogram (EEG) headband over Web Bluetooth, the system captures live EEG, mapping frontal alpha asymmetry and arousal index to normalized valence-arousal proxy coordinates on Russell's circumplex plane. Driven by these coordinates, an affective adapter unifies structurally diverse recommendation backbones under a shared live scoring mechanism. By parameterizing anonymous visitors through a few favorite tracks, the module recommends tracks conditioned on live proxy coordinates. This demonstrates that real-time EEG-derived control signals can steer recommendations without persistent user tables or model retraining.

</details>


### [572] [ExRel: Learning Directed Reuse Relevance between Rich-Text K-12 Question Images with Executable Relation Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21461)
*Xuexin Liu,Zengyi Wo,Shiyu Zhang,Suqi Cheng,Daiting Shi,Xiuyi Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出一种可控、可验证的题目图像复用关系合成框架，能以较低成本生成细粒度训练数据，并提升模型对中等相关关系和图像退化的处理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中小学题目图像常包含文字、公式、图示及复杂版式。即使图像外观相似，题干措辞、条件、选项或任务范围的变化也会显著影响题目能否复用。通用相似度难以衡量这种面向具体任务的复用价值；自然标注数据又以强相关样本为主，缺少细粒度关系覆盖。

Method: 研究将题目复用建模为有方向的相关性判断，并将候选题目划分为强、中、弱三档。框架先把真实题目重建为可编辑的网页样式模板，再将十五种关系细分为可执行约束，明确允许修改的内容、必须保持的要素以及查询题与候选题的方向。生成样本需通过确定性的结构与渲染校验，以及隐藏目标信息、结合证据的审查；必要时进行有限修复，随后加入轻度照片退化。下游训练仅使用最终渲染出的图像。

Result: 实验显示，该框架生成的监督数据优于规模相同的自然数据及数量、类别均匹配的重放数据，尤其改善了中等相关关系的识别，同时保持相近的查询级排序表现，并增强模型对视觉退化的鲁棒性。构建消融实验表明，结构化流程可提高有效样本产出率、减少错误接纳。人工审查确认接纳样本的有效率为百分之九十八；每个接纳样本的成本为零点七元人民币，低于外包标注的每个一点一元。下游答案路由实验也验证了合成监督的实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过把复用关系转化为明确、可执行且可核验的编辑约束，研究缓解了自然监督中细粒度关系不足的问题。结果表明，结构化合成能够以较低成本提供高质量训练数据，提升中等相关关系识别与视觉鲁棒性，并支持实际教育应用。

Abstract: In K-12 education, question images combine text, mathematical expressions, diagrams, and diverse layouts. Variations in wording, conditions, answer options, or task scope can substantially alter their reuse utility despite visual similarity. We formulate this problem as directed reuse relevance, grading candidate utility as Strong, Medium, or Weak. However, generic similarity scores overlook task-specific reuse requirements, while natural supervision is dominated by Strong relations and lacks fine-grained coverage. We propose ExRel, an agentic, code-grounded framework for controllable and verifiable visual data synthesis. It reconstructs real questions into editable HTML/CSS seeds and compiles 15 relation subtypes into executable contracts specifying permitted edits, protected invariants, and query-candidate direction. Synthesized pairs undergo deterministic DOM/render validation and target-hidden, evidence-assisted review, with bounded repair before mild photographic degradation. Only rendered images are used for downstream training. Experiments show that ExRel supervision outperforms size-matched natural data and count- and class-matched replay, particularly on Medium relations, while maintaining comparable query-level ranking performance and improving robustness to visual degradation. Construction ablations demonstrate higher valid yield and fewer false admissions than less structured baselines. Human audits confirm 98.0% post-admission validity, while ExRel achieves a lower per-accepted-pair cost than outsourced annotation (0.70 vs. 1.10 RMB). Downstream answer routing further demonstrates the practical utility of the synthesized supervision.
